Although further testing would be needed before the technology could become a practical medical product, the finding suggests a possible route toward monitoring blood sugar without repeatedly piercing the skin.
paras.zh: 研究人员还对一名参与者进行了长时间的无创血糖追踪。尽管该技术在成为实用的医疗产品之前还需要进行进一步的测试，但这一发现表明了一种无需反复刺穿皮肤即可监测血糖的可能途径。

paras.en: "These biomedical demonstrations are particularly exciting," said Prof. Qixiang Cheng, who led the project. "What makes this work stand out is not just performance in the lab, but technical readiness. Dr. Chunhui Yao's contribution was crucial in translating a mathematical concept into a fully packaged, robust system that operates reliably across temperature extremes and real-world conditions. That combination is what opens the door to practical deployment."
paras.zh: “这些生物医学演示特别令人兴奋，”该项目负责人程启祥教授说。 “这项工作的脱颖而出不仅在于实验室的表现，还在于技术准备。姚春辉博士的贡献对于将数学概念转化为完整封装的、强大的系统至关重要，该系统可以在极端温度和现实条件下可靠运行。这种结合为实际部署打开了大门。”

paras.en: The sensor also demonstrated impressive resistance to temperature changes. It continued operating reliably between -20°C and 80°C, an unusually wide temperature range for a miniature spectrometer. This durability could be especially valuable for wearable devices, factory equipment, and sensors operating outdoors.
paras.zh: 该传感器还表现出令人印象深刻的抗温度变化能力。它在 -20°C 至 80°C 之间持续可靠运行，这对于微型光谱仪来说是一个异常宽的温度范围。这种耐用性对于可穿戴设备、工厂设备和户外运行的传感器尤其有价值。

paras.en: Why a Simpler Design Could Be a Major Breakthrough
paras.zh: 为什么更简单的设计可能是一个重大突破

paras.en: The new spectrometer's advantages extend beyond its accuracy, size, and price. Its internal design also reduces the amount of computing power needed to analyze incoming light.
paras.zh: 新型光谱仪的优势不仅仅在于精度、尺寸和价格。其内部设计还减少了分析入射光所需的计算能力。

paras.en: Many existing miniature spectrometers depend on complicated calibration procedures and demanding algorithms to reconstruct spectral information. These methods can become unreliable when measurements contain noise, and they often require substantial processing resources.
paras.zh: 许多现有的微型光谱仪依赖复杂的校准程序和苛刻的算法来重建光谱信息。当测量结果包含噪声时，这些方法可能变得不可靠，并且通常需要大量的处理资源。

paras.en: The Cambridge team's convolution-based approach avoids much of this complexity. Because the measurements follow a linear mathematical relationship, the system can recover spectra rapidly and consistently while using relatively little computational power.
paras.zh: 剑桥团队基于卷积的方法避免了大部分这种复杂性。由于测量遵循线性数学关系，因此系统可以快速一致地恢复光谱，同时使用相对较少的计算能力。

paras.en: "This is a beautiful example of how elegant engineering can unlock real impact," said Prof. Richard Penty, who contributed to the photonic system design and integration. "The architecture is simple, scalable, and manufacturable, yet it delivers precision that rivals or exceeds much larger instruments. Dr. Chunhui Yao played a central role in bringing together the photonic design, system integration, and experimental validation that made this possible."
paras.zh: “这是一个美丽的例子，展示了优雅的工程如何释放真正的影响，”为光子系统设计和集成做出贡献的理查德·彭蒂教授说。 “该架构简单、可扩展且可制造，但其精度可与大型仪器相媲美或超过。姚春辉博士在将光子设计、系统集成和实验验证结合在一起方面发挥了核心作用，使这成为可能。”

paras.en: Its relatively simple construction could also make the technology easier to manufacture on a large scale, potentially bringing sophisticated optical measurements to devices where conventional spectrometers would be too bulky or expensive.
paras.zh: 其相对简单的结构还可以使该技术更容易大规模制造，从而有可能为传统光谱仪过于笨重或昂贵的设备带来复杂的光学测量。

paras.en: Bringing Laboratory-Grade Measurements to Everyday Devices
paras.zh: 将实验室级测量引入日常设备

paras.en: The researchers envision a future in which accurate optical sensing becomes a routine feature of everyday technology rather than something largely confined to specialized laboratories.
paras.zh: 研究人员设想，未来精确的光学传感将成为日常技术的常规特征，而不再主要局限于专业实验室。

paras.en: In industrial settings, inexpensive spectrometers could be installed throughout manufacturing facilities to continuously check material composition and product quality. Similar sensors could monitor food freshness, identify substances, and analyze environmental conditions on a much larger scale than is currently practical.
paras.zh: 在工业环境中，可以在整个制造设施中安装廉价的光谱仪，以持续检查材料成分和产品质量。类似的传感器可以在比目前实际规模大得多的范围内监测食品新鲜度、识别物质并分析环境条件。

paras.en: Healthcare could see equally significant changes. Compact sensors might eventually enable wearables to measure hydration levels, detect signs of alcohol intoxication, track biomarkers related to physical fitness, or continuously monitor glucose levels for people managing diabetes.
paras.zh: 医疗保健也可能发生同样重大的变化。紧凑型传感器最终可能使可穿戴设备能够测量水合水平，检测酒精中毒的迹象，跟踪与身体健康相关的生物标志物，或持续监测糖尿病患者的血糖水平。

paras.en: "Our vision is to make spectrometry as ubiquitous as temperature or motion sensing," added Prof. Qixiang Cheng. "This work shows that high-quality spectral information doesn't have to be confined to the laboratory -- it can be embedded directly into the technologies people use every day."
paras.zh: “我们的愿景是让光谱测量像温度或运动传感一样无处不在，”程启祥教授补充道。 “这项工作表明，高质量的光谱信息不必局限于实验室——它可以直接嵌入到人们每天使用的技术中。”

paras.en: As photonic technology becomes smaller and more advanced, the convolutional spectrometer provides a promising example of how mathematical insights and practical engineering can make sophisticated scientific instruments simpler, cheaper, and more accessible. By combining high precision with a device that costs around $10, the researchers have opened a potential path toward a new generation of smart sensors capable of measuring the hidden chemistry of our bodies and surroundings.
paras.zh: 随着光子技术变得更小、更先进，卷积光谱仪提供了一个有希望的例子，说明数学见解和实际工程如何使复杂的科学仪器变得更简单、更便宜、更容易使用。通过将高精度与成本约为 10 美元的设备相结合，研究人员为新一代智能传感器开辟了一条潜在途径，能够测量我们身体和周围环境中隐藏的化学成分。

paras.en: Materials provided by University of Cambridge. Original written by Michael Shuff. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由剑桥大学提供。原创作者：迈克尔·舒夫。注意：内容的风格和长度可能会被编辑。

articles.title: Nearly 3,000 exploding stars challenge our understanding of the Universe

paras.en: Nearly 3,000 exploding stars challenge our understanding of the Universe
paras.zh: 近 3,000 颗爆炸的恒星挑战着我们对宇宙的理解

paras.en: - A massive analysis of 2,884 exploding stars has uncovered new evidence that dark energy, the mysterious force accelerating the universeâs expansion, may change over time. The findings challenge a cornerstone of modern cosmology and could reshape our understanding of how the universe works.
paras.zh: - 对 2,884 颗爆炸恒星的大规模分析发现了新的证据，表明暗能量（加速宇宙膨胀的神秘力量）可能会随着时间的推移而发生变化。这些发现挑战了现代宇宙学的基石，并可能重塑我们对宇宙如何运作的理解。

paras.en: The largest collection of exploding white dwarf stars ever compiled is providing fresh evidence that dark energy, the mysterious force responsible for the Universe’s accelerating expansion, may change over time. The findings challenge a central assumption of modern cosmology and could help scientists better understand how the Universe evolves.
paras.zh: 迄今为止最大的爆炸白矮星集合提供了新的证据，表明暗能量（导致宇宙加速膨胀的神秘力量）可能会随着时间的推移而发生变化。这些发现挑战了现代宇宙学的一个中心假设，可以帮助科学家更好地理解宇宙是如何演化的。

paras.en: An international research team led by scientists at the University of Queensland’s School of Mathematics and Physics brought together observations of 2,884 Type Ia supernovae. These powerful stellar explosions serve as important tools for measuring distances across the Universe, allowing astronomers to trace its expansion history.
paras.zh: 由昆士兰大学数学与物理学院科学家领导的国际研究小组汇集了对 2,884 颗 Ia 型超新星的观测结果。这些强大的恒星爆炸是测量宇宙距离的重要工具，使天文学家能够追踪其膨胀历史。

paras.en: PhD candidate Ryan Camilleri said the project establishes a new international standard for supernova cosmology. By bringing decades of measurements into a unified dataset, researchers have created their most detailed picture yet of how cosmic expansion has changed over time.
paras.zh: 博士生瑞安·卡米莱里 (Ryan Camilleri) 表示，该项目为超新星宇宙学建立了新的国际标准。通过将数十年的测量结果纳入统一的数据集中，研究人员创建了迄今为止最详细的图像，展示了宇宙膨胀如何随时间变化。

paras.en: “We’ve rebuilt 3 decades of astronomical observations into a single, consistent framework,” Mr. Camilleri said.
paras.zh: “我们将 3 年的天文观测重建为一个单一、一致的框架，”卡米莱里先生说。

paras.en: “We combined our data with other cosmic measurements including relic light from the Big Bang and maps of how galaxies are distributed through space.
paras.zh: “我们将我们的数据与其他宇宙测量数据结合起来，包括大爆炸的遗迹光和星系在空间中如何分布的地图。

paras.en: “Instead of confirming the standard model of cosmology which assumes dark energy is fixed and unchanging, we have more evidence that dark energy may change over time.”
paras.zh: “我们没有证实宇宙学的标准模型假设暗能量是固定不变的，而是有更多证据表明暗能量可能会随着时间的推移而变化。”

paras.en: Combining Three Decades of Supernova Observations
paras.zh: 结合三个十年的超新星观测

paras.en: The new collection brings together historical supernova measurements and findings from the Dark Energy Survey (DES) published in 2024.
paras.zh: 新合集汇集了历史上的超新星测量结果和 2024 年发布的暗能量巡天 (DES) 的发现。

paras.en: To make observations collected over different periods directly comparable, the scientists revisited older data using updated analytical methods. Advances in understanding supernova behavior allowed the team to improve the consistency and accuracy of measurements gathered over decades.
paras.zh: 为了使不同时期收集的观测结果具有直接可比性，科学家们使用更新的分析方法重新审视了旧数据。对超新星行为理解的进步使团队能够提高数十年来收集的测量结果的一致性和准确性。

paras.en: “Over the years we’ve learned a lot more about how supernovae behave so we’ve been able to go back and apply that improved understanding to older data,” Mr. Camilleri said.
paras.zh: 卡米莱里先生说：“多年来，我们对超新星的行为有了更多了解，因此我们能够回过头来，将加深的理解应用于旧数据。”

paras.en: The researchers also had to account for differences among the telescopes used to collect the observations. Other factors, including cosmic dust and the masses of galaxies, can influence the light astronomers receive from distant supernovae and therefore affect distance measurements.
paras.zh: 研究人员还必须考虑用于收集观测结果的望远镜之间的差异。其他因素，包括宇宙尘埃和星系质量，可能会影响天文学家从遥远的超新星接收到的光，从而影​​响距离测量。

paras.en: “Extensive work has been done to link observations from different telescopes with different capacities and take into account issues such as cosmic dust and galaxy mass which can affect the light coming from a supernova.
paras.zh: “我们已经开展了大量工作，将具有不同能力的不同望远镜的观测结果联系起来，并考虑到宇宙尘埃和星系质量等可能影响超新星发出的光的问题。

paras.en: “We also incorporated more subtle effects such as gravitational lensing, which is the bending and magnification of light around large objects as it travels from a supernova to Earth.”
paras.zh: “我们还融入了更微妙的效果，例如引力透镜，这是大型物体周围的光从超新星传播到地球时的弯曲和放大。”

paras.en: New Evidence Challenges the Dark Energy Model
paras.zh: 新证据挑战暗能量模型

paras.en: Astrophysicist Professor Tamara Davis said the expanded dataset represents an important advance in efforts to understand the nature of dark energy.
paras.zh: 天体物理学家塔玛拉·戴维斯教授表示，扩展的数据集代表了理解暗能量本质的重要进展。

paras.en: Under the standard model of cosmology, dark energy is treated as a constant property of the Universe. However, recent observations have raised questions about whether that assumption fully explains how cosmic expansion has evolved.
paras.zh: 在宇宙学的标准模型下，暗能量被视为宇宙的恒定属性。然而，最近的观察提出了这样的问题：这一假设是否充分解释了宇宙膨胀是如何演化的。

paras.en: “Our supernova data from DES in 2024 first showed hints that dark energy may be time varying, and this new compilation also sees a deviation from the standard model although in a slightly different direction,” Professor Davis said.
paras.zh: 戴维斯教授说：“我们在 2024 年从 DES 获得的超新星数据首次显示暗能量可能随时间变化的暗示，而这个新的汇编也看到了与标准模型的偏差，尽管方向略有不同。”

paras.en: The findings are especially interesting because a separate astronomical project has also produced evidence suggesting that dark energy might not remain constant.
paras.zh: 这些发现特别有趣，因为一个单独的天文项目也产生了证据表明暗能量可能不会保持恒定。

paras.en: “Similarly results from the Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument (DESI) found hints of variations in dark energy in its surveys of relic sound waves from the early Universe.
paras.zh: “暗能量光谱仪（DESI）的类似结果在对早期宇宙遗迹声波的调查中发现了暗能量变化的迹象。

paras.en: “So, 2 completely independent measurements have found hints of time variation in dark energy, challenging the standard model that dark energy doesn't change.
paras.zh: “因此，两次完全独立的测量发现了暗能量随时间变化的迹象，挑战了暗能量不会改变的标准模型。

paras.en: Although the different measurements do not point to exactly the same departure from the standard model, they provide additional reasons to investigate whether dark energy changes as the Universe ages.
paras.zh: 尽管不同的测量结果并不表明与标准模型的偏离完全相同，但它们为研究暗能量是否随着宇宙老化而变化提供了额外的理由。

paras.en: Could Dark Energy Help Unite Gravity and Quantum Physics?
paras.zh: 暗能量可以帮助统一引力和量子物理学吗？

paras.en: Understanding dark energy could have implications extending far beyond the expansion of the Universe. Researchers believe that learning more about its behavior might also provide insights into one of the greatest unresolved problems in theoretical physics: reconciling gravity with quantum physics.
paras.zh: 了解暗能量的影响可能远远超出宇宙的膨胀范围。研究人员认为，更多地了解其行为也可能有助于深入了解理论物理学中尚未解决的最大问题之一：协调引力与量子物理学。

paras.en: “All of this research may also hold the clue to explain how gravity and quantum physics fit together.
paras.zh: “所有这些研究也可能为解释引力和量子物理学如何结合在一起提供线索。

paras.en: “We know these 2 theories are each immensely successful in their own realms, so if we can figure out how to put them together that would be a huge step in theoretical physics.”
paras.zh: “我们知道这两种理论在各自的领域都取得了巨大的成功，因此，如果我们能够弄清楚如何将它们结合在一起，那将是理论物理学的一大进步。”

paras.en: Future Supernova Surveys Could Provide More Answers
paras.zh: 未来的超新星巡天可以提供更多答案

paras.en: The researchers plan to expand the dataset as additional observations become available. One important source will be the Dark Energy Bedrock All-Sky Supernova program (DEBASS), which is identifying hundreds of supernovae at distances closer to Earth than those surveyed by DES.
paras.zh: 研究人员计划随着更多观察结果的出现而扩展数据集。暗能量基岩全天超新星计划 (DEBASS) 是一个重要来源，该计划正在识别数百颗超新星，其距离地球的距离比 DES 调查的距离更近。

paras.en: Incorporating these nearby explosions will provide further measurements that scientists can use to investigate the Universe’s expansion and test whether dark energy truly changes over time.
paras.zh: 结合这些附近的爆炸将提供进一步的测量结果，科学家们可以利用这些测量结果来研究宇宙的膨胀并测试暗能量是否真正随着时间的推移而变化。

paras.en: The cosmology findings are available on arXiv here, while the accompanying measurements of host galaxy masses can be found on arXiv here.
paras.zh: 宇宙学研究结果可在 arXiv 上找到，而宿主星系质量的附带测量结果可以在 arXiv 上找到。

paras.en: International Collaboration Behind the Research
paras.zh: 研究背后的国际合作

paras.en: The new results build on decades of work by hundreds of astronomers and researchers worldwide. Contributing projects include the Dark Energy Survey, Foundation Supernova Survey, PanStarrs I, Sloan Digital Sky Survey, Supernova Legacy Survey, Carnegie Supernova Project, and the Center for Astrophysics supernova survey.
paras.zh: 这些新成果建立在全球数百名天文学家和研究人员数十年的工作基础上。贡献项目包括暗能量巡天、基金会超新星巡天、PanStarrs I、斯隆数字巡天、超新星遗产巡天、卡内基超新星计划和天体物理学中心超新星巡天。

paras.en: Materials provided by The University of Queensland. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由昆士兰大学提供。注意：内容的风格和长度可能会被编辑。

articles.title: 40 years later, Chernobyl's nuclear fallout is not what scientists expected

paras.en: 40 years later, Chernobyl's nuclear fallout is not what scientists expected
paras.zh: 40年后，切尔诺贝利的核辐射后果并非科学家所预期

paras.en: - Forty years after the Chornobyl disaster, tiny radioactive particles still linger in the soil, carrying a dangerous legacy. Using powerful X-rays, scientists discovered that some of these particles have remained surprisingly stable, trapping radioactive substances inside instead of releasing them into the environment.
paras.zh: - 切尔诺贝利灾难四十年后，微小的放射性颗粒仍然残留在土壤中，带来危险的遗产。科学家利用强大的 X 射线发现，其中一些粒子出人意料地保持稳定，将放射性物质捕获在内部，而不是将其释放到环境中。

paras.en: Four decades after the Chernobyl (known today as Chornobyl) nuclear disaster, microscopic radioactive particles remain scattered throughout the surrounding soil. The explosions that devastated the reactor released enormous quantities of debris, leaving behind contamination that continues to pose serious health risks. Even after 40 years, particles measuring just 8 to 50 micrometers remain highly radioactive, and entering affected areas still requires protective clothing.
paras.zh: 切尔诺贝利（今天称为切尔诺贝利）核灾难发生四十年后，微小的放射性颗粒仍然散布在周围的土壤中。摧毁反应堆的爆炸释放了大量碎片，留下的污染继续构成严重的健康风险。即使 40 年后，直径仅为 8 至 50 微米的颗粒仍然具有高放射性，进入受影响区域仍然需要穿着防护服。

paras.en: Scientists have now taken a closer look at these tiny remnants and uncovered a surprising finding: some have preserved much of their original internal structure despite decades of exposure to the environment.
paras.zh: 科学家们现在仔细观察了这些微小的残留物，并发现了一个令人惊讶的发现：尽管暴露在环境中数十年，有些仍然保留了大部分原始的内部结构。

paras.en: "There are three classes of these particles," explains Tobias Weissenborn, a physicist and doctoral candidate at Leibniz University Hannover. "First, there are particles that are chemically and physically still very similar to the nuclear fuel uranium dioxide. Then, there are particles that are partially or fully encased in, or completely fused with, their zirconium layer."
paras.zh: “这些粒子分为三类，”汉诺威莱布尼茨大学的物理学家兼博士生托比亚斯·魏森博恩 (Tobias Weissenborn) 解释道。 “首先，有些粒子在化学和物理上仍然与核燃料二氧化铀非常相似。然后，有些粒子部分或完全包裹在其锆层中，或完全与其融合。”

paras.en: The second category originated during the extreme temperatures reached inside the reactor. As the nuclear fuel melted, it combined with zirconium, a highly resistant metal used in the fuel's protective outer layer.
paras.zh: 第二类起源于反应堆内部达到极端温度时。当核燃料熔化时，它与锆结合，锆是一种用于燃料保护外层的高电阻金属。

paras.en: "The third type of particle was created when the graphite-moderator caught fire," Weissenborn adds.
paras.zh: “第三种类型的粒子是当石墨慢化剂着火时产生的，”魏森伯恩补充道。

paras.en: Under normal operating conditions, the graphite moderator slows fast neutrons, helping sustain the nuclear chain reaction. During the disaster, however, the graphite ignited and continued burning for ten days.
paras.zh: 在正常操作条件下，石墨慢化剂会减慢快中子的速度，有助于维持核链式反应。然而灾难期间，石墨着火并持续燃烧了十天。

paras.en: "In the process, the fuel oxidized into various uranium oxides" - such as U3O8.
paras.zh: “在此过程中，燃料氧化成各种铀氧化物”——例如 U3O8。

paras.en: Unlike more stable materials, this uranium oxide is mechanically fragile and can readily break apart into microscopic fragments. Wind can then carry these radioactive particles through the environment, where inhaling them presents serious health hazards.
paras.zh: 与更稳定的材料不同，这种氧化铀在机械上很脆弱，很容易分解成微小的碎片。然后风可以携带这些放射性颗粒穿过环境，吸入它们会严重危害健康。

paras.en: Scientists Examine Chornobyl's Radioactive Dust in Unprecedented Detail
paras.zh: 科学家以前所未有的细节检查切尔诺贝利的放射性尘埃

paras.en: Despite decades of research, scientists still do not fully understand why radioactive particles from Chornobyl break down at different speeds. As these materials weather, they can produce several forms of uranium oxide, making their long term behavior difficult to predict.
paras.zh: 尽管进行了数十年的研究，科学家们仍然不完全理解为什么切尔诺贝利的放射性粒子以不同的速度分解。随着这些材料的风化，它们会产生多种形式的氧化铀，从而使其长期行为难以预测。

paras.en: Investigating these changes requires exceptionally precise equipment, including synchrotron X-ray diffraction, a technique that reveals the arrangement of atoms inside crystalline materials.
paras.zh: 研究这些变化需要极其精确的设备，包括同步加速器 X 射线衍射，这是一种揭示晶体材料内部原子排列的技术。

paras.en: Dr. Christoph Hennig, a crystallographer at the Helmholtz-Zentrum Dresden-Rossendorf (HZDR), has now completed the first successful structural analysis of radioactive fragments of this kind at the Rossendorf Beamline in Grenoble.
paras.zh: 德累斯顿-罗森多夫亥姆霍兹中心 (HZDR) 的晶体学家 Christoph Hennig 博士现已在格勒诺布尔的罗森多夫束线完成了此类放射性碎片的首次成功结构分析。

paras.en: Working with Weissenborn, Hennig analyzed six particles recovered from the Chornobyl region. By identifying the different crystalline phases within them, the researchers gained information that could help determine how quickly radioactive substances escape into the surrounding environment.
paras.zh: 亨尼格与魏森博恩合作，分析了从切尔诺贝利地区回收的六种颗粒。通过识别其中的不同晶相，研究人员获得了有助于确定放射性物质逃逸到周围环境中的速度的信息。

paras.en: "The colleagues from Hanover and I used various methods to isolate the particles from Ukrainian soil samples and attach them to tungsten electrodes," Weissenborn explains.
paras.zh: “我和来自汉诺威的同事使用各种方法从乌克兰土壤样本中分离出颗粒，并将它们附着在钨电极上，”魏森伯恩解释道。

paras.en: Because the samples were highly radioactive, they had to be enclosed within several layers of containment before being transported to Grenoble. There, Hennig's research team used X-ray diffraction to examine their internal structures by measuring how X-rays scattered as they passed through the material.
paras.zh: 由于样本具有高放射性，因此在运往格勒诺布尔之前必须将它们封装在多层安全壳内。在那里，Hennig 的研究团队使用 X 射线衍射通过测量 X 射线穿过材料时的散射情况来检查其内部结构。

paras.en: "First, we had to figure out how to examine the particle structure," Christoph Hennig explains. "Ultimately, we fully rotated the particles in an X-ray beam focused down to 100 micrometers - about the thickness of a human hair. We measured each particle from 2,000 different angles to seamlessly capture all the reflections."
paras.zh: “首先，我们必须弄清楚如何检查粒子结构，”克里斯托夫·亨尼格解释道。 “最终，我们在聚焦至 100 微米的 X 射线束中完全旋转粒子，大约相当于人类头发的厚度。我们从 2,000 个不同角度测量每个粒子，以无缝捕获所有反射。”

paras.en: The measurements allowed the scientists to distinguish different uranium oxide phases within the radioactive fragments, revealing details that had previously been inaccessible.
paras.zh: 这些测量使科学家能够区分放射性碎片中不同的氧化铀相，揭示了以前无法获得的细节。

paras.en: A Surprising Discovery About 40-Year-Old Nuclear Fallout
paras.zh: 关于 40 年前核尘埃的惊人发现

paras.en: The results revealed something unexpected. Despite spending four decades in the environment, the nuclear fuel inside the six examined particles had retained much of its original crystal structure.
paras.zh: 结果揭示了一些意想不到的事情。尽管在环境中呆了四十年，这六个被检查的粒子内的核燃料仍然保留了其大部分原始晶体结构。

paras.en: This suggests that at least some of the radioactive debris produced by the Chornobyl disaster is more chemically stable than researchers previously believed.
paras.zh: 这表明至少部分切尔诺贝利灾难产生的放射性碎片的化学性质比研究人员之前认为的更稳定。

paras.en: That stability could have important environmental implications. Rather than rapidly releasing radioactive substances, the particles appear capable of retaining fission products within their structures. If this behavior occurs more widely, it could help limit the movement of radioactive contaminants into nearby soil and water.
paras.zh: 这种稳定性可能会产生重要的环境影响。这些粒子似乎能够将裂变产物保留在其结构内，而不是快速释放放射性物质。如果这种行为更广泛地发生，它可能有助于限制放射性污染物进入附近的土壤和水中。

paras.en: However, the researchers emphasize that their findings should not be interpreted as evidence that Chornobyl's radioactive contamination is becoming harmless.
paras.zh: 然而，研究人员强调，他们的发现不应被解释为切尔诺贝利核电站的放射性污染正在变得无害的证据。

paras.en: "However, every single particle has a different structure," warns Weissenborn, "and our experiment only studied six such particles from two different locations."
paras.zh: “然而，每个粒子都有不同的结构，”魏森伯恩警告说，“我们的实验只研究了来自两个不同位置的六个这样的粒子。”

paras.en: The relatively small sample means the findings cannot yet establish how radioactive particles behave throughout the entire contaminated region. To understand their stability more comprehensively, scientists would need to investigate many additional particles collected from a much broader range of locations.
paras.zh: 样本相对较小意味着研究结果尚无法确定放射性粒子在整个污染区域的行为方式。为了更全面地了解它们的稳定性，科学家需要研究从更广泛的地点收集的许多其他粒子。

paras.en: Why Chornobyl's Radioactive Legacy Remains Unpredictable
paras.zh: 为什么切尔诺贝利的放射性遗产仍然难以预测

paras.en: Even with substantially more data, predicting the long term dangers of Chornobyl's radioactive debris would remain challenging. Individual particles can differ in composition, structure, and resistance to environmental weathering, potentially affecting when they release radioactive materials.
paras.zh: 即使有更多的数据，预测切尔诺贝利放射性碎片的长期危险仍然具有挑战性。单个颗粒的成分、结构和对环境风化的抵抗力可能有所不同，这可能会影响它们释放放射性物质的时间。

paras.en: "And even if we obtained some averages at some point, we still wouldn't be able to make universal statements about health risks in the region," Weissenborn cautions. "Because even if the particles decay in a largely uniform patten, there will always be outliers, more persistent particles, that will release radionuclides at a later point in time."
paras.zh: “即使我们在某个时候获得了一些平均值，我们仍然无法对该地区的健康风险做出普遍的陈述，”魏森伯恩警告说。 “因为即使粒子以基本均匀的模式衰变，总会有异常值、更持久的粒子，它们会在稍后的时间点释放放射性核素。”

paras.en: These persistent particles could continue releasing radioactive substances long after other remnants have broken down, complicating efforts to assess future contamination and health risks.
paras.zh: 在其他残留物分解很久之后，这些持久性颗粒可能会继续释放放射性物质，使评估未来污染和健康风险的工作变得更加复杂。

paras.en: For that reason, the new findings do not suggest that restrictions on the Chornobyl Exclusion Zone can be removed anytime soon.
paras.zh: 因此，新的调查结果并不表明对切尔诺贝利禁区的限制可以很快取消。

paras.en: Research into the disaster's enduring consequences is continuing. Weissenborn and Hennig are already conducting additional experiments focused on highly radioactive transuranic phases found in the remaining debris. Their work could provide a clearer picture of how Chornobyl's nuclear materials change over time and how long their environmental effects may persist.
paras.zh: 对这场灾难的持久后果的研究仍在继续。魏森博恩和亨尼格已经在进行其他实验，重点关注在剩余碎片中发现的高放射性超铀相。他们的工作可以更清楚地了解切尔诺贝利核材料如何随时间变化以及它们的环境影响可能持续多久。

paras.en: - Tobias Weissenborn, Christoph Hennig, Laura Leifermann, Paul Hanemann, Eleanor Lawrence Bright, Florian Meurer, Aaron Lehnert, Kristina Kvashnina, Clemens Walther. X-ray diffraction phase analysis of single hot particles from Chornobyl. Journal of Hazardous Materials, 2026; 505: 141533 DOI: 10.1016/j.jhazmat.2026.141533
paras.zh: - 托比亚斯·魏森伯恩、克里斯托夫·亨尼格、劳拉·莱弗曼、保罗·哈内曼、埃莉诺·劳伦斯·布莱特、弗洛里安·梅勒、亚伦·莱纳特、克里斯蒂娜·克瓦斯尼娜、克莱门斯·瓦尔特。切尔诺贝利单个热粒子的 X 射线衍射相分析。危险材料杂志，2026； 505：141533 DOI：10.1016/j.jhazmat.2026.141533

articles.title: After Starshield interruption, Ukraine wants to build its own satellite communication network with ICEYE and Nokia
articles.author: Mike Wall

paras.en: Ukraine wants its own satellite-communication system, which shouldn't be surprising given the events of the past week or so.
paras.zh: 乌克兰想要拥有自己的卫星通信系统，考虑到过去一周左右发生的事件，这不足为奇。

paras.en: The Ukrainian military just signed a letter of intent with two Finnish companies — the telecom giant Nokia and satellite maker ICEYE — to look into developing a sovereign satellite-communications network for Ukraine.
paras.zh: 乌克兰军方刚刚与电信巨头诺基亚和卫星制造商 ICEYE 两家芬兰公司签署了一份意向书，研究为乌克兰开发主权卫星通信网络。

paras.en: "Ukraine needs secure, sovereign and high-performance satellite communications systems that it controls," ICEYE cofounder and CEO Rafal Modrzewski said in a statement today (Oct. 22). "We have a proven track record of delivering sovereign missions at speed to help build that capability. ICEYE has proudly supported Ukraine since 2022, and we remain committed to continuing that support today."
paras.zh: ICEYE 联合创始人兼首席执行官 Rafal Modrzewski 在今天（10 月 22 日）的一份声明中表示：“乌克兰需要其控制的安全、主权和高性能卫星通信系统。” “我们在快速交付主权任务以帮助建立这种能力方面有着良好的记录。ICEYE 自 2022 年以来一直自豪地支持乌克兰，并且我们今天仍然致力于继续提供这种支持。”

paras.en: Ukraine relies heavily on satellite-based communications and data to defend itself from Russia, which invaded the nation in February 2022 and continues to attack it with ground troops, missiles and drone strikes.
paras.zh: 乌克兰严重依赖卫星通信和数据来防御俄罗斯，俄罗斯于 2022 年 2 月入侵该国，并继续通过地面部队、导弹和无人机袭击对其进行攻击。

paras.en: But Ukraine does not own those satellites. It primarily uses the services provided by SpaceX's Starlink megaconstellation in low Earth orbit (LEO) and Starshield, a military-grade, jamming-resistant version of Starlink employed by the U.S. government and its allies.
paras.zh: 但乌克兰并不拥有这些卫星。它主要使用 SpaceX 的低地球轨道 (LEO) 星链巨型星座和 Starshield 提供的服务，Starshield 是美国政府及其盟友采用的军用级、抗干扰版本的星链。

paras.en: Starshield in particular is crucial to Ukraine, as it allows the nation to operate fast-moving drones over large distances in war zones. Ukraine has gotten very good at drone warfare, employing these little robots both in offensive and defensive capacities.
paras.zh: “星盾”对乌克兰尤其重要，因为它使该国能够在战区远距离操作快速移动的无人机。乌克兰在无人机战争方面非常擅长，利用这些小型机器人进行进攻和防御。

paras.en: On Oct. 14, however, Ukrainian soldiers and officials reported a severe throttling of their access to Starshield services — a speed limit on terminal-carrying drones, which caused many of them to fall out of the sky.
paras.zh: 然而，10 月 14 日，乌克兰士兵和官员报告称，他们对 Starshield 服务的访问受到严重限制——对携带终端的无人机进行速度限制，导致许多无人机从天上掉下来。

paras.en: It's not entirely clear who's behind the throttling. Some U.S. officials have apparently said the order came from Elon Musk, but the billionaire SpaceX founder and CEO put the ultimate responsibility on the Trump administration.
paras.zh: 目前还不完全清楚谁是此次节流的幕后黑手。一些美国官员显然表示该命令来自埃隆·马斯克，但亿万富翁 SpaceX 创始人兼首席执行官将最终责任归咎于特朗普政府。

paras.en: "Starshield systems are owned and controlled by the US government. Any limits on speed or usage are decided by the US military and ultimately POTUS," Musk said on Oct. 14 via X, the social media platform he owns.
paras.zh: 10 月 14 日，马斯克通过他拥有的社交媒体平台 X 表示，“星盾系统由美国政府拥有和控制。对速度或使用的任何限制均由美国军方以及最终由美国总统决定。”

paras.en: Whoever made the call, it certainly wasn't Ukraine. And the Starshield throttling — which apparently is still in effect — has doubtless reinforced the nation's desire to control its own satellite-communications infrastructure.
paras.zh: 不管是谁打来的，肯定不是乌克兰。而星盾节流——显然仍然有效——无疑增强了国家控制自己卫星通信基础设施的愿望。

paras.en: "Nations need communications they can rely on in every situation. Satellite networks extend and protect connectivity when networks on the ground are disrupted," Mikko Hautala, Nokia's chief geopolitical and government relations officer and chairman of Nokia Defense, said in the same statement.
paras.zh: 诺基亚首席地缘政治和政府关系官兼诺基亚防务董事长米科·豪塔拉（Mikko Hautala）在同一份声明中表示：“各国需要在任何情况下都可以依赖的通信。当地面网络中断时，卫星网络可以扩展并保护连接。”

paras.en: "This makes them a key part of any secure communications system," he added. "Through this Letter of Intent, together with Ukraine and ICEYE, we will explore how trusted, sovereign satellite communications can strengthen Ukraine's resilience and give it control over the connectivity it depends on."
paras.zh: “这使它们成为任何安全通信系统的关键部分，”他补充道。 “通过这份意向书，我们将与乌克兰和 ICEYE 一起探索可信的主权卫星通信如何增强乌克兰的复原力，并使其控制其所依赖的连接。”

paras.en: Nokia and ICEYE announced on Oct. 1 that they plan to work together to help nations develop such sovereign satcom systems. The partnership with Ukraine follows on from that earlier agreement.
paras.zh: 诺基亚和 ICEYE 于 10 月 1 日宣布，他们计划共同努力帮助各国开发此类主权卫星通信系统。与乌克兰的伙伴关系延续了之前的协议。

paras.en: ICEYE has already been aiding the Ukrainian defense effort. The Finnish company and its U.S. subsidiary jointly operate a fleet of Earth-observing satellites in LEO, which study our planet using synthetic aperture radar. Ukraine uses data from the ICEYE constellation for intelligence and planning purposes.
paras.zh: ICEYE 已经在协助乌克兰的国防工作。这家芬兰公司及其美国子公司在低地球轨道联合运营一组地球观测卫星，利用合成孔径雷达研究我们的星球。乌克兰将 ICEYE 星座的数据用于情报和规划目的。

paras.en: This relationship has put ICEYE — or one of its satellites, at least — in Russia's crosshairs. A Russian inspector satellite called Kosmos 2612 recently made an extremely close approach to ICEYE-X36, which is operated by ICEYE US.
paras.zh: 这种关系使 ICEYE——或者至少是它的一颗卫星——成为俄罗斯的瞄准目标。一颗名为 Kosmos 2612 的俄罗斯检查卫星最近非常接近由 ICEYE US 运营的 ICEYE-X36。

paras.en: The goal of the unsanctioned rendezvous is unclear. Russia may have wanted to assess the satellite's capabilities or interfere with it in some way. Or perhaps the nation simply wanted to send a message, letting ICEYE (and Ukraine) know that it could mess with satellites if it wanted to.
paras.zh: 这次未经批准的会合的目标尚不清楚。俄罗斯可能想评估卫星的能力或以某种方式对其进行干扰。或者也许这个国家只是想发出一条信息，让 ICEYE（和乌克兰）知道，如果它愿意的话，它可以干扰卫星。

paras.en: Michael Wall is the Spaceflight and Tech Editor for Space.com and joined the team in 2010. He primarily covers human and robotic spaceflight, military space, and exoplanets, but has been known to dabble in the space art beat. His book about the search for alien life, "Out There," was published on Nov. 13, 2018. Before becoming a science writer, Michael worked as a herpetologist and wildlife biologist. He has a Ph.D. in evolutionary biology from the University of Sydney, Australia, a bachelor's degree from the University of Arizona, and a graduate certificate in science writing from the University of California, Santa Cruz. To find out what his latest project is, you can follow Michael on Twitter.
paras.zh: Michael Wall 是 Space.com 的太空飞行和技术编辑，于 2010 年加入该团队。他主要报道人类和机器人太空飞行、军事太空和系外行星，但以涉足太空艺术领域而闻名。他关于寻找外星生命的书《Out There》于 2018 年 11 月 13 日出版。在成为科普作家之前，迈克尔曾是一名爬行动物学家和野生动物生物学家。他拥有博士学位。澳大利亚悉尼大学进化生物学博士学位、亚利桑那大学学士学位以及加州大学圣克鲁斯分校科学写作研究生证书。要了解他的最新项目是什么，您可以在 Twitter 上关注 Michael。

articles.title: On this day in space! Oct. 22, 1992: Ashes of 'Star Trek' creator Gene Roddenberry launch into space on NASA shuttle
articles.author: Hanneke Weitering

paras.en: On Oct. 22, 1992, the space shuttle Columbia launched into space with the ashes of Gene Roddenberry, the creator of "Star Trek," aboard.
paras.zh: 1992年10月22日，哥伦比亚号航天飞机载着《星际迷航》创始人吉恩·罗登伯里的骨灰升入太空。

paras.en: During mission STS-52, NASA astronaut and shuttle commander James Wetherbee brought a small container with a portion of Roddenberry's ashes into space as part of his personal effects at the request of Roddenberry's widow, Majel Barrett. It was Roddenberry's lifelong dream to go to space, but he never got to go while he was alive.
paras.zh: 在 STS-52 任务期间，美国宇航局宇航员兼航天飞机指挥官詹姆斯·韦瑟比 (James Wetherbee) 应罗登伯里遗孀马杰尔·巴雷特 (Majel Barrett) 的要求，将一个装有罗登伯里部分骨灰的小容器带入太空，作为他个人物品的一部分。进入太空是罗登伯里一生的梦想，但他在世时从未去过太空。

paras.en: But thanks to his wife, a little bit of Roddenberry finally made it to space almost exactly one year after his death. NASA and his family didn't tell anyone about it until almost two years later in 1994.
paras.zh: 但多亏了他的妻子，罗登伯里的一点点终于在他去世后几乎整整一年进入了太空。 NASA 和他的家人直到近两年后的 1994 年才告诉任何人这件事。

paras.en: Wetherbee said he was "honored to be asked" by Barrett to carry Roddenberry's ashses on the spaceflight. "I'm just glad I was able to bring a little happiness to the family," he said, according to Newsweek.
paras.zh: 韦瑟比表示，他“很荣幸被巴雷特邀请”在太空飞行中携带罗登伯里的骨灰。据《新闻周刊》报道，他说：“我很高兴能为家人带来一点幸福。”

paras.en: The launch of Roddenberry's ashes into space on NASA's STS-52 mission aboard the space shuttle Columbia marked the world's first "space burial," but it wouldn't be the last.
paras.zh: 在 NASA 的 STS-52 任务中，哥伦比亚号航天飞机将罗登伯里的骨灰发射到太空，这标志着世界上第一次“太空埋葬”，但这不会是最后一次。

paras.en: About five years after Roddenberry's memorial flight, in 1997, the space memorial company Celestis began launching a series of "burial" flights by flying capsules with human cremains on rockets . In fact, more of Roddenberry's ashes flew on Celestis' "founders flight" in April 1997 aboard an air-launched Pegasus rocket that took off from the Canary Islands in Spain. The ashes of Roddenberry's wife and of Star Trek actor James Doohan have also flown in space, among others.
paras.zh: 罗登伯里纪念飞行大约五年后，即 1997 年，太空纪念公司 Celestis 开始发射一系列“埋葬”飞行，用火箭运送装有人类骨灰的胶囊。事实上，1997 年 4 月，更多罗登伯里的骨灰搭乘从西班牙加那利群岛起飞的空射飞马座火箭，登上了 Celestis 的“创始人飞行”。罗登伯里的妻子和《星际迷航》演员詹姆斯·杜汉的骨灰等也曾飞入太空。

paras.en: Celestis has gone on to launch human cremains on many suborbital and orbital flights, including some on SpaceX Falcon 9 rockets. The company even launched the ashes of the late astronomer Eugene Shoemaker to the moon in 1999 on the Luna 1 flight, with another set of cremains launched into deep space on the Enterprise mission in 2023.
paras.zh: Celestis 已经在许多亚轨道和轨道飞行中发射了人类骨灰，其中包括 SpaceX Falcon 9 火箭上的一些。该公司甚至于 1999 年通过 Luna 1 号航班将已故天文学家尤金·舒梅克 (Eugene Shoemaker) 的骨灰送入月球，并在 2023 年通过企业号任务将另一组骨灰送入深空。

paras.en: Want more space history? Check out our full On This Day In Space Story archive and watch our On This Day In Space videos on YouTube.
paras.zh: 想要更多太空历史吗？查看我们完整的“太空中的这一天”故事存档，并在 YouTube 上观看“太空中的这一天”视频。

paras.en: Hanneke Weitering is a multimedia journalist in the Pacific Northwest reporting on the future of aviation at FutureFlight.aero and Aviation International News and was previously the Editor for Spaceflight and Astronomy news here at Space.com. As an editor with over 10 years of experience in science journalism she has previously written for Scholastic Classroom Magazines, MedPage Today and The Joint Institute for Computational Sciences at Oak Ridge National Laboratory. After studying physics at the University of Tennessee in her hometown of Knoxville, she earned her graduate degree in Science, Health and Environmental Reporting (SHERP) from New York University. Hanneke joined the Space.com team in 2016 as a staff writer and producer, covering topics including spaceflight and astronomy. She currently lives in Seattle, home of the Space Needle, with her cat and two snakes. In her spare time, Hanneke enjoys exploring the Rocky Mountains, basking in nature and looking for dark skies to gaze at the cosmos.
paras.zh: Hanneke Weitering 是西北太平洋地区的一名多媒体记者，在 FutureFlight.aero 和 Aviation International News 报道航空业的未来，此前曾担任 Space.com 的航天和天文学新闻编辑。作为一名拥有 10 多年科学新闻经验的编辑，她曾为学术课堂杂志、MedPage Today 和橡树岭国家实验室计算科学研究所撰写文章。在家乡诺克斯维尔的田纳西大学学习物理学后，她在纽约大学获得了科学、健康和环境报告 (SHERP) 研究生学位。 Hanneke 于 2016 年加入 Space.com 团队，担任专职撰稿人和制作人，涵盖航天和天文学等主题。她目前与她的猫和两条蛇住在太空针塔所在地西雅图。在业余时间，汉内克喜欢探索落基山脉，沐浴在大自然中，寻找黑暗的天空凝视宇宙。

articles.title: Europe's Space Rider vehicle comes crashing down during drop test
articles.author: Josh Dinner

paras.en: Europe has dropped the ball on the prototype for its first reusable spacecraft. Or, rather, the prototype itself was dropped — on purpose — but the outcome of its fall was not what engineers had hoped for.
paras.zh: 欧洲已经放弃了其第一个可重复使用航天器的原型。或者更确切地说，原型本身是故意掉落的，但其掉落的结果并不是工程师所希望的。

paras.en: The incident occurred during an Oct. 6 drop test of the full-scale Space Rider model, from the European Space Agency (ESA). The robotic vehicle's initial drogue parachute deployed successfully, but its main parafoil detached during deployment, leaving the prototype unable to slow its descent before crashing into the ground, according to ESA officials. The cause of the failure remains under investigation.
paras.zh: 该事件发生在欧洲航天局 (ESA) 10 月 6 日对全尺寸太空骑士模型进行跌落测试期间。据欧空局官员称，该机器人飞行器最初的锥套降落伞成功展开，但其主翼伞在展开过程中分离，导致原型机在坠入地面之前无法减慢下降速度。故障原因仍在调查中。

paras.en: "Following several successful tests using representative vehicle masses, the latest system-level drop test in October was not completed as planned due to an anomaly during the parafoil deployment sequence," an ESA spokesperson confirmed in an email to Space.com. "An independent investigation is ongoing to determine its root cause and inform the next steps."
paras.zh: 欧空局发言人在给 Space.com 的电子邮件中证实：“在使用具有代表性的车辆质量进行了几次成功测试之后，由于翼伞部署序列中出现异常，10 月份最新的系统级跌落测试未能按计划完成。” “一项独立调查正在进行中，以确定其根本原因并为下一步行动提供信息。”

paras.en: Space Rider is being developed as Europe's first reusable orbital spacecraft — an uncrewed vehicle designed to carry scientific experiments to orbit for up to two months, then return them to Earth for analysis. Its method of return, though, differs from that of any other spacecraft in operation today. Space Rider''s wingless, lifting-body design relies on a steerable parachute, or parafoil, to maneuver toward its landing area. This allows it to perform runway-style touchdowns, as opposed to other, less accurate parachute-aided recoveries in current practice.
paras.zh: Space Rider 正在开发中，作为欧洲第一艘可重复使用的轨道航天器，这是一种无人驾驶飞行器，旨在将科学实验带入轨道长达两个月，然后将其带回地球进行分析。不过，它的返回方法与当今运行的任何其他航天器不同。太空骑士的无翼升力体设计依靠可操纵的降落伞或翼伞来操纵其着陆区域。这使得它能够执行跑道式着陆，而不是当前实践中其他不太准确的降落伞辅助回收。

paras.en: This month's drop test was intended to demonstrate that ability, which is a critical requirement for Space Rider's planned reuse after missions in orbit, but the impact of its failure may not end up disrupting its ultimate development timeline. According to Géraldine Naja, ESA's director of space transportation, the vehicle's other remaining qualification tests aren't holding back its path to launch.
paras.zh: 本月的跌落测试旨在证明这种能力，这是太空骑士计划在轨道任务后重复使用的关键要求，但其失败的影响可能不会最终扰乱其最终的开发时间表。欧空局太空运输主管杰拉尔丁·纳贾 (Géraldine Naja) 表示，该飞行器的其他剩余资格测试并没有阻碍其发射之路。

paras.en: "We hope that this test will not damage, or let's say lead us to modify, the remaining schedule and qualification activities," Naja said during an ESA Council media briefing on Oct. 22. "In any case, the remaining qualification activities are not on the critical path of the development of the Space Rider."
paras.zh: 纳贾在 10 月 22 日的欧空局理事会媒体吹风会上表示：“我们希望这次测试不会损害，或者说导致我们修改剩余的时间表和资格认证活动。无论如何，剩余的资格认证活动并不在太空骑士发展的关键道路上。”

paras.en: Naja described the incident as an unfortunate but important event. "We have had many successful tests before, but testing and validation is part of the development of a space system," she said.
paras.zh: 纳贾形容这一事件是一个不幸但重要的事件。 “我们之前已经进行过许多成功的测试，但测试和验证是太空系统开发的一部分，”她说。

paras.en: The lost vehicle was a full-scale test model assembled to evaluate Space Rider's descent and landing systems. The minivan-sized mockup reproduced the size and flight characteristics of its reentry module, with avionics to control its autonomous guidance and navigation systems, but the vehicle was far from a space-ready article.
paras.zh: 失落的飞行器是一个全尺寸测试模型，组装用于评估太空骑士的下降和着陆系统。这个小型货车大小的模型再现了其再入舱的尺寸和飞行特性，并用航空电子设备控制其自主制导和导航系统，但该飞行器距离太空准备就绪还很远。

paras.en: The Oct. 6 test took place at a military range on the Italian island of Sardinia, where the mockup was released from a helicopter at an altitude of approximately 2 miles (3 kilometers). According to Naja, the vehicle's initial drogue parachute triggered as expected and began slowing the Space Rider mock-up's descent before its larger, steerable parafoil was supposed to unfurl. The parafoil, however, detached during deployment, leaving the vehicle in freefall before impacting the ground. ESA has subsequently recovered all the craft's components.
paras.zh: 10 月 6 日的测试在意大利撒丁岛的一个军事靶场进行，模型从直升机上释放，高度约 2 英里（3 公里）。据纳贾介绍，飞行器最初的锥套降落伞按预期触发，并在其更大的可操纵翼伞展开之前开始减慢太空骑士模型的下降速度。然而，翼伞在展开过程中脱落，导致飞行器在撞击地面之前处于自由落体状态。欧空局随后回收了飞船的所有部件。

paras.en: This month's event was the first drop test since an unsuccessful attempt in May, when a sensor flagged an issue during preparations, prompting engineers to abort the test before the model was released. Following that, Space Rider's testing range, operated by Italy's Ministry of Defense, was unavailable from June through September.
paras.zh: 本月的活动是自 5 月份尝试失败以来的首次跌落测试，当时传感器在准备过程中发现了一个问题，促使工程师在模型发布之前中止了测试。此后，由意大利国防部运营的 Space Rider 测试场从 6 月到 9 月都无法使用。

paras.en: Space Rider's descent and landing qualification campaign began in 2025, with previous successes demonstrating its parafoil deployment and autonomous capabilities. Beyond its landing systems, Space Rider also underwent separate thermal protection testing earlier this year, exposing its heat-shield materials to temperatures around 2,900 degrees Fahrenheit (1,600 degrees Celsius) in plasma wind tunnel trials.
paras.zh: Space Rider 的下降和着陆资格认证活动于 2025 年开始，之前的成功展示了其翼伞部署和自主能力。除了着陆系统之外，Space Rider 今年早些时候还进行了单独的热防护测试，在等离子风洞试验中将其隔热材料暴露在 2,900 华氏度（1,600 摄氏度）左右的温度下。

paras.en: ESA has targeted Space Rider's first orbital mission for later this decade.
paras.zh: 欧空局已确定太空骑士号的首次轨道飞行任务将在本十年晚些时候进行。

paras.en: Josh Dinner is Space.com's Spaceflight Staff Writer and a photographer with a passion for science and space exploration. He has worked the space beat since 2016, covering the evolution of NASA's commercial spaceflight partnerships and crewed missions from the Space Coast, planetary science missions, the Artemis program and humanity's return to the moon and more. He also enjoys building 1:144-scale model rockets and spacecraft. Find some of Josh's launch photography on Instagram, and follow him on X, where he mostly posts in haiku.
paras.zh: 乔什·丁纳 (Joshdinner) 是 Space.com 的 Spaceflight 特约撰稿人，也是一位热衷于科学和太空探索的摄影师。自 2016 年以来，他一直致力于太空领域的研究，报道了 NASA 商业航天合作伙伴关系的演变、太空海岸载人飞行任务、行星科学任务、阿尔忒弥斯计划以及人类重返月球等内容。他还喜欢建造 1:144 比例的火箭和航天器模型。在 Instagram 上查找 Josh 的一些首发照片，并在 X 上关注他，他主要在 X 上发布俳句。

articles.title: Oct. 29: Applying AI/SI to the GEOINT Mission
articles.author: SpaceNews Editor

paras.en: Artificial intelligence is changing how intelligence organizations collect, process and exploit satellite imagery. As the volume of Earth observation data grows, AI is becoming essential for identifying patterns, detecting anomalies and delivering intelligence at operational speed.
paras.zh: 人工智能正在改变情报组织收集、处理和利用卫星图像的方式。随着地球观测数据量的增长，人工智能对于识别模式、检测异常和以运行速度提供情报变得至关重要。

paras.en: Join SpaceNews and Vantor on Oct. 29 for a virtual event that will explore how machine learning is transforming the GEOINT mission across defense, intelligence and commercial markets.
paras.zh: 10 月 29 日与 SpaceNews 和 Vantor 一起参加虚拟活动，探讨机器学习如何改变国防、情报和商业市场的 GEOINT 任务。

paras.en: Speakers will discuss advances in automated target recognition, change detection, multimodal data fusion and large language models, as well as the challenges of validating AI outputs and maintaining analyst trust. The conversation will consider where AI delivers its greatest operational value, where humans remain indispensable and how intelligence organizations can adapt to persistent, data-driven surveillance.
paras.zh: 演讲者将讨论自动目标识别、变化检测、多模式数据融合和大型语言模型方面的进展，以及验证人工智能输出和维持分析师信任的挑战。对话将考虑人工智能在哪些方面发挥最大的运营价值、人类在哪些方面仍然不可或缺，以及情报组织如何适应持续的、数据驱动的监视。

paras.en: - Peter Wilczynski, chief product officer, Vantor
paras.zh: - Peter Wilczynski，Vantor 首席产品官

paras.en: - Joe O’Callaghan, director, Super Intelligence (SI) Mission, National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency
paras.zh: - Joe O’Callaghan，国家地理空间情报局超级情报 (SI) 任务主任

paras.en: - Jackie Barbieri, chief executive officer, Whitespace
paras.zh: - Jackie Barbieri，Whitespace 首席执行官

paras.en: This virtual event will take place via Zoom. You will receive a unique link to join with your registration confirmation. A recording will be posted here shortly after the event concludes.
paras.zh: 该虚拟活动将通过 Zoom 进行。您将收到一个独特的加入链接以及您的注册确认信息。活动结束后不久将在此处发布录音。

paras.en: Vantor is forging the new frontier of spatial intelligence to unlock a more autonomous, interoperable world. We give decision makers and operators the power to build a unified intelligence picture, delivering the clarity they need to navigate what’s happening now and shape what’s coming next. We fuse data from our constellation, which includes the most capable imaging satellites on orbit, with real-time sensor feeds from space, air, and ground to create an AI-ready digital twin of Earth. Our spatial intelligence platform automates every part of the cycle—from tasking to collection to production—to update and analyze this foundation at the pace of change. Our products drive deeper mission-critical insights and connect the next generation of autonomous systems across the defense, intelligence, and commercial landscape. To learn more, visit www.vantor.com
paras.zh: Vantor 正在开拓空间智能的新领域，以解锁一个更加自主、可互操作的世界。我们使决策者和操作员能够构建统一的情报图景，为他们提供所需的清晰度，以引导当前正在发生的事情并塑造接下来的情况。我们将来自我们的星座（包括在轨成像卫星）的数据与来自太空、空中和地面的实时传感器反馈相融合，创建一个支持人工智能的地球数字孪生。我们的空间智能平台可自动化周期的每个部分（从任务分配到收集再到生产），以根据变化的速度更新和分析这一基础。我们的产品推动更深入的关键任务洞察，并连接国防、情报和商业领域的下一代自主系统。要了解更多信息，请访问 www.vantor.com

articles.title: AnySignal to Deliver Space-to-Earth Communications for Three Reflect Orbital Missions
articles.author: AnySignal

paras.en: LOS ANGELES — October 20, 2026 AnySignal, a leading provider of software-defined radios and space-based networking, today announced an agreement with Reflect Orbital to deliver space-to-earth communications for Reflect Orbital’s inaugural satellite and two subsequent missions. The agreement includes the delivery of AnySignal’s USX space transceivers for flight operations and the implementation of the AnyLink software for ground connectivity. This establishes AnySignal as Reflect Orbital’s communications partner, integrating spacecraft radio hardware directly with ground network infrastructure.
paras.zh: 洛杉矶 — 2026 年 10 月 20 日 软件定义无线电和天基网络的领先提供商 AnySignal 今天宣布与 Reflect Orbital 达成协议，为 Reflect Orbital 的首颗卫星和后续的两次任务提供空对地通信。该协议包括交付用于飞行操作的 AnySignal USX 空间收发器以及实施用于地面连接的 AnyLink 软件。这使得 AnySignal 成为 Reflect Orbital 的通信合作伙伴，将航天器无线电硬件直接与地面网络基础设施集成。

paras.en: For these missions, Reflect Orbital satellites will utilize the AnySignal USX transceiver, a multi-band software-defined radio. The USX unit consolidates high-rate payload downlinks and Telemetry, Tracking, and Command (TT&C) functions within a single hardware module. This configuration removes the need for separate radios for different frequency bands, reducing mass and cabling requirements on the satellite bus. The agreement involves the implementation of AnySignal’s AnyLink software for ground operations. AnyLink functions as an interface that aggregates access to multiple ground-station-as-a-service (GSaaS) providers. The technology enables operators at Reflect to access different third-party ground networks through a single architecture.
paras.zh: 对于这些任务，Reflect Orbital 卫星将利用 AnySignal USX 收发器，这是一种多频段软件定义无线电。 USX 单元将高速有效负载下行链路以及遥测、跟踪和命令 (TT&C) 功能整合到单个硬件模块中。这种配置无需针对不同频段使用单独的无线电，从而减少了卫星总线的质量和布线要求。该协议涉及实施 AnySignal 的 AnyLink 软件以进行地面操作。 AnyLink 充当聚合对多个地面站即服务 (GSaaS) 提供商的访问的接口。该技术使 Reflect 的运营商能够通过单一架构访问不同的第三方地面网络。

paras.en: “AnySignal is excited to provide Reflect with full-stack communications for their upcoming missions,” said CEO and Co-Founder John Malsbury. “This agreement reflects the power of AnySignal’s operating system for the electromagnetic spectrum. The AnySignal operating system, including radio hardware and ground networking, solves technical RF problems so that innovative customers like Reflect Orbital can focus on their groundbreaking missions.”
paras.zh: “AnySignal 很高兴能够为 Reflect 即将到来的任务提供全栈通信，”首席执行官兼联合创始人 John Malsbury 说道。 “该协议体现了 AnySignal 操作系统在电磁频谱方面的强大功能。AnySignal 操作系统（包括无线电硬件和地面网络）解决了射频技术问题，使像 Reflect Orbital 这样的创新客户能够专注于他们的开创性任务。”

paras.en: “We selected AnySignal for both our flight radio and ground connectivity software because it delivers a true end-to-end comms solution,” said Ben Nowack, Co-Founder and CEO, Reflect Orbital. “AnySignal has helped us de-risk early operations and let us focus on engineering the novel parts of our spacecraft.”
paras.zh: Reflect Orbital 联合创始人兼首席执行官 Ben Nowack 表示：“我们选择 AnySignal 作为我们的飞行无线电和地面连接软件，因为它提供了真正的端到端通信解决方案。” “AnySignal 帮助我们降低了早期运营的风险，让我们专注于设计航天器的新颖部件。”

paras.en: AnySignal is a U.S.-based aerospace and defense technology company building the operating system for the electromagnetic spectrum. The company designs, builds, integrates, and operates end-to-end radio-frequency (RF) systems for civil, commercial, and national security customers to sense, connect, and defend across land, air, sea, and space—providing the adaptable spectrum capabilities their missions depend on. For more information, visit: anysignal.com
paras.zh: AnySignal 是一家总部位于美国的航空航天和国防技术公司，致力于构建电磁频谱操作系统。该公司为民用、商业和国家安全客户设计、构建、集成和运营端到端射频 (RF) 系统，以跨陆地、空中、海上和太空进行感知、连接和防御，从而提供他们的任务所依赖的适应性频谱功能。欲了解更多信息，请访问：anysignal.com

paras.en: Reflect Orbital is developing space-enabled infrastructure to deliver sunlight to precise locations on Earth. By redirecting sunlight from orbit, we aim to extend electricity generation at solar farms and provide light to help search-and-rescue teams find people at night and construction crews work more safely after dark. We believe reliable access to affordable energy is the foundation of human progress, a healthier planet and economic growth. Our mission is to unlock more of the sun’s potential and deliver energy abundance to a world that urgently needs it. For more information, visit: https://www.reflectorbital.com/
paras.zh: Reflect Orbital 正在开发太空基础设施，将阳光传送到地球上的精确位置。通过重新定向轨道上的阳光，我们的目标是扩大太阳能发电厂的发电量，并提供照明以帮助搜救队在夜间找到人员，并帮助施工人员在天黑后更安全地工作。我们相信可靠地获得负担得起的能源是人类进步、更健康的地球和经济增长的基础。我们的使命是释放更多太阳能潜力，为急需能源的世界提供丰富的能源。欲了解更多信息，请访问：https://www.reflectorbital.com/

paras.en: Reflect Orbital: press@reflectorbital.com
paras.zh: 反射轨道：press@reflectorbital.com

articles.title: Nepal’s deadly glacier flood a ‘defining moment’ for the international community

paras.en: Nepal’s deadly glacier flood a ‘defining moment’ for the international community
paras.zh: 尼泊尔致命的冰川洪水对国际社会来说是一个“决定性时刻”

paras.en: The deadly flash flood that tore through Nepal in August is a “defining moment” for both the country and the international community, according to the head of the UN field agency which builds roads, schools and clinics in crisis zones.
paras.zh: 在危机地区修建道路、学校和诊所的联合国实地机构负责人表示，八月份席卷尼泊尔的致命山洪对于该国和国际社会来说都是一个“决定性时刻”。

paras.en: UN Project Services chief, Jorge Moreira da Silva, briefed journalists in New York by videolink after joining teams from UNOPS in Nepal, describing the glacier collapse on 26 August as one of the most destructive and deadliest climate disasters ever.
paras.zh: 联合国项目服务主管豪尔赫·莫雷拉·达席尔瓦 (Jorge Moreira da Silva) 在加入联合国项目事务署驻尼泊尔团队后，在纽约通过视频连线向记者通报了情况，他将 8 月 26 日的冰川崩塌描述为有史以来最具破坏性和最致命的气候灾难之一。

paras.en: Survivors told him of a wall of water more than 100 metres high, travelling at 180 kilometres per hour, which devastated 60 kilometres of valley in a matter of seconds.
paras.zh: 幸存者告诉他，一道100多米高的水墙以每小时180公里的速度行进，几秒钟内就摧毁了60公里的山谷。

paras.en: “We are not dealing with a normal flood,” he said.
paras.zh: “我们面对的不是一场普通的洪水，”他说。

paras.en: More than 1,500 people lost their lives and 5,600 remain missing. Some 100,000 people have been affected, including more than 30,000 children.
paras.zh: 超过 1,500 人丧生，5,600 人失踪。约10万人受到影响，其中包括3万多名儿童。

paras.en: More than 100 bridges collapsed, while 13 hydropower dams and 23 schools were destroyed. Some 2.2 million tonnes of debris and sediment now cover what used to be homes, schools, roads and rivers.
paras.zh: 100多座桥梁倒塌，13座水坝和23所学校被毁。大约 220 万吨碎片和沉积物现在覆盖了曾经的房屋、学校、道路和河流。

paras.en: With so many bridges gone, a journey that once took a few minutes on foot can now take 12 hours, he said. Yet displaced communities had expressed resilience and a determination to return home.
paras.zh: 他说，由于许多桥梁被毁，以前步行几分钟的路程现在可能需要 12 个小时。然而，流离失所的社区表现出了韧性和返回家园的决心。

paras.en: Recovery needs are estimated at $4.8 billion, equivalent to 10 per cent of Nepal’s gross domestic product (GDP). In US-terms, that would represent over $3 trillion.
paras.zh: 恢复需求估计为 48 亿美元，相当于尼泊尔国内生产总值 (GDP) 的 10%。以美国计算，这将超过 3 万亿美元。

paras.en: A flash appeal for $50 million in immediate support has so far raised only $24.5 million.
paras.zh: 紧急呼吁立即提供 5000 万美元支持，但迄今为止仅筹集到 2450 万美元。

paras.en: “There is a good perception from the international community about the need to provide support, but perception is not enough. We need a strong commitment,” Mr. Moreira da Silva said, adding that Nepal is planning a pledging conference.
paras.zh: 莫雷拉·达席尔瓦先生表示：“国际社会对提供支持的必要性有良好的认识，但光有这种认识还不够。我们需要坚定的承诺。”他补充说，尼泊尔正在计划召开认捐会议。

paras.en: He called the disaster one of the most tangible expressions of climate injustice.
paras.zh: 他称这场灾难是气候不公正最明显的表现之一。

paras.en: Nepal, a least developed country, emits just 0.08 per cent of global greenhouse gas emissions, yet is disproportionately affected by climate change.
paras.zh: 尼泊尔是一个最不发达国家，其温室气体排放量仅占全球的0.08%，但却受到气候变化的严重影响。

paras.en: It is not fair, he said, to ask Nepal to bear the cost of recovering from a climate crisis for which it bears no responsibility.
paras.zh: 他说，要求尼泊尔承担从气候危机中恢复的成本是不公平的，而尼泊尔对此不承担任何责任。

paras.en: The government is finalising a post-disaster needs assessment and preparing a recovery plan, with support from the UN and multilateral development banks.
paras.zh: 在联合国和多边开发银行的支持下，政府正在完成灾后需求评估并制定恢复计划。

paras.en: Building back better will require investment in early warning systems, climate-resilient infrastructure and planning, Mr. Moreira da Silva said.
paras.zh: 莫雷拉·达席尔瓦先生表示，更好的重建需要对预警系统、气候适应型基础设施和规划进行投资。

paras.en: He also urged developed countries to honour their commitment to provide $1.3 trillion a year in climate finance to developing countries by 2035, and called on all nations to cut emissions to keep the 1.5°C target within reach.
paras.zh: 他还敦促发达国家兑现到2035年每年向发展中国家提供1.3万亿美元气候融资的承诺，并呼吁所有国家减少排放，以实现1.5℃的目标。

articles.title: First human case of Shamonda virus reported in France as patient dies

paras.en: First human case of Shamonda virus reported in France as patient dies
paras.zh: 法国报告首例沙蒙达病毒人类病例，患者死亡

paras.en: The virus is mainly found in livestock, especially cattle, sheep, goats, horses and alpacas.
paras.zh: 该病毒主要存在于牲畜中，特别是牛、绵羊、山羊、马和羊驼。

paras.en: It is thought to be spread by the bites of midges – tiny biting flies – though the World Health Organization (WHO) has said further studies are needed to understand how it is transmitted.
paras.zh: 据认为，这种病毒是通过蠓（一种微小的叮咬苍蝇）的叮咬传播的，尽管世界卫生组织（WHO）表示，还需要进一步研究来了解它的传播方式。

paras.en: There are currently no commercially available vaccines against Shamonda virus, according to the internationally recognised World Organisation for Animal Health (WOAH).
paras.zh: 根据国际公认的世界动物卫生组织（WOAH）的说法，目前还没有针对沙蒙达病毒的市售疫苗。

paras.en: The unidentified patient, who died in early October, had been receiving treatment for a serious illness and was immunocompromised, making him more vulnerable to infection than the general public, according to a statement from the French health and agriculture ministries.
paras.zh: 法国卫生部和农业部的一份声明称，这名身份不明的患者于10月初死亡，他一直在接受严重疾病的治疗，并且免疫功能低下，使他比普通公众更容易受到感染。

paras.en: French authorities say that no health risk to the general public has been identified so far.
paras.zh: 法国当局表示，到目前为止，尚未发现公众健康面临风险。

paras.en: He had been in an area where the virus was circulating among animals and where Culicoides midges were present, WHO said.
paras.zh: 世界卫生组织表示，他曾去过病毒在动物之间传播且库蠓出没的地区。

paras.en: The UN health agency’s Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus expressed his condolences to the man’s loved ones.
paras.zh: 联合国卫生机构总干事谭德塞向该男子的亲人表示哀悼。

paras.en: He said WHO was working with French authorities to establish how the patient became infected, possible routes of transmission and any potential risk to public health.
paras.zh: 他说，世卫组织正在与法国当局合作，以确定患者是如何感染的、可能的传播途径以及对公共卫生的任何潜在风险。

articles.title: World News in Brief: Russian attacks intensify, UN team tours West Bank, ‘unlawful’ elderly deaths

paras.en: World News in Brief: Russian attacks intensify, UN team tours West Bank, ‘unlawful’ elderly deaths
paras.zh: 世界新闻简讯：俄罗斯袭击加剧、联合国小组视察西岸、“非法”老年人死亡

paras.en: Long-range Russian attacks across Ukraine are intensifying, including in Kyiv, causing at least 14 civilian deaths and 78 injuries overnight into Thursday, as UN agencies continue to provide aid.
paras.zh: 随着联合国机构继续提供援助，俄罗斯在乌克兰各地（包括基辅）的远程袭击正在加剧，截至周四夜间，已造成至少 14 名平民死亡和 78 人受伤。

paras.en: Seven children were wounded in the strikes, which further damaged health and energy facilities, according to Ukrainian authorities and reports from Russian-occupied areas.
paras.zh: 据乌克兰当局和俄罗斯占领地区的报道，袭击造成七名儿童受伤，卫生和能源设施进一步受损。

paras.en: In Russian-occupied areas, reports also indicate that two civilians were killed and nine were injured in the Donetsk region.
paras.zh: 在俄罗斯占领区，有报道还显示，顿涅茨克地区有两名平民被杀，九人受伤。

paras.en: Overnight attacks damaged energy infrastructure in Poltavska, Rivnenska and Volynska oblasts, disrupting the power supply, according to Ukrainian authorities.
paras.zh: 乌克兰当局表示，夜间袭击破坏了波尔塔夫斯卡州、里夫嫩斯卡州和沃林斯卡州的能源基础设施，导致电力供应中断。

paras.en: Hostilities also caused power cuts in six frontline areas, while emergency power outages were also reported in Kyiv.
paras.zh: 敌对行动还导致六个前线地区停电，基辅也报告出现紧急停电。

paras.en: Scrambling to reach frontline communities
paras.zh: 争先恐后地接触前线社区

paras.en: UN agencies continue to support communities in frontline areas of Ukraine, where reaching them is complicated or dangerous.
paras.zh: 联合国机构继续支持乌克兰前线地区的社区，在那里接触这些社区既复杂又危险。

paras.en: A UN Department of Safety and Security team delivered relief supplies on Wednesday to a community close to the contact line in the Zaporizhzhia region, where they described access as “severely constrained”.
paras.zh: 联合国安全和安保部的一个小组周三向扎波罗热地区接触线附近的一个社区运送了救援物资，他们称那里的救援物资“严重受限”。

paras.en: Helping with winterisation efforts, the UN Children’s Fund (UNICEF) reported this week that it has supported nearly 70,000 families living on the frontline with cash assistance, delivered in partnership with Ukrainian authorities.
paras.zh: 为帮助过冬工作，联合国儿童基金会 (UNICEF) 本周报告称，它已与乌克兰当局合作提供现金援助，为近 70,000 个生活在前线的家庭提供支持。

paras.en: Acting UN Humanitarian Coordinator for the Occupied Palestinian Territory Ramiz Alakbarov and 13 UN Member State representatives have visited Jenin in the West Bank to learn about challenges surrounding the ongoing Palestinian olive harvest, displacement and recurrent Israeli settler attacks, UN Spokesperson Stéphane Dujarric said on Thursday.
paras.zh: 联合国发言人斯特凡·杜雅里克 (Stéphane Dujarric) 周四表示，联合国巴勒斯坦被占领土代理人道主义协调员拉米兹·阿拉克巴罗夫 (Ramiz Alakbarov) 和 13 名联合国会员国代表访问了西岸的杰宁，了解巴勒斯坦橄榄收获、流离失所和以色列定居者一再袭击等挑战。

paras.en: In the village of Arraba, the group heard from farmers who have been subjected to recurrent settler attacks while attempting to bring in the olive harvest – which combined with Israeli access restrictions, is undermining food security.
paras.zh: 在阿拉巴村，该组织听取了农民的说法，他们在试图收获橄榄时经常遭受定居者的袭击，再加上以色列的准入限制，正在破坏粮食安全。

paras.en: “Our humanitarian partners briefed the delegation on efforts to protect olive pickers, including by accompanying them to the groves and providing legal aid to challenge Israeli-imposed access restrictions,” Mr. Dujarric said.
paras.zh: “我们的人道主义合作伙伴向代表团介绍了保护橄榄采摘者的努力，包括陪同他们前往果园并提供法律援助以挑战以色列施加的准入限制，”杜贾里克先生说。

paras.en: Up to 100,000 Palestinian households depend on olives for their livelihoods, but many Palestinians are being prevented from gathering their crops safely, Dr. Alakbarov said, emphasising that crimes committed against them must stop and the perpetrators must be held to account by the Israeli authorities.
paras.zh: 阿拉克巴罗夫博士说，多达10万个巴勒斯坦家庭依靠橄榄为生，但许多巴勒斯坦人无法安全地收割庄稼，他强调以色列当局必须停止针对他们的犯罪行为，肇事者必须承担责任。

paras.en: At a UN clinic in the city of Qabatiya, the diplomats met with Palestinians who, since early 2025, have been prevented by the Israeli authorities from returning to Jenin refugee camp, where many of their homes have been destroyed.
paras.zh: 在卡巴蒂亚市的联合国诊所，外交官们会见了巴勒斯坦人，自 2025 年初以来，以色列当局阻止他们返回杰宁难民营，那里的许多房屋已被摧毁。

paras.en: The UN agency for Palestine refugees (UNRWA) briefed the group on support being provided to those families, from food and shelter to other essential services.
paras.zh: 联合国巴勒斯坦难民机构（近东救济工程处）向工作组介绍了向这些家庭提供的支持，包括食物、住所和其他基本服务。

paras.en: Dr. Alakbarov stressed that more funding is needed and urged the Israeli authorities to enable Palestinians’ safe and dignified return.
paras.zh: 阿拉克巴罗夫博士强调，需要更多资金，并敦促以色列当局确保巴勒斯坦人安全、有尊严地返回。

paras.en: Unlawful deaths of the elderly: Overlooked and under-reported
paras.zh: 老年人非法死亡：被忽视和报告不足

paras.en: Suspicious deaths of elderly people are under-reported, under-investigated and under-researched worldwide, an independent human rights expert said on Thursday, in a call to boost investigations and prevention work.
paras.zh: 周四，一位独立人权专家呼吁加强调查和预防工作，他表示，全世界范围内老年人的可疑死亡事件均未得到充分报告、调查和研究。

paras.en: Morris Tidball-Binz, who reports to the UN Human Rights Council on extrajudicial, summary or arbitrary executions, said that ageism and other discrimination “too often lead to abuse, neglect and other causes of unlawful deaths being overlooked”.
paras.zh: 向联合国人权理事会报告法外处决、即审即决或任意处决问题的莫里斯·蒂德博尔-宾兹表示，年龄歧视和其他歧视“常常导致虐待、忽视和其他导致非法死亡的原因被忽视”。

paras.en: The Special Rapporteur maintained that “harmful age-based stereotypes depicting older persons as inevitably frail, sick and near death can normalise and depersonalise their deaths”.
paras.zh: 特别报告员坚持认为，“基于年龄的有害陈规定型观念将老年人描绘成不可避免的虚弱、患病和濒临死亡的人，这可能会使他们的死亡正常化并失去个性化”。

paras.en: This can mean that criminal or preventable deaths are falsely reported as the result of ageing.
paras.zh: 这可能意味着刑事或可预防的死亡被错误地报告为老龄化的结果。

paras.en: Sepsis can cause a natural death, but it may be the result of long-lasting abuse and neglect, Mr. Tidball-Binz noted.
paras.zh: 蒂德博尔-宾兹先生指出，败血症可能导致自然死亡，但这可能是长期虐待和忽视的结果。

paras.en: In his report to the Human Rights Council, the Special Rapporteur detailed practical measures that improve respect for and protection of older persons’ right to life; these include strengthening investigative processes, data collection, institutional oversight and prevention.
paras.zh: 特别报告员在提交人权理事会的报告中详细介绍了加强尊重和保护老年人生命权的实际措施；其中包括加强调查程序、数据收集、机构监督和预防。

paras.en: “Professionals must be trained and equipped to recognise, respond to and document age-related vulnerabilities and signs of abuse,” said the Human Rights Council-appointed independent expert, who is not UN staff member and does not receive a salary for his work.
paras.zh: 这位人权理事会任命的独立专家表示：“专业人员必须接受培训并具备能力，能够识别、应对和记录与年龄相关的脆弱性和虐待迹象。”他不是联合国工作人员，也没有领取薪水。

articles.title: Norris: 'Incredible' Antonelli two levels above Russell all season

paras.en: Kimi Antonelli: Lando Norris, Lewis Hamilton praise Mercedes driver ahead of first F1 2026 title win chance at United States GP
paras.zh: 基米·安东内利：兰多·诺里斯、刘易斯·汉密尔顿在美国大奖赛上赢得 2026 年 F1 首个冠军机会之前赞扬梅赛德斯车手

paras.en: Reigning world champion Lando Norris says "incredible" champion-in-waiting Kimi Antonelli has performed "two levels above" George Russell all season; watch every United States GP session live on Sky Sports F1, starting with first practice at 6pm on Friday evening
paras.zh: 卫冕世界冠军兰多·诺里斯表示，“令人难以置信”的候补冠军基米·安东内利整个赛季的表现比乔治·拉塞尔“高出两个水平”；从周五晚上 6 点的第一次练习开始，在天空体育 F1 上观看每场美国大奖赛的直播

paras.en: Lando Norris believes Kimi Antonelli has done an "incredible job" and performed "two levels above" Mercedes team-mate George Russell this season, in form which has taken the Italian to the brink of a record-breaking world championship triumph.
paras.zh: 兰多·诺里斯相信基米·安东内利本赛季做了“令人难以置信的工作”，并且表现比梅赛德斯队友乔治·拉塞尔“高出两个水平”，这种状态使意大利人接近破纪录的世界冠军胜利。

paras.en: Antonelli looks all but assured to succeed Norris as F1's reigning world champion this year thanks to the 102-point lead he holds at the top of the standings with six races left.
paras.zh: 安东内利看起来几乎肯定会接替诺里斯成为今年的 F1 卫冕世界冠军，这要归功于他在还剩六场比赛时以 102 分的领先优势位居积分榜榜首。

paras.en: The 20-year-old could become the sport's youngest-ever champion as early as this Sunday's United States Grand Prix if he wins the race and nearest challengers Russell and Lewis Hamilton do not score sufficient points to stay in mathematical contention.
paras.zh: 如果这名 20 岁的选手赢得比赛，那么他最早可能在本周日的美国大奖赛上成为这项运动有史以来最年轻的冠军，而最接近的挑战者拉塞尔和刘易斯·汉密尔顿没有获得足够的积分来留在数学竞争中。

paras.en: And Norris, who claimed his own maiden crown with McLaren last year, has spoken glowingly about Antonelli's second season of F1 up against the "very good" Russell.
paras.zh: 诺里斯去年在迈凯伦赢得了自己的首个冠军，他热情洋溢地谈到安东内利在 F1 的第二个赛季对阵“非常出色”的拉塞尔。

paras.en: "I think it's very impressive what he's been able to do," said Norris.
paras.zh: “我认为他所做的事情非常令人印象深刻，”诺里斯说。

paras.en: "At his age, his second year in Formula 1, he's going to be the youngest world champion ever. It's pretty incredible, especially because, I wouldn't say he had a bad first season in Formula 1, he was against George, who I think is very good and has performed very well, especially in the last year [at Mercedes in 2024] against Lewis.
paras.zh: “在他这个年龄，在一级方程式赛车的第二年，他将成为有史以来最年轻的世界冠军。这非常令人难以置信，特别是因为，我不会说他在一级方程式赛车的第一个赛季表现得很糟糕，他对阵的是乔治，我认为乔治非常出色，表现也非常好，特别是在去年（2024年在梅赛德斯）对阵刘易斯的比赛中。

paras.en: "For him to take quite a huge step from last year to this year, in terms of optimising things and understanding how to drive this year's car, more than other people as well.
paras.zh: “从去年到今年，他在优化事物和了解如何驾驶今年的汽车方面迈出了相当大的一步，比其他人也更多。

paras.en: "Dealing with the pressure, the lack of mistakes that have come from him, in both qualifying and races, the consistency to beat his team-mate.
paras.zh: “他应对压力，在排位赛和正赛中都没有犯错，并且始终如一地击败队友。

paras.en: "I rate George and I think he's a very good driver, but Kimi has been two levels above George the whole season. He's done a pretty incredible job and I'm sure the world knows that. I don't need to say it, I think it's obvious enough."
paras.zh: “我评价乔治，我认为他是一个非常好的车手，但基米整个赛季都比乔治高出两个级别。他做得非常令人难以置信，我相信全世界都知道这一点。我不需要说，我认为这已经足够明显了。”

paras.en: Mercedes made the then-18-year-old Antonelli the sport's third-youngest driver in history when they promoted him to the seat vacated by the Ferrari-bound Hamilton, F1's most successful-ever driver, from the 2025 season.
paras.zh: 梅赛德斯将当时 18 岁的安东内利提升到了 2025 赛季以来 F1 有史以来最成功的车手、法拉利车队的汉密尔顿空出的位置，从而使他成为了这项运动历史上第三年轻的车手。

paras.en: Asked in Austin on Thursday if he had any advice for Antonelli as his successor closes on the title, seven-time champion Hamilton quipped: "Slow down!
paras.zh: 周四在奥斯汀，当安东内利的继任者即将夺冠时，当被问及他是否有什么建议时，七届冠军汉密尔顿打趣道：“慢点！

paras.en: "No, I don't know. He doesn't need any advice. I think he's shown this year, and also last year, but particularly this year, his talent and his ability, his calmness and his approach.
paras.zh: “不，我不知道。他不需要任何建议。我认为他今年和去年都展示了他的天赋和能力，他的冷静和他的方法。

paras.en: "He's done an amazing job this year, and I'm so proud of him. I'm so proud of the way he's carried himself, how he interacts with the drivers and even with you guys.
paras.zh: “他今年做得非常出色，我为他感到骄傲。我为他的举止方式、他与车手甚至与你们的互动方式感到非常自豪。

paras.en: "It's great to see him and the team excel. If it's not my team, I'd always want to see my old team do well."
paras.zh: “很高兴看到他和球队表现出色。如果不是我的球队，我总是希望看到我的老球队表现出色。”

paras.en: 'Crazy if you think about it' - but Antonelli not thinking about title win yet
paras.zh: “如果你想一想就很疯狂”——但安东内利还没有考虑夺冠

paras.en: Although it has become a question in recent races of when and not if Antonelli will win this year's championship, the mathematics required for him to do so as early as Sunday evening in Austin are not in his own hands.
paras.zh: 尽管在最近的比赛中，安东内利何时以及是否会赢得今年的冠军已经成为一个问题，但他最早在周日晚上在奥斯汀赢得冠军所需的数学并不掌握在他自己手中。

paras.en: Antonelli would clinch the title if he claims his ninth race victory of the season and Russell finishes ninth or lower and Hamilton fifth or lower. That exact three-way result has not happened once in a race so far this season.
paras.zh: 如果安东内利获得本赛季的第九场比赛胜利，并且拉塞尔获得第九名或更低，汉密尔顿获得第五名或更低，他将获得冠军。本赛季迄今为止，在一场比赛中还没有出现过这样的三人结果。

paras.en: "I mean, it definitely is crazy if you think about it, but that's why I won't think about it," said Antonelli.
paras.zh: “我的意思是，如果你考虑一下，这绝对是疯狂的，但这就是我不会考虑它的原因，”安东内利说。

paras.en: "I've heard that something catastrophic needs to happen to the others for me to become champion. For me, it needs to be a perfect weekend. The others need to have a poor result, which is unlikely to happen.
paras.zh: “我听说其他人需要发生一些灾难性的事情才能让我成为冠军。对我来说，这需要是一个完美的周末。其他人需要有一个糟糕的结果，这是不太可能发生的。

paras.en: "So, of course, anything can happen, and it's crazy to think about it. But, as I said, we had a meeting with Bono [Peter Bonnington, Antonelli's race engineer] this morning, and we just said, 'Just have fun.' It's always the same mindset I've had all year: one race at a time. Just try to do the best I can every race weekend, and then we'll see.
paras.zh: “所以，当然，任何事情都有可能发生，想想就很疯狂。但是，正如我所说，今天早上我们与波诺（安东内利的赛车工程师彼得·博宁顿）会面，我们只是说，‘玩得开心。’我一整年的心态都是一样的：一次一场比赛。只要在每个比赛周末尽我所能，然后我们就会看到。

paras.en: "But, of course, if I do things well, then the result will come."
paras.zh: “但是，当然，如果我把事情做好，那么结果就会到来。”

paras.en: The Italian is aware of the significance of what almost-certainly awaits him at some point in the forthcoming weeks, but is focused on making it a reality first.
paras.zh: 意大利人意识到在未来几周的某个时刻几乎肯定会发生的事情的重要性，但他首先致力于将其变为现实。

paras.en: "I mean, it would be a dream. It's something I've dreamt of since I was little," he added.
paras.zh: “我的意思是，这将是一个梦想。这是我从小就梦想的事情，”他补充道。

paras.en: "First of all, to find myself in such a position is incredible. But at the same time, I need to keep going, keep pushing, and it's not over yet.
paras.zh: “首先，发现自己处于这样的位置真是令人难以置信。但与此同时，我需要继续前进，继续推动，而且这还没有结束。

paras.en: "So first, we'll try to finish the job properly, and then we can enjoy the rest. But, for sure, it would be an incredible achievement, but there's still a bit to go."
paras.zh: “所以首先，我们会努力妥善完成工作，然后我们就可以享受剩下的事情了。但是，可以肯定的是，这将是一项令人难以置信的成就，但还有一段路要走。”

articles.title: Verstappen criticises 'unacceptable' COTA surface amid concerns over injury

paras.en: Max Verstappen: Red Bull driver hits out at 'unacceptable' bumpy United States GP surface at COTA amid safety concerns
paras.zh: 马克斯·维斯塔潘：出于安全考虑，红牛车手在COTA美国大奖赛崎岖不平的路面上进行了猛烈抨击

paras.en: Max Verstappen has criticised the bumpy surface at Circuit of The Americas ahead of this weekend's race in Austin, Texas; watch every United States GP session live on Sky Sports F1, starting with first practice at 6pm on Friday evening
paras.zh: 在本周末于德克萨斯州奥斯汀举行的比赛之前，马克斯·维斯塔潘批评了美洲赛道崎岖不平的路面；从周五晚上 6 点的第一次练习开始，在天空体育 F1 上观看每场美国大奖赛的直播

paras.en: Max Verstappen revealed concerns over the state of his spine as he unleashed a scathing criticism of the "out of control" bumpy track surface at Circuit of The Americas.
paras.zh: 马克斯·维斯塔潘在对美洲赛道“失控”的崎岖赛道表面提出严厉批评时，透露了对自己脊柱状况的担忧。

paras.en: The four-time world champion arrives in Austin for Sunday's United States Grand Prix after claiming his first two victories of the season in back-to-back races.
paras.zh: 这位四届世界冠军在连续两场比赛中获得本赛季的前两场胜利后，抵达奥斯汀参加周日举行的美国大奖赛。

paras.en: Speaking to the media on Thursday, Verstappen was unexpectedly passionate over the state of the circuit, which is generally considered as one of the most popular among the drivers on the F1 calendar.
paras.zh: 周四在接受媒体采访时，维斯塔潘对赛道状况出人意料地充满热情，这条赛道通常被认为是 F1 赛历上最受车手欢迎的赛道之一。

paras.en: "You see also the track state from what I saw in WEC (World Endurance Championship), it was extremely badly bumpy," Verstappen said.
paras.zh: “你也可以从我在 WEC（世界耐力锦标赛）中看到的赛道状况来看，赛道非常颠簸，”维斯塔潘说道。

paras.en: "I'm not really looking forward to that to be honest, for your spine. I was joking about that in the last race but it's not really a joke to be honest because we mentioned this already for years that it's actually getting a bit out of control.
paras.zh: “说实话，为了你的脊椎，我并不是真的期待这一点。我在上一场比赛中开玩笑说，但说实话，这并不是一个真正的笑话，因为我们已经提到这一点很多年了，它实际上已经有点失控了。

paras.en: "I'm sure it's going to be quite tough to find the right compromises around this track in places where it's just extremely bumpy. I don't know how our car is going to respond to that."
paras.zh: “我确信，在这条赛道上，在极其颠簸的地方，要找到正确的妥协方案将会非常困难。我不知道我们的赛车将如何应对。”

paras.en: The Red Bull driver appeared to be urging the event organisers to place greater emphasis on improving the surface for the event in future.
paras.zh: 这位红牛车手似乎敦促赛事组织者更加重视未来赛事的路面改善。

paras.en: "Of course, you can use the excuse that the soil is the problem, but then you should have known that you need to make sure that you reinforce it more," Verstappen continued.
paras.zh: “当然，你可以借口土壤是问题所在，但你应该知道你需要确保对它进行更多加固，”维斯塔潘继续说道。

paras.en: "I love this track. I love this place. It's one of the best layouts ever and it's one of the venues, best cities to be at. But for me, the bumps that we have are unacceptable.
paras.zh: “我喜欢这条赛道。我喜欢这个地方。它是有史以来最好的布局之一，也是场地之一，也是最好的城市之一。但对我来说，我们遇到的颠簸是不可接受的。

paras.en: "Over time, they've been grinding a little bit here and there, but it's just putting a plaster on the big problem - that's just what's coming underneath.
paras.zh: “随着时间的推移，他们一直在这里和那里进行一些磨练，但这只是在大问题上贴上膏药——这就是下面的问题。

paras.en: "That's what you need to actually tackle in the first place. Of course, it means you need to really fully open up the track. That costs a lot of money and time, but honestly, that's the only way to get rid of it because these bumps are not natural and they are out of control."
paras.zh: “这就是你首先需要真正解决的问题。当然，这意味着你需要真正完全开放赛道。这需要花费大量金钱和时间，但老实说，这是摆脱它的唯一方法，因为这些颠簸不是自然的，而且它们是失控的。”

paras.en: Verstappen then explained that medical checks had shown that "the bottom end" of his spine "doesn't look that great".
paras.zh: 维斯塔潘随后解释说，体检显示他的脊柱“底部”“看起来不太好”。

paras.en: The 29-year-old said: "That I think sometimes people don't really understand that because I can tell you from the checks that I've done from my spine, the bottom end doesn't look that great, the spine.
paras.zh: 这位 29 岁的年轻人说：“我认为有时人们并不真正理解这一点，因为我可以从我对脊柱所做的检查中告诉你，脊柱的底端看起来不太好。

paras.en: "I know that's part of racing. I know that can be part of sport, but it's of course also further damage from the cars that we had the last few years.
paras.zh: “我知道这是赛车的一部分。我知道这也可以是运动的一部分，但这当然也是我们过去几年拥有的汽车造成的进一步损坏。

paras.en: "Now, if we continue with finding this acceptable to drive on, then, you are going to suffer with that much more."
paras.zh: “现在，如果我们继续认为这种情况可以继续行驶，那么，你将会遭受更多的痛苦。”

paras.en: Reigning world champion Lando Norris revealed that he takes headache tablets before driving at certain tracks due to their bumpiness.
paras.zh: 卫冕世界冠军兰多·诺里斯透露，由于某些赛道崎岖不平，他在开车前会服用头痛药。

paras.en: Norris also explained that if COTA was a brand-new circuit, it wouldn't meet the requirements to be added to the calendar.
paras.zh: 诺里斯还解释说，如果COTA是一条全新的赛道，它就达不到加入赛历的要求。

paras.en: "If you build a new track now, the rules, the regulation of building a new track, the tolerances you have to be within are pretty small," Norris said.
paras.zh: “如果你现在建造一条新赛道，建造新赛道的规则、规定、你必须遵守的公差都非常小，”诺里斯说。

paras.en: "It certainly doesn't fit anywhere close to what those regulations are now, but it's an old track, not a new track.
paras.zh: “它当然与现在的规定不符，但它是一条旧赛道，而不是一条新赛道。

paras.en: "It's pretty bad. There's a lot of places… I need to take headache tablets before I go out simply because it's so bumpy and you're hitting your head pretty hard against the headrests and things because of the bumps. It's certainly not a nice thing.
paras.zh: “这很糟糕。有很多地方……我出去之前需要服用头痛药，因为这里太颠簸了，而且由于颠簸，你的头会非常用力地撞到头枕和其他东西上。这当然不是一件好事。

paras.en: "There's not much we can do. We complain about it. It's something we've brought up many, many times, but there's only so much we can complain about things."
paras.zh: “我们无能为力。我们抱怨它。我们已经多次提出这个问题，但我们能抱怨的就这么多了。”

paras.en: Mercedes driver George Russell said the bumpy nature of the circuit is "just part of racing," but expressed concern over the general standard of surfaces throughout the year.
paras.zh: 梅赛德斯车手乔治·拉塞尔表示，赛道的颠簸本质“只是赛车的一部分”，但对全年路面的总体标准表示担忧。

paras.en: "It's bumpy, but I think it's just part of racing," Russell said.
paras.zh: “这很坎坷，但我认为这只是赛车的一部分，”拉塞尔说。

paras.en: "I'd say my general view is F1 tracks probably need to be repaved every couple of years just to make it a bit more consistent because we're going to tracks now where tarmac's coming up, it's falling apart, it's causing more issues than not.
paras.zh: “我想说的是，我的总体观点是，F1 赛道可能需要每隔几年重新铺设一次，只是为了使其更加一致，因为我们现在要追踪跑道上出现的停机坪、崩塌的地方，以及引发更多问题的地方。

paras.en: "We're not an IndyCar or an F2 car that run their ride heights, reasonably high. Our ride heights are 10mm at the end of the straight, a centimetre from the ground, so any time you bump you really feel it.
paras.zh: “我们不是 IndyCar 或 F2 赛车，它们的行驶高度相当高。我们的行驶高度在直道末端为 10 毫米，距地面 1 厘米，所以每次碰撞时您都会真正感觉到。

paras.en: "The side profile of the tyres now since we've been at the 18-inch is substantially smaller.
paras.zh: “自从我们使用 18 英寸轮胎以来，轮胎的侧面轮廓明显变小了。

paras.en: "The circumference of the tyre is the same. The circumference of the rim is far greater, so you've lost all of that effective suspension in the tyre, which was a damper, which we kind of don't have anymore. Not ideal, but not much we can do."
paras.zh: “轮胎的周长是相同的。轮圈的周长要大得多，所以你失去了轮胎中所有有效的悬架，这是一个阻尼器，我们已经没有了。不理想，但我们能做的不多。”
