articles.title: Arizona's Otherworldly 'Wonderland of Rocks' Is Now America's Newest National Park

paras.en: America’s newest national park protects thousands of years of human history, nearly 200 species of birds and towering stone spires formed by an ancient volcanic eruption.
paras.zh: 美国最新的国家公园保护着数千年的人类历史、近 200 种鸟类和由古代火山喷发形成的高耸石塔。

paras.en: Chiricahua National Monument in southeastern Arizona is now Chiricahua National Park, bringing the total number of national parks in the United States to 64. Nicknamed the “Wonderland of Rocks,” the site has been a national monument since 1924 but was officially redesignated as a national park this week.
paras.zh: 位于亚利桑那州东南部的奇里卡瓦国家纪念碑 (Chiricahua National Monument) 现为奇里卡瓦国家公园 (Chiricahua National Park)，使美国国家公园总数达到 64 个。该遗址绰号“岩石仙境”，自 1924 年以来一直是国家纪念碑，但本周被正式重新指定为国家公园。

paras.en: Chiricahua—pronounced “cheery-cow-uh”—is the country’s first new national park in six years, following the establishment of West Virginia’s New River Gorge National Park and Preserve in 2020.
paras.zh: Chiricahua（发音为“cheery-cow-uh”）是继 2020 年西弗吉尼亚州新河峡谷国家公园和保护区建立后，该国六年来第一个新的国家公园。

paras.en: The 12,000-acre park protects part of the Chiricahua Mountains, one of several “sky islands,” or isolated mountain ranges that rise up from the surrounding deserts of southeastern Arizona and northern Mexico. Located about 120 miles from Tucson, it sits at the intersection of four major ecosystems: the Rocky Mountains, Sierra Madre, Sonoran Desert and Chihuahuan Desert.
paras.zh: 这座占地 12,000 英亩的公园保护着奇里卡瓦山脉的一部分，奇里卡瓦山脉是几个“天空岛屿”之一，或者说是从亚利桑那州东南部和墨西哥北部周围的沙漠中升起的孤立山脉。它距离图森约 120 英里，坐落在四大生态系统的交汇处：落基山脉、马德雷山脉、索诺兰沙漠和奇瓦瓦沙漠。

paras.en: In 2025, Chiricahua National Monument welcomed 70,406 visitors, ranking 254th out of 399 National Park Service sites. Business owners, outdoor groups, politicians and others hope that number will increase following its national park designation, Henry Brean reports for the Arizona Daily Star.
paras.zh: 2025 年，奇里卡瓦国家纪念碑接待了 70,406 名游客，在 399 个国家公园管理局站点中排名第 254 位。据亨利·布里恩（Henry Brean）向《亚利桑那每日星报》报道，企业主、户外团体、政治家和其他人士希望在指定国家公园后，这一数字将会增加。

paras.en: Chiricahua’s unique geology is a big part of the appeal for visitors. About 27 million years ago, a massive volcanic eruption blanketed the region in ash and debris. Over time, that material hardened into a rock layer called rhyolitic tuff. Millions of years of wind, rain, freezing temperatures and other natural forces gradually wore it away, carving the landscape into a maze of towering stone spires, balanced boulders and narrow passageways.
paras.zh: 奇里卡瓦独特的地质是吸引游客的一个重要原因。大约 2700 万年前，一次大规模的火山喷发，火山灰和碎片覆盖了该地区。随着时间的推移，这种物质硬化成岩石层，称为流纹质凝灰岩。数百万年的风雨、冰冻温度和其他自然力量逐渐磨损了它，将景观雕刻成一个由高耸的石塔、平衡的巨石和狭窄的通道组成的迷宫。

paras.en: “It has spectacular vistas,” Emily Burns, program director for the Sky Island Alliance, a regional conservation nonprofit, tells USA Today’s Ignacio Calderón and Janet Loehrke. “It has a beautiful canyon and then these rock formations that are a little mind-boggling to understand how they formed over geologic history.”
paras.zh: “这里的景色非常壮观，”区域保护非营利组织天空岛联盟的项目总监艾米丽·伯恩斯 (Emily Burns) 告诉《今日美国》的伊格纳西奥·卡尔德隆 (Ignacio Calderón) 和珍妮特·洛尔克 (Janet Loehrke)。 “它有一个美丽的峡谷，还有这些岩层，令人难以置信，难以理解它们在地质历史上是如何形成的。”

paras.en: Visitors can explore the otherworldly landscape via the park’s 17 miles of hiking trails. As Sylvia Dekker writes for Outside magazine, trekking through the national park feels like “being dwarfed by a sea of massive navigation cairns and those knobby towers of dribbled sand children make at the beach.”
paras.zh: 游客可以沿着公园 17 英里的远足小径探索超凡脱俗的景观。正如西尔维娅·德克尔 (Sylvia Dekker) 为《Outside》杂志所写的那样，徒步穿越国家公园感觉就像“在一片巨大的导航石标海洋和孩子们在海滩上滴下的沙子形成的那些多节塔中显得相形见绌”。

paras.en: Scenic drives, stargazing, horseback riding and camping are also popular ways to experience the park. Surrounded by the 1.78-million-acre Coronado National Forest, it’s also a haven for wildlife, giving animal lovers the chance to spot everything from Coues deer and javelina to black bears, mountain lions, coatimundi, skunks and 16 species of bats.
paras.zh: 驾车观光、观星、骑马和露营也是体验公园的热门方式。这里周围环绕着占地 178 万英亩的科罗纳多国家森林，也是野生动物的天堂，动物爱好者有机会观赏到各种动物，从库埃鹿、标枪到黑熊、山狮、长鼻浣熊、臭鼬和 16 种蝙蝠。

paras.en: Birdwatchers also flock here to see the migratory species that pass through on their way to and from Mexico and Central and South America, as well as the many resident species that live in the area year-round. Around 200 bird species have been documented in the park.
paras.zh: 观鸟者也蜂拥至此，观赏往返墨西哥和中南美洲的迁徙物种，以及常年生活在该地区的许多留鸟物种。公园内记录了大约 200 种鸟类。

paras.en: Human history in the Chiricahua region stretches back at least 12,000 years, when paleoindians hunted big game in the area. Later, hunter-gatherers took advantage of its diverse plants and wildlife before some communities turned to agriculture.
paras.zh: 奇里卡瓦地区的人类历史至少可以追溯到 12,000 年前，当时古印第安人在该地区狩猎大型动物。后来，在一些社区转向农业之前，狩猎采集者利用了这里多样化的植物和野生动物。

paras.en: The Chiricahua Apache lived across a vast territory spanning present-day southeastern Arizona, southwestern New Mexico and northern Mexico. Conflict with the U.S. government eventually culminated in the Apache’s forced removal in the late 19th century. The area was also home to Buffalo Soldiers, homesteaders, immigrants and Civilian Conservation Corps laborers.
paras.zh: 奇里卡瓦阿帕奇人生活在广阔的领土上，横跨今天的亚利桑那州东南部、新墨西哥州西南部和墨西哥北部。与美国政府的冲突最终导致阿帕奇在 19 世纪末被强制拆除。该地区也是布法罗士兵、自耕农、移民和民间保护团工人的家园。

paras.en: Today, the park offers visitors a chance to experience this landscape much as generations before them have. One of the biggest perks of visiting Chiricahua is the ability to “immerse yourself in a place that seems relatively unchanged over the millennia,” Matthew Nelson, executive director of the nonprofit Arizona Trail Association, tells USA Today.
paras.zh: 如今，公园为游客提供了像前几代人一样体验这片景观的机会。非营利组织亚利桑那步道协会的执行董事马修·尼尔森告诉《今日美国》，游览奇里卡瓦的最大好处之一就是能够“沉浸在一个千年以来似乎相对没有变化的地方”。

paras.en: “[It’s] just such a break from modern day technology and the pace of our lives,” Nelson adds. “Being in the rocks in Chiricahua encourages people to just slow down and to listen to the wind and to study the rock features and to be reminded of the beauty that exists in nature.”
paras.zh: “[这]与现代技术和我们的生活节奏完全不同，”尼尔森补充道。 “身处奇里卡瓦的岩石中，人们可以放慢脚步，聆听风声，研究岩石特征，并提醒人们大自然中存在的美丽。”

articles.title: More Than 1,000 Birds Were Killed or Injured in Window Collisions Around Chicago Over the Weekend

paras.en: Wildlife advocates are sounding the alarm after more than 1,000 birds were killed or injured in window collisions in the Chicago area last weekend, reports Fox 32 Chicago’s Nic Flosi.
paras.zh: 据 Fox 32 Chicago 的 Nic Flosi 报道，上周末芝加哥地区发生了 1000 多只鸟类因窗户碰撞事故而死或伤的事件，野生动物倡导者们对此发出了警报。

paras.en: Volunteers with the nonprofit Chicago Bird Collision Monitors spent October 17 and 18 rescuing wounded birds and collecting the bodies of dead ones in downtown Chicago and the northern suburb of Evanston.
paras.zh: 10 月 17 日至 18 日，非营利组织芝加哥鸟类碰撞监测组织的志愿者在芝加哥市中心和埃文斯顿北郊营救受伤的鸟类并收集死鸟的尸体。

paras.en: “We’d pick up a bird at a building, go around that building, and immediately find another,” Annette Prince, director of Chicago Bird Collision Monitors, tells the Chicago Sun-Times’ Kaitlin Washburn. “We had birds hitting the glass windows over our heads.”
paras.zh: 芝加哥鸟类碰撞监测中心主任安妮特·普林斯 (Annette Prince) 告诉《芝加哥太阳报》的凯特琳·沃什伯恩 (Kaitlin Washburn)：“我们在一栋大楼里捡到一只鸟，绕着那栋大楼转一圈，然后立即找到另一只鸟。” “有鸟儿撞击我们头顶的玻璃窗。”

paras.en: Prince says the more than 1,000 birds collected by volunteers likely represent only a fraction of those injured or killed during this year’s fall migration—or even over the weekend. They searched a small area, and they can “only find what’s on the ground,” Prince tells WTTW’s Patty Wetli. Many more birds probably go undiscovered, she says.
paras.zh: 普林斯说，志愿者收集的 1000 多只鸟可能只占今年秋季迁徙期间甚至周末受伤或死亡的一小部分。 Prince 告诉 WTTW 的 Patty Wetli，他们搜索了一小块区域，“只能找到地面上的东西”。她说，可能还有更多的鸟类未被发现。

paras.en: “We don’t even know the full extent, and that’s very sobering,” she adds. “What’s heartbreaking to us is this happens year after year.”
paras.zh: “我们甚至不知道全部情况，这非常发人深省，”她补充道。 “令我们心碎的是这种情况年复一年地发生。”

paras.en: More than five million birds flew through Cook County, which includes Chicago, on the evening of October 16, according to the Cornell Lab of Ornithology’s BirdCast, which uses weather radar to detect and predict migratory activity. That huge number of birds coincided with a cold front, which brought favorable northerly tailwinds that can help push birds south. Across the country, more than one billion migratory birds were estimated to have taken flight that night.
paras.zh: 根据康奈尔鸟类学实验室 BirdCast 的数据，10 月 16 日晚，超过 500 万只鸟类飞过包括芝加哥在内的库克县，该实验室使用天气雷达来检测和预测迁徙活动。如此大量的鸟类与冷锋同时出现，冷锋带来了有利的北顺风，可以帮助鸟类向南移动。据估计，当晚全国范围内有超过十亿只候鸟起飞。

paras.en: Chicago is located along the Mississippi Flyway, a major migratory corridor for millions of birds traveling between North, Central and South America every spring and fall. But the city’s abundance of windows and artificial lights can make it a hazardous place for birds to navigate.
paras.zh: 芝加哥位于密西西比迁徙路线沿线，这是每年春季和秋季数百万鸟类在北美洲、中美洲和南美洲之间迁徙的主要迁徙走廊。但这座城市大量的窗户和人造光可能使其成为鸟类航行的危险场所。

paras.en: Birds often don’t see transparent glass, or they mistake its reflections of the surrounding scenery for a clear path forward. As a result, they can end up crashing into windows while traveling at speeds of up to 30 miles per hour, which can cause death, internal bleeding, concussions or other injuries. Artificial lights can also attract and disorient birds, increasing the risk of collisions, particularly at night, when many species migrate.
paras.zh: 鸟类通常看不到透明的玻璃，或者它们将周围风景的反射误认为是一条清晰的前进道路。因此，它们最终可能会在以每小时 30 英里的速度行驶时撞上窗户，从而导致死亡、内出血、脑震荡或其他伤害。人造光还会吸引鸟类并使它们迷失方向，增加碰撞的风险，特别是在许多物种迁徙的夜间。

paras.en: The birds that make it to Chicago every spring and fall, Prince tells WTTW, are “fit and strong.” But the city’s lights and windows are “taking out the best members,” she says. “They were doing everything right.”
paras.zh: 普林斯告诉 WTTW，每年春天和秋天到达芝加哥的鸟儿“健康而强壮”。但她说，这座城市的灯光和窗户正在“淘汰最好的成员”。 “他们做的一切都是正确的。”

paras.en: Wildlife advocates say these deaths are largely preventable, an especially urgent concern at a time when bird populations face mounting threats. North America has lost around three billion birds since 1970, a figure that represents about 29 percent of the continent’s population, or more than one in four birds. In many places, the rate of decline is accelerating, likely due to warming temperatures and intensive agriculture, research suggests.
paras.zh: 野生动物倡导者表示，这些死亡在很大程度上是可以预防的，在鸟类种群面临日益严重的威胁之际，这是一个尤为紧迫的问题。自 1970 年以来，北美已经失去了约 30 亿只鸟类，这一数字约占该大陆人口的 29%，即超过四分之一的鸟类。研究表明，在许多地方，下降速度正在加快，这可能是由于气温变暖和集约化农业造成的。

paras.en: Chicago has seen high numbers of deadly bird collisions before. In October 2023, nearly 1,000 birds died in a single night after crashing into McCormick Place Lakeside Center, an event venue with a primarily glass facade.
paras.zh: 芝加哥以前曾发生过大量致命的鸟类碰撞事件。 2023 年 10 月，近 1,000 只鸟在撞上麦考密克广场湖滨中心（McCormick Place Lakeside Center）后一夜之间死亡，该中心是一个主要由玻璃幕墙组成的活动场所。

paras.en: Ahead of the 2024 fall migration, the building’s managers spent $1.2 million installing a special, polka-dot-covered film designed to help birds better differentiate between windows and open air. The center also vowed to implement other bird-safe measures, such as switching off non-essential exterior lights and closing drapes and blinds at night. Those efforts led to a more than 90 percent reduction in bird collision deaths during the following autumn season.
paras.zh: 在 2024 年秋季迁徙之前，该建筑的管理人员花费了 120 万美元安装了一种特殊的圆点覆盖薄膜，旨在帮助鸟类更好地区分窗户和露天。该中心还誓言要实施其他鸟类安全措施，例如关闭不必要的外部灯光以及在夜间关闭窗帘和百叶窗。这些努力使接下来的秋季鸟类碰撞死亡事件减少了 90% 以上。

paras.en: Wildlife advocates would like Chicago’s leaders to mandate such bird safety design measures for all new and renovated buildings. They’re pushing city councilors to adopt a bird-friendly building ordinance that’s currently undergoing language revisions in the city’s zoning committee, per the Chicago Tribune’s Adriana Pérez. Similar laws have been passed in other major cities, including New York City and Washington, D.C.
paras.zh: 野生动物倡导者希望芝加哥领导人对所有新建和翻新的建筑强制实施此类鸟类安全设计措施。据《芝加哥论坛报》的阿德里亚娜·佩雷斯报道，他们正在推动市议员通过一项对鸟类友好的建筑条例，该条例目前正在该市分区委员会进行语言修订。其他主要城市也通过了类似的法律，包括纽约市和华盛顿特区。

paras.en: Birds “have a right to migrate and live and fly through our city without unnecessary harm,” Jennifer Bell, a Chicago Bird Collision Monitors volunteer who estimates she has collected more than 350 birds since September on her own, tells Block Club Chicago’s Janelle Mella. “We are causing unnecessary harm by continuing to build all of these glass buildings.”
paras.zh: 芝加哥鸟类碰撞监测志愿者珍妮弗·贝尔 (Jennifer Bell) 告诉芝加哥街区俱乐部 (Block Club Chicago) 的珍妮尔·梅拉 (Janelle Mella)，自 9 月份以来，她估计自己已经收集了 350 多只鸟类，鸟类“有权在我们的城市中迁徙、生活和飞行，而不会受到不必要的伤害”。 “我们继续建造所有这些玻璃建筑正在造成不必要的伤害。”

articles.title: Researchers Claimed a Blurry Object on Apple Maps Was 'Very Likely' Amelia Earhart's Missing Plane. It Turned Out to Be a 'Collection of Large Trees'

paras.en: The expedition began with a blurry satellite image on Apple Maps. Just off Nikumaroro, a remote atoll in the South Pacific, a mysterious object lurked below the surface. Didn’t it look suspiciously like the wing of an airplane?
paras.zh: 这次探险从苹果地图上一张模糊的卫星图像开始。就在南太平洋偏远环礁尼库马罗罗附近，一个神秘物体潜伏在地表以下。它看起来不像飞机的机翼吗？

paras.en: The atoll in question is located near the region where aviator Amelia Earhart and her navigator, Fred Noonan, disappeared in 1937. The location of their Lockheed Electra has been a longstanding mystery, but that hasn’t stopped new generations of sleuths from trying to solve it. The strange shape near Nikumaroro sparked the latest attempt to crack the case.
paras.zh: 该环礁位于飞行员阿米莉亚·埃尔哈特 (Amelia Earhart) 和她的航海家弗雷德·努南 (Fred Noonan) 1937 年失踪的地区附近。他们的洛克希德·伊莱克特拉 (Lockheed Electra) 的位置长期以来一直是个谜，但这并没有阻止新一代侦探试图解开这个谜团。尼库马罗罗附近的奇怪形状引发了破案的最新尝试。

paras.en: Earlier this month, a team of 17 traveled to the South Pacific to investigate the so-called Taraia Object, named for the atoll’s Taraia Peninsula. They surveyed the site with a magnetometer (to detect ferrous metals) and side-scan sonar (to identify objects buried in the sediment). As they worked, onlookers eagerly anticipated success, with some headlines claiming that the 89-year-old mystery “could be solved in days.”
paras.zh: 本月早些时候，一个由 17 人组成的团队前往南太平洋调查所谓的塔拉亚天体，该天体以环礁的塔拉亚半岛命名。他们用磁力计（用于检测黑色金属）和侧扫声纳（用于识别埋在沉积物中的物体）对该地点进行了勘察。当他们工作时，旁观者热切地期待着成功，一些头条新闻声称这个 89 年的谜团“可能在几天内解开”。

paras.en: On October 18, the researchers announced the results: They had found “no conclusive evidence” of Earhart’s plane on Nikumaroro. That tantalizing shape in the satellite imagery had likely been “a collection of large trees.” Many of the trees and other debris had already washed away by the time the team arrived at the site.
paras.zh: 10月18日，研究人员公布了结果：他们在尼库马罗罗岛上“没有发现埃尔哈特飞机的确凿证据”。卫星图像中那个诱人的形状很可能是“一群大树”。当团队到达现场时，许多树木和其他碎片已经被冲走。

paras.en: “The name ‘Taraia’ itself in the Gilbertese language, the Kiribati language, can mean ‘see if you can find it,’” Steve Schultz, Purdue University’s general counsel and a member of the expedition, says in a video. “We came to see what we could find here, to see if it could add a final concluding chapter to the mystery of Amelia Earhart and Fred Noonan’s disappearance. And unfortunately, we weren’t able to find that smoking gun.”
paras.zh: “‘塔拉亚’这个名字本身在基里巴斯吉尔伯特语中的意思是‘看看你能不能找到它’，”普渡大学总法律顾问、探险队成员史蒂夫·舒尔茨在一段视频中说道。 “我们来这里是为了看看能在这里找到什么，看看它是否能为阿米莉亚·埃尔哈特和弗雷德·努南的失踪之谜增添最后的结局。不幸的是，我们没能找到确凿的证据。”

paras.en: When her plane disappeared, Earhart was trying to become the first woman in history to fly around the world. She’d already broken a number of other records, becoming the first woman (and second person) to fly solo and nonstop across the Atlantic in 1932 and the first person to fly solo and nonstop from Hawaii to the United States mainland in 1935. Two years later, she plotted out a round-the-world journey divided into 34 legs. She selected a route near the equator to avoid harsh northern weather. In exchange, however, she would need to navigate long stretches of open water in the South Pacific.
paras.zh: 当她的飞机失踪时，埃尔哈特正试图成为历史上第一位环游世界的女性。她已经打破了许多其他记录，成为 1932 年第一个单人不间断飞越大西洋的女性（也是第二人），以及 1935 年第一个单人不间断从夏威夷飞往美国大陆的人。两年后，她规划了一次分为 34 段的环球旅行。 She selected a route near the equator to avoid harsh northern weather. In exchange, however, she would need to navigate long stretches of open water in the South Pacific.

paras.en: Earhart and Noonan took off from Lae, New Guinea, on July 2, 1937. Their plan was to land on Howland Island, an isolated speck of earth thousands of miles from the mainland, where a Coast Guard cutter waited with fuel. “We must be on you, but we cannot see you,” the aviator radioed as she approached her destination. “Fuel is running low. Been unable to reach you by radio. We are flying at 1,000 feet.” About an hour later, she made her final transmission to the vessel: “We are running north and south.” Earhart and Noonan disappeared after completing nearly 31 of their 34 legs. They had flown 22,000 of their planned 29,000 miles.
paras.zh: 埃尔哈特和努南于 1937 年 7 月 2 日从新几内亚莱城起飞。他们的计划是降落在距大陆数千英里的豪兰岛，一艘海岸警卫队快艇正在那里等待着燃料。 “我们一定在你身上，但我们看不到你，”飞行员在接近目的地时用无线电说道。 “燃料即将耗尽。无法通过无线电联系到您。我们的飞行高度为 1,000 英尺。”大约一个小时后，她向船只发出了最后一次通讯：“我们正在向北和向南行驶。”埃尔哈特和努南在完成 34 条腿中的近 31 条后失踪。他们计划的 29,000 英里已经飞行了 22,000 英里。

paras.en: - After the Electra disappeared, rescuers conducted a large-scale search covering 250,000 square miles of ocean. The Navy ultimately concluded that the plane had likely crashed in the Pacific.
paras.zh: - Electra号失踪后，救援人员进行了覆盖25万平方英里海域的大规模搜寻。海军最终得出的结论是，这架飞机很可能在太平洋坠毁。

paras.en: - “Although unfortunately the fate of the missing flyers remains a mystery, it is considered that the search made was efficient and that the areas covered were the most probable ones, based on the facts and information available,” the Navy wrote in a report later that month.
paras.zh: 美国海军在当月晚些时候的一份报告中写道：“尽管不幸的是，失踪飞行员的命运仍然是个谜，但根据现有的事实和信息，我们认为搜索是有效的，而且所覆盖的区域是最有可能的区域。”

paras.en: Numerous far-fetched theories have attempted to explain the pair’s disappearance. Some conspiracy theorists believe that Earhart landed in the Marshall Islands, where she was captured by the Japanese. One of them published a 2016 book claiming that President Franklin D. Roosevelt had sent the aviator on a secret spy mission, with Earhart later returning to America under a new identity.
paras.zh: 许多牵强的理论试图解释这对夫妇的失踪。一些阴谋论者认为，埃尔哈特在马绍尔群岛登陆，并在那里被日本人俘虏。其中一人在 2016 年出版了一本书籍，声称富兰克林·罗斯福总统派这位飞行员执行秘密间谍任务，埃尔哈特后来以新身份返回美国。

paras.en: Most experts think that the plane went down in the ocean near Howland Island. But some argue that Earhart and Noonan landed on Nikumaroro, some 400 miles away, and died there as castaways. Researchers with the International Group for Historic Aircraft Recovery (TIGHAR) have made numerous trips to the island, where they identified several 1930s-era cosmetic items and fragments of a shoe. These discoveries are titillating, but none of them are definitively linked to the Electra. The shoe, for example, likely wasn’t Earhart’s size.
paras.zh: 大多数专家认为飞机是在豪兰岛附近的海洋中坠毁的。但有些人认为，埃尔哈特和努南在约 400 英里外的 Nikumaroro 登陆，并在那里遇难。国际历史飞机修复组织 (TIGHAR) 的研究人员多次前往该岛，并在那里发现了一些 1930 年代的化妆品和鞋子碎片。这些发现令人兴奋，但没有一个与厄勒克特拉有明确的联系。例如，这双鞋可能不是埃尔哈特的尺码。

paras.en: The castaway theory “doesn’t follow the facts,” Dorothy Cochrane, then a curator at the Smithsonian’s National Air and Space Museum, told Smithsonian magazine’s Brigit Katz in 2019. The Coast Guard cutter waiting near Howland Island reported that her radio transmissions had gotten progressively louder, suggesting that she was getting closer. Rescuers flew over Nikumaroro within a week of the disappearance; if she were there, “it’s just inconceivable that they would not have seen her,” said Cochrane, who retired last year.
paras.zh: 2019 年，时任史密森尼国家航空航天博物馆馆长的多萝西·科克伦 (Dorothy Cochrane) 告诉史密森尼杂志的布里吉特·卡茨 (Brigit Katz)，漂流者理论“不符合事实”。在豪兰岛附近等待的海岸警卫队快艇报告说，她的无线电传输声音逐渐变大，表明她已经离我们越来越近了。失踪后一周内，救援人员飞越尼库马罗罗上空；去年退休的科克伦说，如果她在那里，“他们看不到她真是不可思议”。

paras.en: Several other big-budget expeditions have come up empty in recent years. In 2019, Robert Ballard, the oceanographer who discovered the wreck of the Titanic, conducted an unsuccessful search. In 2024, the exploration company Deep Sea Vision identified an intriguing shape on a sonar image some 100 miles from Howland Island; it later found that this shape was a natural rock formation.
paras.zh: 近年来，其他几项大预算的探险活动均告失败。 2019年，发现泰坦尼克号残骸的海洋学家罗伯特·巴拉德进行了一次搜寻，但没有成功。 2024 年，勘探公司 Deep Sea Vision 在距豪兰岛约 100 英里的声纳图像上发现了一个有趣的形状；后来发现这个形状是天然岩层。

paras.en: The recent investigation began with Michael Ashmore, the amateur researcher who found the blurry Apple Maps image in 2020. He contacted Richard Gillespie, TIGHAR’s executive director, who wasn’t convinced. After all, TIGHAR’s researchers had previously investigated that section of the island.
paras.zh: 最近的调查始于业余研究员迈克尔·阿什莫尔 (Michael Ashmore)，他在 2020 年发现了模糊的苹果地图图像。他联系了 TIGHAR 的执行董事理查德·吉莱斯皮 (Richard Gillespie)，但后者并不相信。毕竟，TIGHAR 的研究人员之前已经调查过该岛的那部分区域。

paras.en: But the satellite image intrigued Richard Pettigrew, executive director of the Archaeological Legacy Institute, who asked Ashmore to present his discovery at a conference. “I was sufficiently impressed,” Pettigrew told National Geographic’s Rachel Hartigan earlier this month. “Within a few days after that, I was already looking for ways to get back to Nikumaroro.”
paras.zh: 但卫星图像引起了考古遗产研究所执行主任理查德·佩蒂格鲁的兴趣，他要求阿什莫尔在一次会议上展示他的发现。 “我印象深刻，”佩蒂格鲁本月早些时候告诉国家地理杂志的雷切尔·哈蒂根。 “在那之后的几天内，我就已经在寻找返回尼库马罗罗的方法了。”

paras.en: Pettigrew created a video about the theory, which caught the attention of Schultz at Purdue. As it happens, Earhart had worked as a consultant and career counselor at the university. She even purchased the Electra with money from the Purdue Research Foundation—and, according to the university’s announcement, she had planned to return the plane to Purdue after her record-breaking flight.
paras.zh: 佩蒂格鲁制作了一个关于该理论的视频，引起了普渡大学舒尔茨的注意。碰巧的是，埃尔哈特曾在大学担任顾问和职业顾问。她甚至用普渡大学研究基金会的钱购买了这架 Electra，而且根据该大学的公告，她计划在破纪录的飞行后将飞机返回普渡大学。

paras.en: Purdue University and the Purdue Research Foundation partnered with the Archaeological Legacy Institute to plan the Taraia Object expedition. Ahead of the trip, the researchers were bullish. “We believe it is very likely that the Taraia Object in Nikumaroro Lagoon is actually the remains of the Lockheed Model 10-E Electra flown to the island by Amelia Earhart and Fred Noonan,” they wrote. They described the expedition as “Phase 1 of a potential three-phase project,” which could eventually include “full-scale archaeological excavation (Phase 2) and recovery (Phase 3) of the aircraft remains.”
paras.zh: Purdue University and the Purdue Research Foundation partnered with the Archaeological Legacy Institute to plan the Taraia Object expedition.在这次旅行之前，研究人员表示乐观。他们写道：“我们认为，尼库马罗罗泻湖中的塔拉亚物体很可能实际上是阿米莉亚·埃尔哈特和弗雷德·努南飞往该岛的洛克希德 10-E 型伊莱克特拉飞机的残骸。”他们将这次探险描述为“潜在的三阶段项目的第一阶段”，最终可能包括“对飞机残骸进行全面的考古发掘（第二阶段）和恢复（第三阶段）”。

paras.en: Despite the disappointing results, the researchers are eager to continue the search. They say their confidence in the castaway theory hasn’t faltered. “There’s a long list of evidence that supports that conclusion,” Pettigrew says in the video. “I think eventually someone will find conclusive evidence here to finally put a cap on the mystery.”
paras.zh: 尽管结果令人失望，研究人员仍渴望继续研究。他们表示，他们对漂流者理论的信心并未动摇。 “有一长串证据支持这个结论，”佩蒂格鲁在视频中说。 “我认为最终有人会在这里找到确凿的证据，最终揭开这个谜团。”

paras.en: Other experts, however, doubt that any evidence will surface on Nikumaroro. Nauticos, the deep-sea exploration company, is raising money for its fourth attempt to locate Earhart’s plane, which will investigate an area near Howland Island. “I’m very excited about their work,” Cochrane tells CTV’s Anne-Marie Mediwake. “They’re following the facts of the flight.”
paras.zh: 然而，其他专家怀疑 Nikumaroro 是否会出现任何证据。深海勘探公司 Nauticos 正在为其第四次寻找埃尔哈特飞机的位置筹集资金，该飞机将调查豪兰岛附近的地区。 “我对他们的工作感到非常兴奋，”科克伦告诉 CTV 的 Anne-Marie Mediwake。 “他们正在追踪航班的事实。”

articles.title: Meet Mori, a Cute Robot Mushroom That Doesn’t Really Say (or Do) Anything
articles.author: Julian Chokkattu

paras.en: You've had a long day. You finally get home, fling the door open, plonk on the couch, and let out a big sigh. In the corner of your eye, you notice your mushroom lamp perk up. Its microphone must have heard you come in. Its head raises to reveal round, animated eyes, and a little diamond-shaped nose—which actually houses a camera.
paras.zh: 你已经度过了漫长的一天。终于到家了，推开门，重重地坐在沙发上，长长地叹了口气。在你的眼角，你注意到蘑菇灯亮了起来。它的麦克风一定听到了你进来的声音。它的头抬起来，露出圆圆的、充满活力的眼睛，还有一个菱形的小鼻子——鼻子里实际上装有一个摄像头。

paras.en: It does a little jiggle because it sees you're back. Its name is Mori.
paras.zh: 它会轻微晃动，因为它看到你回来了。它的名字叫森。

paras.en: As you move around the space—maybe it's time to start cooking dinner—the little robot's face follows you, observing your movements and making soft sounds that are a cross between a bird and R2-D2. The day's stress catches up, and you need a moment to relax, so you head over to Mori, touch its head, and its eyes and camera-nose dip back inside its body. It goes back to being a lamp, except now it plays nature soundscapes so you can feel at ease.
paras.zh: 当您在空间中走动时（也许是时候开始做饭了），小机器人的脸会跟随您，观察您的动作并发出介于鸟和 R2-D2 之间的柔和声音。一天的压力袭来，你需要片刻放松，所以你走到 Mori 身边，触摸它的头，它的眼睛和相机鼻子又缩回到它的身体里。它又回到了灯的状态，只不过现在它播放自然音景，让您感到轻松自在。

paras.en: That's the pitch from OKA, or One Kind Artifact, a new startup based in Cambridge, Massachusetts, and Shenzhen, China, focusing on experimental technology. CEO Hua Wang tells WIRED he wants his company to create five experimental “Artifacts” over the course of OKA's lifetime. Mori is the first.
paras.zh: OKA（One Kind Artifact）是一家位于马萨诸塞州剑桥和中国深圳的初创公司，专注于实验技术。首席执行官王华告诉《连线》杂志，他希望公司在 OKA 的一生中创造出五件实验性“工件”。森是第一个。

paras.en: “There are certain relationships in this era we want to fix between humans and our surroundings—human with nature, human with one another—every product is an experience trying to reconnect some of those relationships,” Wang says. Before cofounding OKA, he was a general manager at Meipai, a video-sharing app from the Chinese phone brand Meitu. He also cofounded Bondee, a now-defunct social media app that briefly went viral in Asia.
paras.zh: “在这个时代，我们希望修复人类与周围环境之间的某些关系——人与自然、人与人之间——每一件产品都是一种试图重新连接其中一些关系的体验，”王说。在共同创立 OKA 之前，他曾担任美拍（中国手机品牌美图公司旗下的视频共享应用程序）的总经理。他还共同创立了 Bondee，这是一款现已停产的社交媒体应用程序，曾在亚洲短暂走红。

paras.en: According to the company, the point of Mori, the nearly 12-inch-tall home robot lamp, is to reconnect its owners with nature. It can play nature soundscapes. It will glow different colors—inspired by rain, forests, fire, and wind—while reacting to your movements. It can guide you through a calming breathing session.
paras.zh: 据该公司称，Mori 这款近 12 英寸高的家用机器人灯的目的是让其主人与自然重新建立联系。它可以播放自然音景。它会发出不同的颜色——灵感来自雨、森林、火和风——同时对你的动作做出反应。它可以指导您进行平静的呼吸课程。

paras.en: It also uses its built-in camera and microphones to serve as a fun little interactive companion in your home. Ask it how your outfit looks, and Mori will jiggle excitedly. If you're playing music or watching TV, Mori can dance to the tunes and react to the action on your TV screen.
paras.zh: 它还使用内置摄像头和麦克风作为您家中有趣的小互动伴侣。如果你问它你的衣服怎么样，森会兴奋地摇晃。如果您正在播放音乐或看电视，Mori 可以随着音乐跳舞并对电视屏幕上的动作做出反应。

paras.en: It intentionally does not do anything else. Unlike an Amazon Echo, it isn't an assistant: You can't use voice commands to control smart lights or cue up Spotify tracks, and it won't answer if you ask about the weather.
paras.zh: 它故意不做任何其他事情。与 Amazon Echo 不同的是，它不是助手：你不能使用语音命令来控制智能灯或提示 Spotify 曲目，如果你询问天气，它也不会回答。

paras.en: The Founder's Edition is a staggering $649 and is available starting today, though stock is limited to a few hundred units. That price also includes a two-year warranty and two years of Mori's subscription service ($17 per month or $80 a year). If you miss out on the Founder’s Edition, you can still buy a standard edition Mori, but that costs $799, and that higher price shockingly does not include any of the subscription features.
paras.zh: 创始人版售价高达 649 美元，从今天开始发售，但库存仅限几百件。该价格还包括两年保修和两年 Mori 订阅服务（每月 17 美元或每年 80 美元）。如果你错过了创始人版，你仍然可以购买标准版 Mori，但价格为 799 美元，而且令人震惊的是，更高的价格不包括任何订阅功能。

paras.en: Wang says today's home robots have mostly taken on “machine-like” forms that don't mesh well with personal environments, so OKA designed a lamp that blends in, but is also anthropomorphized to make being at home “feel better.”
paras.zh: 王说，今天的家庭机器人大多采取“类似机器”的形式，与个人环境不能很好地融合，因此 OKA 设计了一款既能融入环境的灯，又被拟人化，让在家“感觉更好”。

paras.en: OKA's AI algorithms (powered by multiple local large language models) let Mori understand the room's context through the camera and microphone, so it knows when to interact and when to stay quiet. The company calls this “Attentive Intelligence.” It has memory, so it remembers you and interacts with you a certain way over time, whereas it might act a little more shy if you bring home a guest. If it doesn't see someone for a month, it will forget them.
paras.zh: OKA 的人工智能算法（由多个本地大语言模型提供支持）让 Mori 通过摄像头和麦克风了解房间的背景，因此它知道何时进行交互以及何时保持安静。该公司称之为“注意力智能”。它有记忆，所以随着时间的推移，它会记住你并以某种方式与你互动，而如果你带一位客人回家，它可能会表现得更害羞。如果一个月见不到一个人，它就会忘记他们。

paras.en: It might notice, for example, that you've been on your phone doomscrolling for two hours straight on the couch. Mori might then try to get your attention so you come over, listen to some wind rustling through the leaves, and give your eyes a break. When you're on a phone call, or maybe having an argument with a significant other, it understands what’s happening and goes silent so as not to distract you.
paras.zh: 例如，它可能会注意到您已经在沙发上用手机滚动了两个小时。然后森可能会试图引起你的注意，这样你就会过来，听听风吹过树叶的沙沙声，让你的眼睛休息一下。当您正在打电话或与重要的其他人发生争执时，它会了解正在发生的事情并保持沉默，以免分散您的注意力。

paras.en: “All gadgets try to capture more of your attention,” Wang says. “Mori gives your attention back to you. It invites you to do meditative experiences. Nature has this restorative power to humans.”
paras.zh: “所有的小工具都试图吸引你更多的注意力，”王说。 “森让你的注意力重新回到你身上。它邀请你进行冥想体验。大自然对人类有这种恢复力量。”

paras.en: The robot can connect to Wi-Fi, which should give you pause from a security standpoint, but Wang says the internet connection is only used for firmware updates.
paras.zh: 该机器人可以连接到 Wi-Fi，从安全角度来看，这应该会让你犹豫一下，但 Wang 表示，互联网连接仅用于固件更新。

paras.en: Mori processes raw images and audio locally, and then discards the files. Facial feature data—which is collected so it knows to react to you versus a guest—is encrypted on the device, and never uploaded. The camera turns off when the robot retracts into a lamp, and the microphone turns off when you double-tap the top of Mori's head. It is battery-powered, so you can take it from room to room, or just leave it plugged in.
paras.zh: Mori 在本地处理原始图像和音频，然后丢弃文件。收集面部特征数据是为了让它知道对您和访客做出反应，并在设备上进行加密，并且永远不会上传。当机器人缩回灯中时，相机会关闭；当您双击森的头顶时，麦克风会关闭。它由电池供电，因此您可以将其从一个房间带到另一个房间，或者只需将其插入电源即可。

paras.en: Wang says Mori's skill set is limited for now, though it could expand in the future. He suggests it could connect to your Oura Ring data in the future so it knows exactly when you need some relaxing sounds, or to your Spotify account to play different content. Voice commands could even come later—like asking Mori to play nature sounds instead of having to touch it.
paras.zh: 王说，森稔的技能目前有限，但未来可能会扩展。他建议它将来可以连接到你的 Oura Ring 数据，这样它就能准确地知道你什么时候需要一些放松的声音，或者连接到你的 Spotify 帐户来播放不同的内容。语音命令甚至可以稍后出现——比如要求 Mori 播放自然声音，而不必触摸它。

paras.en: “People feel isolated and want this kind of presence in their home. A lot of people leave their TV on to fill the emptiness of the room,” Wang says, pointing to a time when he was feeling isolated while studying abroad in the US. “It's not particularly for the elderly or children, but for younger generations.”
paras.zh: “人们感到孤立，希望在家里有这样的存在。很多人把电视开着，以填补房间的空虚，”王说，他指的是他在美国留学时感到孤立​​的一段时间。 “这并不是特别针对老人或儿童，而是针对年轻一代。”

paras.en: Cute robot pets that interact with you have been welcomed into our homes before. Chris Harrison, director of the Future Interfaces Group at Carnegie Mellon University, points to Sony's Aibo dog from 1999 as an early digital companion. However, he says the crucial ingredient they have been missing is what artificial intelligence can now provide. These previous robots were too simplistic, but now that the modern versions can understand and react to human actions and emotions, they could become more impactful.
paras.zh: 与你互动的可爱机器人宠物以前就被欢迎进入我们的家。卡内基梅隆大学未来接口小组主任 Chris Harrison 指出，索尼 1999 年推出的 Aibo 狗是早期的数字伴侣。然而，他表示，他们所缺少的关键要素是人工智能现在可以提供的东西。以前的这些机器人过于简单，但现在现代版本可以理解人类的行为和情感并做出反应，它们可能会变得更有影响力。

paras.en: “Humans have always wanted to anthropomorphize everything—they love making things cute,” Harrison says. “We want to make robots cute; we want to put cute little cases on our iPhones.” He points to Meta's new Muse agent, which has a cuddly avatar. “It is almost like a pet, but a hyper-capable pet.”
paras.zh: “人类一直想将一切拟人化——他们喜欢让事物变得可爱，”哈里森说。 “我们想让机器人变得可爱；我们想让我们的 iPhone 上装上可爱的小外壳。”他指着 Meta 的新 Muse 代理，它有一个可爱的化身。 “它几乎就像一只宠物，但能力超强。”

paras.en: When I point out that Mori doesn't seem very capable with its limited feature set, Harrison likens it to people owning a goldfish or a hamster.
paras.zh: 当我指出 Mori 因其有限的功能集而显得能力不强时，Harrison 将其比作拥有金鱼或仓鼠的人。

paras.en: “Are we holding [Mori] to an unrealistic bar? People do extract a lot of pleasure out of taking care of their pets and snuggling with their pets and interacting with their pets that I wouldn't say are necessarily more sophisticated.”
paras.zh: “我们是否让[森]陷入了一个不切实际的境地？人们确实从照顾宠物、与宠物依偎以及与宠物互动中获得了很多乐趣，我认为这些乐趣不一定更复杂。”

paras.en: Whether people will shell out hundreds of dollars for a robotic pet that can’t fetch—or even tell you the time—is up in the air. But if this mushroom-shaped, camera-wielding lamp can fool overstimulated brains into feeling a little less alone at the end of the day, maybe that’s enough.
paras.zh: 人们是否会花数百美元购买一只无法取回甚至无法告诉你时间的机器宠物，目前还不确定。但如果这种蘑菇形的、手持相机的灯能够欺骗过度刺激的大脑，让他们在一天结束时感觉不那么孤独，也许这就足够了。

articles.title: Fellow Aiden Precision Coffee Maker is $100 Off
articles.author: Molly Higgins

paras.en: The Fellow Aiden drip coffee maker is universally beloved among the WIRED Reviews team. (Read our review here.) It, alongside other popular Fellow staples, are over 20 percent off right now at Fellow's Refurbished Gear Section.
paras.zh: Fellow Aiden 滴滤咖啡机深受《连线》评论团队的普遍喜爱。 （请在此处阅读我们的评论。）它与 Fellow 的其他热门主打产品一起，目前在 Fellow 的翻新装备专区有超过 20% 的折扣。

paras.en: We love the Aiden partly because of its sleek, mid-century modernist design, but above all, for how easy it is to use and how great the coffee tastes. It's approachable to use but still has plenty of customization for coffee aficionados, including roast level, brewing temperature, bloom duration, and even local elevation. If you're like me and would rather press a button and go, you can choose the automated “Guided Brew” setting on the LED menu, pick your size (between five and 50 ounces), pop in a color-coded basket (which, as an added bonus, takes standard paper filters), and add the amount of coffee the drip coffee maker recommends. You'll get the perfect cup, brewed at 200 degrees Fahrenheit.
paras.zh: 我们喜欢 Aiden 的部分原因是它的时尚、中世纪现代主义设计，但最重要的是它的易用性和咖啡的味道。它易于使用，但仍然为咖啡爱好者提供了大量的定制功能，包括烘焙级别、冲泡温度、开花持续时间，甚至当地海拔。如果您像我一样，宁愿按下按钮即可开始，您可以在 LED 菜单上选择自动“引导冲泡”设置，选择您的尺寸（5 到 50 盎司之间），放入颜色编码的篮子（作为额外的好处，它采用标准纸过滤器），然后添加滴漏式咖啡机推荐的咖啡量。您将获得一杯在 200 华氏度下冲泡的完美杯子。

paras.en: If you're a true coffee nerd, there's the Fellow phone app where you can customize your brew and build a library of recipes to refer to later. So, if you get an exceptionally good cup of drip coffee, you can easily recreate it the next morning.
paras.zh: 如果您是一个真正的咖啡迷，可以使用 Fellow 手机应用程序，您可以在其中自定义您的咖啡并建立一个食谱库以供以后参考。因此，如果您喝到一杯非常好的滴滤咖啡，第二天早上您就可以轻松地重新制作它。

paras.en: But if you're like me and would rather sip iced coffee to match your frozen heart, Aiden uses hot-bloomed coffee and a Japanese-style slow-drip method to make a light-bodied, aromatic cold brew in about 90 minutes. The brew is room temperature when it's done, so we recommend making it the night before and refrigerating it for the morning—or letting it brew a little longer and serving it over plenty of ice.
paras.zh: 但如果你像我一样，更愿意喝冰咖啡来搭配你冰冻的心，Aiden 使用热花咖啡和日式慢滴法，在大约 90 分钟内制作出一杯口感轻盈、芳香四溢的冷萃咖啡。冲泡完成后温度为室温，因此我们建议在前一天晚上冲泡，并在早上冷藏，或者让它冲泡的时间更长一点，然后加大量冰块饮用。

paras.en: This and a few other Fellow machines and kettles are discounted as part of the brand's refurbished program (called Rebrew). Every refurbished unit the brand sells is sent to their headquarters for rigorous restoration and testing, including deep cleaning, performance testing, and component replacements. Refurbished products also come with a one-year limited warranty. Below are two other discounted Fellow electric kettles we love sitting pretty in the refurbished section.
paras.zh: 作为该品牌翻新计划（称为 Rebrew）的一部分，这款机器和其他一些 Fellow 机器和水壶均享有折扣。该品牌销售的每台翻新设备都会被送往总部进行严格的修复和测试，包括深度清洁、性能测试和部件更换。翻新产品还享有一年有限保修。下面是另外两款打折的 Fellow 电热水壶，我们喜欢在翻新区漂亮地摆放。

articles.title: Save $150 on the Apple Mac Mini M4, but There’s a Catch
articles.author: Les Shu

paras.en: Apple’s Mac Mini M4 has become a popular mini-yet-mighty desktop computer for running local agentic AI 24/7—so much so that it’s been out of stock for months. But with the introduction of the new Mac Mini M6, the older M4 is no longer as scarce (there was no M5 Mac Mini), and the base model (256-GB hard drive, 16-GB unified memory) is on sale for $649—$150 off MSRP and $250 cheaper than the M6.
paras.zh: Apple 的 Mac Mini M4 已成为一款流行的迷你但功能强大的台式电脑，用于运行本地代理 AI 24/7，以至于已经断货数月。但随着新款 Mac Mini M6 的推出，旧款 M4 不再那么稀缺（没有 M5 Mac Mini），基本型号（256 GB 硬盘、16 GB 统一内存）售价为 649 美元，比建议零售价低 150 美元，比 M6 便宜 250 美元。

paras.en: It’s a good deal for a computer that is plenty powerful for most people, and some M4 Mac Mini configurations can even handle AI tasks. But—and it’s a big but—shoppers should be aware that the M4’s original base price was $599 when it launched in 2024. However, with Apple raising prices on hardware across the board this year, driven by chip and memory shortages, the M4 ended up costing $799. In comparison, the new M6 starts at $899.
paras.zh: 对于一台对大多数人来说都足够强大的计算机来说，这是一个很划算的选择，一些 M4 Mac Mini 配置甚至可以处理人工智能任务。但是，这是一个很大的但是，购物者应该意识到，M4 在 2024 年推出时的原始基本价格为 599 美元。然而，由于芯片和内存短缺，苹果今年全面提高了硬件价格，M4 最终售价为 799 美元。相比之下，新款 M6 起售价为 899 美元。

paras.en: Depending on how you look at it, it’s either a discount or a hard pill to swallow, knowing that it used to be much cheaper. If you’ve been eyeing a new Mac Mini and don’t need the better performance of the M6, you’re unlikely to get a lower price than this M4.
paras.zh: 这取决于你如何看待它，它要么是折扣，要么是难以下咽的药丸，因为你知道它曾经便宜得多。如果您一直在关注新的 Mac Mini 并且不需要 M6 的更好性能，那么您不太可能获得比这款 M4 更低的价格。

paras.en: The M4 Mac Mini may no longer be Apple’s most powerful tiny computer—that title now belongs to the M6 and M5 Pro models—but the M4 is still an incredibly strong and efficient processor. When it was discovered that it could easily run agentic AI locally, people gobbled up the Mac Mini as the affordable computing option.
paras.zh: M4 Mac Mini 可能不再是苹果最强大的微型电脑——这个头衔现在属于 M6 和 M5 Pro 型号——但 M4 仍然是一款极其强大和高效的处理器。当人们发现它可以轻松地在本地运行代理人工智能时，人们纷纷选择 Mac Mini 作为经济实惠的计算选项。

paras.en: Of course, for intensive tasks like AI or video editing, you really need more than 16 GB of memory; those who bought it for AI purposes loaded it up with 32 GB of RAM. For most users, however, this base-specs machine is more than capable. While the M6 system on a chip is extra powerful due to having more CPU and GPU cores, Neural Accelerators, and higher memory bandwidth, the M4 Mac Mini isn’t lagging far behind. For things like web browsing and general productivity, you won’t see much of a difference in performance.
paras.zh: 当然，对于 AI 或视频编辑等密集型任务，您确实需要 16 GB 以上的内存；那些为了人工智能目的而购买它的人则为其配备了 32 GB 的 RAM。然而，对于大多数用户来说，这款基本规格的机器绰绰有余。虽然 M6 芯片系统由于拥有更多的 CPU 和 GPU 核心、神经加速器和更高的内存带宽而变得更加强大，但 M4 Mac Mini 也没有落后太多。对于网页浏览和一般生产力等方面，您不会发现性能有太大差异。

paras.en: If you need the performance, we recommend the newer M6. But for most people, the M4 Mac Mini is more than sufficient for everyday computing, and you're unlikely to find a better deal than this one.
paras.zh: 如果您需要性能，我们推荐较新的 M6。但对于大多数人来说，M4 Mac Mini 足以满足日常计算需求，而且您不可能找到比这款更好的产品了。

articles.title: Bukele launches military rescue operation in Haiti; U.S. backs effort

paras.en: Oct. 22 (UPI) -- El Salvador President Nayib Bukele launched a military combat operation in Haiti to rescue four Salvadoran aviation technicians kidnapped by criminal gangs, drawing immediate U.S. support after international condemnation of the attack at the U.N. Security Council.
paras.zh: 10月22日（UPI）——萨尔瓦多总统纳伊布·布克莱在海地发起军事行动，营救四名被犯罪团伙绑架的萨尔瓦多航空技术人员，联合国安理会对这次袭击事件表示谴责后，立即得到了美国的支持。

paras.en: In a post on X Wednesday, Bukele said the hostages were not combat personnel, but rather aviation technicians whose sole mission in Haiti was to coordinate medical evacuations and humanitarian assistance.
paras.zh: 布克莱在周三的一篇帖子中表示，人质不是战斗人员，而是航空技术人员，他们在海地的唯一任务是协调医疗后送和人道主义援助。

paras.en: He said the four men were "cowardly kidnapped" while returning from a local supermarket where they had gone to buy food.
paras.zh: 他说，这四名男子是在从当地一家超市买食物回来时被“懦弱的绑架”的。

paras.en: "That is why today we launched combat operations to rescue them. We have only one objective: to bring our four compatriots home safe and sound," Bukele wrote.
paras.zh: “这就是为什么今天我们发起战斗行动来营救他们。我们只有一个目标：让我们的四名同胞平安回家，”布克莱写道。

paras.en: The Salvadoran president also issued a direct ultimatum to Haiti's gang leaders.
paras.zh: 萨尔瓦多总统还向海地帮派头目直接发出最后通牒。

paras.en: "Today's attack is nothing compared with what will come if you do not hand over all four alive. We have already eliminated the gangs in El Salvador, and we can eliminate you, too," Bukele warned, referring to his administration's crackdown on criminal gangs.
paras.zh: 布克莱在谈到萨尔瓦多政府打击犯罪团伙的行动时警告说：“今天的袭击与你们不交出全部四人的情况相比根本算不了什么。我们已经消灭了萨尔瓦多的帮派，我们也可以消灭你们。”

paras.en: Bukele said the current operation was only an initial phase and warned that he could order a much larger military intervention, if necessary.
paras.zh: 布克莱表示，目前的行动只是初始阶段，并警告说，如有必要，他可以下令进行更大规模的军事干预。

paras.en: The operation followed an attack Sunday involving the aviation technicians from El Salvador's Freedom Task Force II, deployed as part of the international Gang Suppression Force, a multinational security mission operating in Haiti.
paras.zh: 此次行动是在周日发生的一次袭击事件之后发生的，涉及萨尔瓦多第二自由特遣部队的航空技术人员，该部队是国际帮派镇压部队的一部分，该部队是在海地执行任务的多国安全部队。

paras.en: The Salvadorans were ambushed in the Santo area of Croix-des-Bouquets, on the outskirts of the Haitian capital, Port-au-Prince.
paras.zh: 萨尔瓦多人在海地首都太子港郊区克罗瓦德布凯的桑托地区遭到伏击。

paras.en: According to security reports, the technicians were returning from a food supply trip when heavily armed gang members opened fire and attacked their armored vehicle with explosives.
paras.zh: 据安全报告称，技术人员从食品供应之旅返回时，全副武装的团伙成员开火并用炸药袭击了他们的装甲车。

paras.en: The Salvadoran personnel managed to escape the vehicle before it was engulfed in flames. However, contact with the four men was lost after they were forced to flee on foot through gang-controlled territory.
paras.zh: 萨尔瓦多人员在车辆被火焰吞没之前设法逃离了车辆。然而，在这四名男子被迫徒步穿越帮派控制的地区后，他们就与他们失去了联系。

paras.en: The incident prompted an international response at United Nations headquarters in New York.
paras.zh: 这一事件引起了纽约联合国总部的国际反应。

paras.en: U.S. Ambassador to the United Nations Mike Waltz condemned the kidnapping and reaffirmed Washington's full support for rescue efforts by Salvadoran forces and their international partners.
paras.zh: 美国驻联合国大使迈克·沃尔兹谴责了这起绑架事件，并重申华盛顿全力支持萨尔瓦多军队及其国际伙伴的营救努力。

paras.en: Speaking before the Security Council, Waltz said intelligence reports suggested the Salvadorans had survived the attack, and he pledged to help bring them home.
paras.zh: 沃尔兹在安理会发言时表示，情报报告显示萨尔瓦多人在袭击中幸存，他承诺帮助他们回家。

paras.en: Waltz also warned the criminal gangs operating in Port-au-Prince that they were making a "terrible mistake" if they believed such attacks would intimidate or force the international security mission to withdraw.
paras.zh: 沃尔兹还警告在太子港活动的犯罪团伙，如果他们认为此类袭击会恐吓或迫使国际安全特派团撤出，他们就犯了“可怕的错误”。

paras.en: On Wednesday afternoon, Haiti's government issued a statement on social media describing the rescue of the Salvadoran personnel as "an absolute priority for state authorities."
paras.zh: 周三下午，海地政府在社交媒体上发表声明，称营救萨尔瓦多人员是“国家当局的绝对优先事项”。

paras.en: "In the face of the seriousness of this act, the state reaffirms its authority and determination. Security forces are firmly continuing their operations to secure the release of the kidnapped soldiers and protect human lives," the Haitian government said.
paras.zh: 海地政府表示：“面对这一行为的严重性，国家重申其权威和决心。安全部队正在坚定地继续开展行动，以确保被绑架的士兵获释并保护人民生命。”

paras.en: The statement was accompanied by a photograph showing Haitian officials meeting to coordinate the government's response.
paras.zh: 该声明附有一张照片，显示海地官员开会协调政府的应对措施。

articles.title: France adds protest restrictions in wake of weekend unrest

paras.en: Oct. 22 (UPI) -- France will only allow protest by authorized unions, French President Emmanuel Macron said Thursday, after violent demonstrations last weekend.
paras.zh: 10月22日（UPI）——法国总统马克龙周四在上周末的暴力示威后表示，法国将只允许授权工会举行抗议活动。

paras.en: Some cities, including Lyon and Nice, made complete bans, but Macron said "illegitimate" protests are banned while unions will have alternative routes to protect businesses.
paras.zh: 包括里昂和尼斯在内的一些城市实施了全面禁令，但马克龙表示，“非法”抗议活动被禁止，而工会将有其他途径来保护企业。

paras.en: Nationwide protests last weekend included about 500,000 people marching against school conditions and the rising cost of living ended in chaos as rioters vandalized buildings and set fires. On Monday, some city leaders around the country imposed curfews to prevent more damage.
paras.zh: 上周末全国范围内的抗议活动包括约 50 万人游行抗议学校条件，以及骚乱者破坏建筑物和纵火，导致生活成本上涨造成混乱。周一，全国一些城市领导人实施宵禁，以防止造成更多损失。

paras.en: Nearly 1,000 police officers were injured and more than 3,000 shops were looted or damaged in the unrest, authorities said. More than 2,500 people were arrested, and courts were speeding trials, The New York Times reported. Investigators were still trying to identify some suspects.
paras.zh: 当局称，骚乱中有近 1,000 名警察受伤，3,000 多家商店被抢劫或损坏。据《纽约时报》报道，超过 2,500 人被捕，法院正在加快审判速度。调查人员仍在试图识别一些嫌疑人。

paras.en: Interior Minister Jean-Didier Berger said police deployments would rise by 20% over last weekend, after the French government was accused of being blindsided by the size of the protests, the BBC reported.
paras.zh: 据英国广播公司 (BBC) 报道，法国政府被指责对抗议活动的规模措手不及，内政部长让-迪迪埃·伯杰 (Jean-Didier Berger) 表示，上周末警察部署将增加 20%。

paras.en: In Lyon, where a tourism office was set on fire, regional authorities created a total ban on protests for the weekend.
paras.zh: 在里昂，一家旅游办公室被纵火，地方当局全面禁止周末举行抗议活动。

paras.en: "In light of the mobilization that is circulating and in view of the events of Oct. 17, the prefect has decided to prohibit by decree any demonstration in the city of Lyon this Saturday," the Rhône prefecture said in a statement.
paras.zh: 罗纳省在一份声明中表示：“鉴于目前的动员情况以及 10 月 17 日发生的事件，省长决定颁布法令，禁止本周六在里昂市举行任何示威活动。”

paras.en: In Limoges, a clock tower and parts of the roof of the city hall were burned and collapsed Saturday.
paras.zh: 周六，利摩日的一座钟楼和市政厅部分屋顶被烧毁并倒塌。

paras.en: In the wake of the protests, French Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez resigned, but Macron rejected his resignation.
paras.zh: 抗议活动爆发后，法国内政部长洛朗·努涅斯辞职，但马克龙拒绝了他的辞职。

articles.title: Cuba rejects U.S. accusations of involvement in Ukraine war

paras.en: Oct. 22 (UPI) -- Cuba rejected U.S. accusations linking Havana to the war in Ukraine, calling the allegations false and unfounded.
paras.zh: 10月22日（合众社）——古巴否认美国将哈瓦那与乌克兰战争联系起来的指控，称这些指控是虚假且毫无根据的。

paras.en: In a statement posted on social media Wednesday, Cuba's Foreign Ministry said the country "is not a party to this conflict, nor does it have military personnel involved there or in any other country."
paras.zh: 古巴外交部周三在社交媒体上发布的一份声明中表示，该国“不是这场冲突的一方，也没有军事人员参与其中或在任何其他国家”。

paras.en: The statement followed remarks by U.S. Ambassador to the United Nations Mike Waltz, who accused the Cuban government of complicity in Russia's war against Ukraine during events this week in New York.
paras.zh: 在此声明之前，美国驻联合国大使迈克·沃尔兹发表了讲话，他在本周纽约举行的活动中指责古巴政府在俄罗斯对乌克兰的战争中串通一气。

paras.en: Waltz criticized European delegations for supporting Cuba in its opposition to the U.S. economic embargo, contending that Havana actively backs Russia's invasion of Ukraine.
paras.zh: 瓦尔兹批评欧洲代表团支持古巴反对美国经济封锁，认为哈瓦那积极支持俄罗斯入侵乌克兰。

paras.en: He also accused Cuban authorities of allowing mercenaries from the island to fight in Ukraine as "cannon fodder" for Moscow.
paras.zh: 他还指责古巴当局允许古巴雇佣军作为莫斯科的“炮灰”前往乌克兰作战。

paras.en: Cuba's Foreign Ministry rejected Washington's allegations, describing them as part of a coordinated disinformation campaign aimed at misleading and manipulating international public opinion about the principles guiding Cuban foreign policy.
paras.zh: 古巴外交部拒绝了华盛顿的指控，称这些指控是协调一致的虚假信息运动的一部分，旨在误导和操纵国际公众对指导古巴外交政策原则的舆论。

paras.en: The dispute comes after Ukraine accused Russia this week at the United Nations of recruiting large numbers of Cuban citizens for its military.
paras.zh: 这场争端是在乌克兰本周在联合国指责俄罗斯为其军队招募大量古巴公民之后发生的。

paras.en: According to Ukraine's delegation, more than 1,000 Cubans signed contracts with the Russian military between 2023 and 2025, making Cuban nationals one of the four largest groups of foreign recruits serving in Russian forces.
paras.zh: 据乌克兰代表团称，2023年至2025年间，有超过1000名古巴人与俄罗斯军队签署了合同，使古巴国民成为在俄罗斯军队服役的四大外国新兵群体之一。

paras.en: Addressing reports of Cuban citizens fighting in Ukraine, the Foreign Ministry denied any involvement by the Cuban government.
paras.zh: 针对有关古巴公民在乌克兰作战的报道，外交部否认古巴政府参与其中。

paras.en: According to the statement, those involved were recruited abroad by organizations with no ties to Cuban government institutions.
paras.zh: 声明称，涉案人员是由与古巴政府机构没有关系的组织在国外招募的。

paras.en: The ministry pointed to domestic investigations and criminal prosecutions targeting international human trafficking networks involved in military recruitment as evidence of its position.
paras.zh: 该部指出，针对参与征兵的国际人口贩运网络的国内调查和刑事起诉可以作为其立场的证据。

paras.en: Cuba reiterated its "zero tolerance" policy toward mercenary activity, reporting that prosecutors and courts have investigated 17 cases related to the offense since 2023.
paras.zh: 古巴重申其对雇佣军活动的“零容忍”政策，并报告称，自2023年以来，检察官和法院已调查了17起与该罪行有关的案件。

paras.en: Those investigations have resulted in charges against 49 people, the vast majority of whom have already received prison sentences, according to the ministry.
paras.zh: 据该部称，这些调查已对 49 人提出指控，其中绝大多数已被判入狱。

paras.en: The Cuban government also reaffirmed its support for a peaceful, diplomatic and negotiated resolution to the war in Ukraine through constructive dialogue among the parties involved.
paras.zh: 古巴政府还重申支持有关各方通过建设性对话以和平、外交和谈判方式解决乌克兰战争。

paras.en: The exchange of accusations comes ahead of the U.N. General Assembly's annual debate Tuesday and Wednesday, when member states are scheduled to vote on a nonbinding resolution calling for an end to the U.S. economic embargo against Cuba.
paras.zh: 双方相互指责是在周二和周三举行的联合国大会年度辩论之前进行的，届时成员国计划就一项不具约束力的决议进行投票，呼吁结束美国对古巴的经济封锁。

paras.en: At a news conference in Havana on Wednesday, Cuban Foreign Minister Bruno Rodríguez Parrilla accused the United States of conducting a campaign of "extreme and unprecedented pressure" and political blackmail against several U.N. member states.
paras.zh: 周三在哈瓦那举行的新闻发布会上，古巴外交部长布鲁诺·罗德里格斯·帕里利亚指责美国对几个联合国成员国进行“极端和前所未有的压力”和政治勒索。

paras.en: According to Havana, Washington has used coercive measures, including threats of tariffs, visa restrictions on diplomats and the cancellation of international cooperation programs, to pressure countries into changing their votes or withdrawing their longstanding support for Cuba's resolution.
paras.zh: 据哈瓦那称，华盛顿采取了强制措施，包括关税威胁、对外交官签证限制和取消国际合作项目，迫使各国改变投票或撤回对古巴决议的长期支持。

articles.title: Phoebe Bridgers to Make Her ‘SNL’ Return as Musical Guest on John Mulaney-Hosted Episode
articles.author: Hannah Dailey

paras.en: Phoebe Bridgers won’t be having a lost weekend halfway through November, as the indie-rock star is all booked up for a return as musical guest on the Nov. 14 episode of Saturday Night Live hosted by John Mulaney.
paras.zh: 菲比·布里杰斯 (Phoebe Bridgers) 不会在 11 月中旬度过一个失落的周末，因为这位独立摇滚明星已被安排在 11 月 14 日由约翰·穆拉尼 (John Mulaney) 主持的《周六夜现场》节目中作为音乐嘉宾回归。

paras.en: NBC announced the news on Thursday (Oct. 22), revealing that in addition to Bridgers and the stand-up comedian, 30 Rock will soon welcome The Strokes as musical guests on the Nov. 7 Druski-hosted episode. As previously revealed, the week before that will feature Obsession star Inde Navarrette hosting and Gracie Abrams performing on the heels of Billboard 200-topping album Daughter From Hell.
paras.zh: NBC 于周四（10 月 22 日）宣布了这一消息，透露除了 Bridgers 和这位单口喜剧演员外，30 Rock 很快还将迎来 The Strokes 作为音乐嘉宾，出现在 11 月 7 日由 Druski 主持的节目中。正如之前透露的那样，在那之前的一周，Obsession 明星 Inde Navarrette 将主持节目，Gracie Abrams 将在 Billboard 200 榜首专辑《Daughter From Hell》之后进行表演。

paras.en: The boygenius artist — whose new album Lost Weekend debuted at No. 2 on the U.S. albums chart — has previously been on SNL, making headlines in 2021 for smashing her guitar to pieces while singing “Kyoto” on the program. Mulaney is a seasoned veteran, with the Nov. 14 installment set to mark his seventh time hosting.
paras.zh: 这位boygenius艺术家的新专辑《Lost Weekend》首次亮相就在美国专辑榜上排名第二，她此前曾登上过《周六夜现场》(SNL)，并因在节目中演唱《京都》时将吉他砸碎而成为2021年的头条新闻。 Mulaney 是一位经验丰富的老手，11 月 14 日的分期付款将标志着他第七次主持。

paras.en: Druski, however, is new to the gig, as Nov. 7 will mark his hosting debut. The Strokes will be able to show him around, though, as the rock band has served as musical guests four times already.
paras.zh: 然而，Druski 是一位新人，11 月 7 日将是他首次主持。不过，The Strokes 乐队将能够带他到处参观，因为这支摇滚乐队已经四次担任音乐嘉宾了。

paras.en: The updates come shortly after SNL drew controversy for its most recent episode on Oct. 10, which featured Rosalía as musical guest and Shane Gillis as host. His opening monologue sparked immediate backlash for including derogatory comments about women’s gym attire, something stars such as Maren Morris and Flavor Flav blasted online in the days that followed.
paras.zh: 此前不久，SNL 于 10 月 10 日播出的最新一集罗莎莉亚担任音乐嘉宾，肖恩·吉利斯担任主持人，引发了争议。他的开场独白因包含对女性健身服装的贬义言论而立即引发强烈反对，马伦·莫里斯和弗莱弗·弗拉夫等明星在接下来的几天里在网上对此进行了猛烈抨击。

paras.en: SNL is currently three episodes deep into its 52nd season, which kicked off in September with an episode helmed by Jalen Brunson that featured KATSEYE on the music stage. The following week, Dakota Johnson hosted and Turnstile served as music guest.
paras.zh: SNL 目前已进入第 52 季的三集，该季于 9 月开始，其中一集由 Jalen Brunson 执导，其中 KATSEYE 出现在音乐舞台上。接下来的一周，达科塔·约翰逊主持，特恩斯泰尔担任音乐嘉宾。

articles.title: The Highest Grossing Latin Tours in Billboard Boxscore History
articles.author: Eric Frankenberg

paras.en: Over the course of Billboard Boxscore’s 40-year history, Latin music artists have made their mark on stage with sold-out tours across the Americas. Here, Billboard is running down the 10 highest grossing concert tours by Latin acts — here, defined by artists eligible for Billboard’s Top Latin Albums and Hot Latin Songs charts — in the Boxscore archives.
paras.zh: 在 Billboard Boxscore 40 年的历史中，拉丁音乐艺术家在美洲各地的巡演中都在舞台上留下了满座的门票。在这里，Billboard 列出了 Boxscore 档案中拉丁艺人收入最高的 10 场巡回演唱会——这里是由有资格进入 Billboard 顶级拉丁专辑和热门拉丁歌曲排行榜的艺术家定义的。

paras.en: After decades of growth, Luis Miguel became the first Latin artist to gross more than $100 million on a single tour, reaching a new peak on the Mexico Por Siempre Tour in 2018-19. But while Miguel opened the doors, a flood of acts broke down the walls with outsized post-pandemic treks.
paras.zh: 经过数十年的成长，路易斯·米格尔成为首位单次巡演收入超过 1 亿美元的拉丁艺术家，并在 2018-19 年的墨西哥 Por Siempre 巡演中达到新的巅峰。但当米格尔打开大门时，大量的活动打破了围墙，在大流行后进行了大规模的徒步旅行。

paras.en: Fifteen more Latin tours have crossed the $100 million threshold since 2022, with three of them continuing throughout 2026 and into 2027. The top of the list is a showdown between two of this year’s tours, each selling out stadiums on multiple continents.
paras.zh: 自 2022 年以来，又有 15 场拉丁巡演突破了 1 亿美元大关，其中 3 场将持续到 2026 年至 2027 年。排名第一的是今年两场巡演之间的对决，每场巡演都售罄了多个大洲的体育场馆。

paras.en: Due to inflation and an explosive ticketing market, it makes sense that recent tours are topping the revenue-based list. But beyond those general economic factors, Latin music has gone through explosive growth in the 2020s. Reggaeton, pop and regional Mexican artists have broken ground on cross-genre charts such as the Billboard 200 and Billboard Hot 100, not to mention the Billboard Global 200 and Billboard Global Excl. U.S. tallies. Likewise, they have joined classic rock bands, pop stars and rappers among the most successful touring acts.
paras.zh: 由于通货膨胀和票务市场的爆炸性增长，最近的巡演在收入排行榜上名列前茅是有道理的。但除了这些一般经济因素之外，拉丁音乐在 2020 年代经历了爆炸性增长。雷鬼、流行音乐和墨西哥地方艺术家在跨流派排行榜上取得了突破，例如 Billboard 200 和 Billboard Hot 100，更不用说 Billboard Global 200 和 Billboard Global Excl. 了。美国统计。同样，他们也加入了经典摇滚乐队、流行歌星和说唱歌手的行列，跻身最成功的巡回演出行列。

paras.en: Not only are the highest grossing Latin tours from the last few years, but so are the bestselling Latin tours in Boxscore history. Ten tours by eight different acts have sold more than 1 million tickets, while no pre-pandemic Latin tour had crossed the seven-digit threshold.
paras.zh: 不仅是过去几年票房最高的拉丁巡演，而且也是 Boxscore 历史上最畅销的拉丁巡演。八个不同乐队的十场巡演已售出超过 100 万张门票，而疫情前的拉丁巡演门票销量尚未突破七位数。

paras.zh: 请阅读下面 Billboard Boxscore 历史上 10 个票房最高的拉丁巡演。此列表基于截至 2026 年 10 月 22 日向 Billboard Boxscore 报告的数据。
