articles.author: Jillian Kestler-D'Amours

paras.en: EU awards human rights prize to International Criminal Court amid Trump attacks
paras.zh: 欧盟在特朗普攻击中向国际刑事法院颁发人权奖

paras.en: ICC says Sakharov Prize particularly significant in face of 'unprecedented challenges'
paras.zh: 国际刑事法院称萨哈罗夫奖在面对“前所未有的挑战”时尤为重要

paras.en: The European Union has awarded its top human rights prize to the International Criminal Court (ICC), the international tribunal in The Hague that has come under attack from U.S. President Donald Trump's administration.
paras.zh: 欧盟将最高人权奖授予位于海牙的国际刑事法院（ICC），该法庭受到美国总统唐纳德·特朗普政府的攻击。

paras.en: The European Parliament announced on Thursday that it was awarding the 2026 Sakharov Prize for Freedom of Thought to the ICC and its officials.
paras.zh: 欧洲议会周四宣布，将 2026 年萨哈罗夫思想自由奖授予国际刑事法院及其官员。

paras.en: The decision "recognizes the Court's important work in upholding international law and justice," Roberta Metsola, president of the European Parliament, said in a written statement.
paras.zh: 欧洲议会主席罗伯塔·梅索拉在一份书面声明中表示，这一裁决“认可了法院在维护国际法和正义方面所做的重要工作”。

paras.en: Established by the Rome Statute, the ICC investigates and tries individuals accused of serious violations of international law, including genocide and crimes against humanity.
paras.zh: 国际刑事法院根据《罗马规约》设立，负责调查和审判被控严重违反国际法（包括种族灭绝罪和反人类罪）的个人。

paras.en: It has faced a widening pressure campaign from the Trump administration, which has accused the court of seeking to try Americans as well as U.S. allies.
paras.zh: 它面临着来自特朗普政府不断扩大的压力，特朗普政府指责该法院试图审判美国人以及美国的盟友。

paras.en: While the United States is not a party to the Rome Statute, the ICC can investigate alleged crimes that are committed in countries that are state parties — and it opened a probe in 2020 into U.S. personnel in Afghanistan.
paras.zh: 虽然美国不是《罗马规约》的缔约国，但国际刑事法院可以调查在缔约国境内犯下的涉嫌犯罪行为，并于 2020 年对驻阿富汗的美国人员展开调查。

paras.en: In 2024, the ICC also issued arrest warrants for Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and former defence minister Yoav Gallant for alleged crimes against humanity and war crimes in Gaza. Israel has rejected those allegations.
paras.zh: 2024年，国际刑事法院还对以色列总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡和前国防部长约夫·加兰特发出逮捕令，罪名是涉嫌在加沙犯下反人类罪和战争罪。以色列否认了这些指控。

paras.en: Since then, the Trump administration has imposed several rounds of sanctions on the ICC and some of its judges.
paras.zh: 此后，特朗普政府对国际刑事法院及其部分法官实施了多轮制裁。

paras.en: U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio said the latest curbs, issued on Oct. 9, were aimed at "crippling" the court's "ability to operate."
paras.zh: 美国国务卿马可·卢比奥表示，10 月 9 日发布的最新限制措施旨在“削弱”法院的“运作能力”。

paras.en: "Our message is clear: The United States and its people are not subject to the jurisdiction of the ICC," Rubio said at the time. "Either the ICC will end its threats or we will end the ICC."
paras.zh: 卢比奥当时表示：“我们的信息很明确：美国及其人民不受国际刑事法院的管辖。” “要么国际刑事法院结束其威胁，要么我们结束国际刑事法院。”

paras.en: The ICC denounced the measures as "an attempt to obstruct the course of justice" and "an assault on the rule of law."
paras.zh: 国际刑事法院谴责这些措施是“企图妨碍司法公正”和“对法治的攻击”。

paras.en: European prize 'carries particular significance'
paras.zh: 欧洲奖项“具有特殊意义”

paras.en: Thursday's award marks the second time this month that the ICC and those affiliated with the court have been recognized for their work.
paras.zh: 周四的奖项标志着国际刑事法院及其附属机构本月第二次因其工作而获得认可。

paras.en: On Oct. 9, the same day that the U.S. announced its latest sanctions, the Nobel Peace Prize was awarded to Navi Pillay, a former ICC judge and human rights expert.
paras.zh: 10月9日，就在美国宣布最新制裁的同一天，诺贝尔和平奖被授予前国际刑事法院法官、人权专家纳维·皮莱。

paras.en: The ICC welcomed the prize from the European Parliament, saying it comes at a time of "unprecedented challenges."
paras.zh: 国际刑事法院对欧洲议会授予该奖项表示欢迎，称该奖项是在“前所未有的挑战”之际颁发的。

paras.en: "Against this backdrop, the Sakharov Prize carries particular significance, reaffirming the importance of independent judicial institutions and of those who work to uphold international law," it said.
paras.zh: 声明称：“在此背景下，萨哈罗夫奖具有特殊意义，它重申了独立司法机构和那些致力于维护国际法的人的重要性。”

paras.en: Named after Soviet dissident Andrei Sakharov, the prize is awarded annually to groups or individuals working in defence of human rights.
paras.zh: 该奖项以苏联持不同政见者安德烈·萨哈罗夫的名字命名，每年颁发给致力于捍卫人权的团体或个人。

articles.title: U.S. charges 82-year-old Virginia Democratic lawmaker in alleged drug scheme

paras.en: U.S. charges 82-year-old Virginia Democratic lawmaker in alleged drug scheme
paras.zh: 美国指控 82 岁弗吉尼亚州民主党议员涉嫌贩毒

paras.en: Prosecutors accuse state Senator L. Louise Lucas of running illegal cannabis business
paras.zh: 检察官指控州参议员 L. Louise Lucas 经营非法大麻业务

paras.en: One of the most powerful Democrats in the U.S. state of Virginia has been charged in connection with what federal authorities allege was a role leading a wide-ranging criminal enterprise that acquired and distributed large quantities of marijuana and laundered the proceeds.
paras.zh: 美国弗吉尼亚州最有权势的民主党人之一被指控涉嫌领导一个范围广泛的犯罪企业，该企业收购和分销大量大麻并洗钱。

paras.en: Virginia state Senator L. Louise Lucas, 82, who has been in elected office for decades, used her political power to insulate the operation from scrutiny, according to an indictment Thursday charging her and six other defendants, including several of her relatives.
paras.zh: 根据周四的起诉书，82 岁的弗吉尼亚州参议员路易斯·卢卡斯 (L. Louise Lucas) 已担任民选公职数十年，她利用自己的政治权力使这一行动免受审查。起诉书周四指控她和其他六名被告，其中包括她的几名亲属。

paras.en: She "put her own financial interests before the people she was elected to serve," said U.S. Attorney General Todd Blanche, who spoke at a news conference with FBI Director Kash Patel.
paras.zh: 美国司法部长托德·布兰奇在与联邦调查局局长卡什·帕特尔举行的新闻发布会上发表讲话时表示，她“将自己的经济利益置于她当选服务的人民​​之上”。

paras.en: Lucas surrendered, a Justice Department spokesperson said, and was expected to make an initial appearance in federal court on Thursday afternoon.
paras.zh: 司法部发言人表示，卢卡斯已投案自首，预计将于周四下午在联邦法院首次出庭。

paras.en: - Ohio's Vivek Ramaswamy slammed for 'revolting' campaign ad featuring opponent's estranged mother
paras.zh: - 俄亥俄州的维韦克·拉马斯瓦米因以对手疏远的母亲为主角的“令人反感”的竞选广告而受到猛烈抨击

paras.en: - Podcast How Canada and tariffs are factoring into U.S. midterm elections
paras.zh: - 播客加拿大和关税如何影响美国中期选举

paras.en: The indictment comes less than two weeks before the November midterm elections, which will determine control of the U.S. Congress, though Lucas and other members of the Virginia state senate are not up for re-election this year.
paras.zh: 该起诉书距离 11 月中期选举不到两周，中期选举将决定美国国会的控制权，尽管卢卡斯和弗吉尼亚州参议院的其他成员今年不会参加连任。

paras.en: The Justice Department under President Donald Trump has repeatedly investigated and, in some cases, prosecuted prominent critics of the Republican president, and the department faced criticism for raiding Democratic Rep. Ilhan Omar's home last week.
paras.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统领导下的司法部多次进行调查，在某些情况下还起诉了这位共和党总统的著名批评者，该部门上周因突袭民主党众议员伊尔汗·奥马尔的家而受到批评。

paras.en: U.S. Attorney General Todd Blanche answers questions during a press conference announcing Thursday's indictment in Norfolk, Va. (Steve Helber/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 美国司法部长托德·布兰奇在弗吉尼亚州诺福克举行的周四宣布起诉书的新闻发布会上回答问题。（史蒂夫·赫尔伯/美联社）

paras.en: Blanche said the investigation into Lucas has been ongoing for several years, rejecting suggestions that it was politically motivated.
paras.zh: 布兰奇表示，对卢卡斯的调查已经持续了好几年，并否认调查出于政治动机。

paras.en: "The charges listed in the indictment reflect the alleged behaviour of a public servant who put her own financial interests before the people she was elected to serve," Blanche said during Thursday's news conference.
paras.zh: 布兰奇在周四的新闻发布会上说：“起诉书中列出的指控反映了一名公务员的行为，她将自己的经济利益置于她当选服务的人民​​之上。”

paras.en: The charges, including drug trafficking and money laundering, came after the FBI searched Lucas's hometown office and a cannabis shop in which she has a stake in May.
paras.zh: 联邦调查局五月份搜查了卢卡斯家乡的办公室和她持有股份的一家大麻店后，提出了包括贩毒和洗钱在内的指控。

paras.en: At the time of the search, Lucas — who has been a vocal critic of the Trump administration — characterized it as an attempt to intimidate her.
paras.zh: 在搜查时，一直直言不讳地批评特朗普政府的卢卡斯将其描述为试图恐吓她。

paras.en: "This is the circus we always expected it to be, and we will wait for further details to have a more specific response," said Brian Woolfolk, chief counsel for the L. Louise Lucas Legal Defense Fund.
paras.zh: “这就是我们一直期待的马戏团，我们将等待更多细节，以便做出更具体的回应，”L. Louise Lucas 法律辩护基金首席顾问布莱恩·沃尔福克 (Brian Woolfolk) 说。

paras.en: A statement attributed to Lucas posted on her social media account did not directly address the substance of the charges but said Thursday's actions amounted to the federal government wielding its "full weight" against a great-grandmother.
paras.zh: 卢卡斯在其社交媒体账户上发布的一份声明并未直接提及指控的实质内容，但表示周四的行动相当于联邦政府对曾祖母“全力以赴”。

paras.en: "I will not be intimidated. I will not be bullied. And I will not back down," Lucas said in the statement.
paras.zh: “我不会被吓倒。我不会被欺负。我不会退缩，”卢卡斯在声明中说。

paras.en: Lucas, who has served since 1992 in the Virginia state senate, says she 'will not be intimidated.' (Steve Helber/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 卢卡斯自 1992 年以来一直在弗吉尼亚州参议院任职，她说她“不会被吓倒”。 （史蒂夫·赫尔伯/美联社）

paras.en: The brash lawmaker has spent decades ascending the ranks of Virginia politics and has served since 1992 in the state senate, where she is the president pro tempore, overseeing the chamber in the lieutenant governor's absence.
paras.zh: 这位傲慢的议员花了几十年的时间在弗吉尼亚政坛不断晋升，自 1992 年以来一直在州参议院任职，她是该州的临时议长，在副州长缺席期间监督众议院。

paras.en: She also leads the powerful senate finance committee, through which all legislation with any budget impact must flow.
paras.zh: 她还领导着强大的参议院财务委员会，所有影响预算的立法都必须通过该委员会。

paras.en: Lucas has been a leading voice in Democrats' ultimately failed attempt to redistrict the state's congressional map this year, a bid to hedge against Republican efforts in other states to redraw maps for their advantage in midterm elections.
paras.zh: 卢卡斯一直是民主党今年重新划分该州国会地图的尝试最终失败的主要声音，此举旨在对冲其他州共和党为中期选举中的优势而重新绘制地图的努力。

articles.title: Are Europeans putting profits over human rights in Vietnam?

paras.en: Vietnam's Communist Party chief and president, To Lam, arrived in Brussels on Wednesday for an official visit to the European Union (EU) and Belgium in another sign of a relationship that continues to grow.
paras.zh: 越南共产党中央委员会主席兼国家主席苏林周三抵达布鲁塞尔，对欧盟和比利时进行正式访问，这是两国关系持续发展的又一迹象。

paras.en: The visit comes just days after Vietnam signed a free trade agreement with the European Free Trade Association (EFTA), comprising Norway, Switzerland, Iceland and Liechtenstein.
paras.zh: 此次访问是在越南与由挪威、瑞士、冰岛和列支敦士登组成的欧洲自由贸易联盟（EFTA）签署自由贸易协定几天后进行的。

paras.en: Trade ties between Vietnam and Europe have deepened in recent years. The EU-Vietnam Free Trade Agreement (EVFTA), which took effect in August 2020, substantially expanded Vietnam's commercial ties with most European states.
paras.zh: 近年来，越南与欧洲的贸易关系不断深化。 2020年8月生效的欧盟-越南自由贸易协定（EVFTA）大大扩大了越南与大多数欧洲国家的商业关系。

paras.en: "This is a win-win for both sides," he added. "Vietnam offers Europe an established manufacturing base and another foothold in Asian supply chains. Europe offers Vietnam capital, technology and a large market, helping Hanoi reduce its exposure to American demand and Chinese industrial inputs."
paras.zh: “这对双方来说都是双赢，”他补充道。 “越南为欧洲提供了一个成熟的制造基地和亚洲供应链中的另一个立足点。欧洲为越南提供了资本、技术和广阔的市场，帮助河内减少对美国需求和中国工业投入的影响。”

paras.en: Vietnam is now the EU's largest goods-trading partner in Southeast Asia and its 14th-largest globally. The EU is Vietnam's fourth-largest trading partner and a major source of foreign investment.
paras.zh: 越南目前是欧盟在东南亚最大的货物贸易伙伴，也是全球第14大货物贸易伙伴。欧盟是越南第四大贸易伙伴和主要外资来源地。

paras.en: Non-economic relations are also advancing. In January, both sides upgraded ties to a Comprehensive Strategic Partnership — the first such agreement between the EU and a Southeast Asian country.
paras.zh: 非经济关系也在不断发展。一月份，双方将关系升级为全面战略伙伴关系，这是欧盟与东南亚国家之间的首个此类协议。

paras.en: Vietnam has also become a key strategic partner for the EU in the Indo-Pacific, Alfred Gerstl, an expert on Indo-Pacific international relations at the University of Vienna, told DW.
paras.zh: 维也纳大学印太国际关系专家阿尔弗雷德·格斯特尔向德国之声表示，越南也已成为欧盟在印太地区的重要战略伙伴。

paras.en: "The cooperation is crucial for advancing the EU's economic security agenda and its strategy of de-risking from China," he added, referring to Brussels' efforts to diversify its supply chains and reduce dependence on Chinese manufacturing.
paras.zh: 他补充说：“这种合作对于推进欧盟的经济安全议程及其消除中国风险的战略至关重要。”他指的是布鲁塞尔为实现供应链多元化和减少对中国制造业依赖所做的努力。

paras.en: Several European states have signed defense agreements with Vietnam, while EU foreign policy chief Kaja Kallas held talks with Foreign Minister Le Hoai Trung on Wednesday to discuss ways to improve security cooperation, including in the South China Sea, where Hanoi is locked in territorial disputes with China.
paras.zh: 几个欧洲国家已与越南签署了防务协议，欧盟外交政策负责人卡贾·卡拉斯周三与外交部长黎怀忠举行会谈，讨论改善安全合作的方法，包括在南海问题上的合作，河内与中国在南海存在领土争端。

paras.en: Concerns over Vietnam's human rights record
paras.zh: 对越南人权记录的担忧

paras.en: However, the relationship has also faced difficulties. Questions remain over whether European companies are benefiting sufficiently from Vietnam's economic boom and whether Brussels is overlooking Hanoi's worsening human rights record.
paras.zh: 然而，两国关系也面临困难。欧洲公司是否从越南经济繁荣中充分受益，以及布鲁塞尔是否忽视了河内日益恶化的人权记录，这些问题仍然存在。

paras.en: Vietnam remains a one-party communist state that severely restricts political opposition, independent journalism and civil society. Rights organizations say repression has intensified under To Lam, who previously headed the country's powerful public security ministry.
paras.zh: 越南仍然是一个一党共产主义国家，严格限制政治反对派、独立新闻业和公民社会。人权组织表示，在曾领导该国强大的公安部的杜林领导下，镇压加剧。

paras.en: In an open letter sent this week to European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen and European Council President Antonio Costa, 12 international human rights organizations raised "grave concerns over the Vietnamese government's intensifying repression" and urged EU leaders to demand meaningful reforms.
paras.zh: 在本周致欧盟委员会主席乌苏拉·冯德莱恩和欧洲理事会主席安东尼奥·科斯塔的一封公开信中，12个国际人权组织“对越南政府加强镇压表示严重关切”，并敦促欧盟领导人要求进行有意义的改革。

paras.en: When negotiating the EVFTA and the accompanying political agreements, Hanoi agreed to obligations on human rights, labor protections and environmental standards.
paras.zh: 在谈判EVFTA及相关政治协议时，河内同意承担人权、劳工保护和环境标准方面的义务。

paras.en: These included commitments to reform labor legislation to permit independent worker organizations and align domestic regulations more closely with International Labour Organization (ILO) standards.
paras.zh: 其中包括改革劳动立法的承诺，以允许独立的工人组织并使国内法规更紧密地与国际劳工组织（ILO）标准保持一致。

paras.en: However, rights groups argue that Hanoi has failed to deliver. Vietnam has still not ratified the ILO convention on freedom of association, and independent trade unions remain prohibited.
paras.zh: 然而，人权组织认为河内未能兑现承诺。越南尚未批准国际劳工组织关于结社自由的公约，独立工会仍然被禁止。

paras.en: "The EU has taken no action in response to Vietnam's repeated breaches of its EVFTA-related obligations and pledges; instead, in January it upgraded bilateral relations," the joint letter read.
paras.zh: 联合信中写道：“欧盟没有对越南一再违反其EVFTA相关义务和承诺采取任何行动；相反，它在一月份升级了双边关系。”

paras.en: There are also questions about which Vietnamese companies have benefited most from the EU's trade liberalization.
paras.zh: 还有一个问题是哪些越南企业从欧盟贸易自由化中受益最多。

paras.en: Large foreign-invested manufacturers and established exporters have been better placed to exploit tariff reductions than smaller domestic businesses, which often lack the resources to navigate Europe's complex import requirements.
paras.zh: 大型外资制造商和老牌出口商比小型国内企业更能利用关税削减，而小型国内企业往往缺乏资源来应对欧洲复杂的进口要求。

paras.en: Vietnamese exporters also face growing demands from the EU's Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism and its deforestation regulations, which require businesses in affected sectors to provide more detailed information about their production processes and supply chains.
paras.zh: 越南出口商还面临欧盟碳边境调整机制及其森林砍伐法规日益增长的要求，这些要求受影响行业的企业提供有关其生产流程和供应链的更详细信息。

paras.en: "It is quite clear that the EVFTA's benefits have been distributed unevenly across sectors, firms, and social groups, while political, regulatory, and economic challenges may complicate the next phase of the relationship," Hai Thiem Bui, a researcher at the Stockholm Center for Global Asia, Stockholm University, told DW.
paras.zh: 斯德哥尔摩大学斯德哥尔摩全球亚洲中心研究员海蒂姆·裴（Hai Thiem Bui）对德国之声表示：“很明显，EVFTA的好处在各部门、企业和社会群体之间分配不均，而政治、监管和经济挑战可能会使下一阶段的关系变得复杂。”

paras.en: "The next phase of EU-Vietnam trade relations is likely to depend less on tariff liberalization and more on whether Vietnam can adapt to increasingly demanding EU standards concerning labor rights, sustainability, and regulatory governance," he added.
paras.zh: 他补充说：“欧盟与越南贸易关系的下一阶段可能不太依赖关税自由化，而更多地依赖于越南是否能够适应欧盟在劳工权利、可持续性和监管治理方面日益严格的标准。”

paras.en: Another challenge concerns how much European businesses are gaining from Vietnam's expanding export economy.
paras.zh: 另一个挑战涉及欧洲企业从越南不断扩大的出口经济中获益多少。

paras.en: Although the EVFTA has considerably strengthened bilateral commerce, it has been far more successful at increasing Vietnamese exports to Europe than European sales to Vietnam.
paras.zh: 尽管EVFTA大大加强了双边贸易，但它在增加越南对欧洲的出口方面比欧洲对越南的出口要成功得多。

paras.en: The EU's goods-trade deficit with Vietnam reached €51.7 billion ($57.9 billion) in 2025, up from roughly €24 billion in 2019.
paras.zh: 到 2025 年，欧盟对越南的货物贸易逆差将达到 517 亿欧元（579 亿美元），高于 2019 年的约 240 亿欧元。

paras.en: This imbalance is becoming more conspicuous as Brussels seeks greater economic security and new export opportunities for European industries.
paras.zh: 随着布鲁塞尔寻求更大的经济安全和欧洲工业新的出口机会，这种不平衡变得更加明显。

paras.en: Another obstacle is the EU-Vietnam Investment Protection Agreement, signed in 2019, which has still not entered into force.
paras.zh: 另一个障碍是2019年签署的欧盟-越南投资保护协定，目前尚未生效。

paras.en: "We have also seen an uptick in investments by European businesses in Vietnam, despite the lack of an Investment Protection Agreement being in place," Chris Humphrey, executive director of the EU-ASEAN Business Council, told DW.
paras.zh: 欧盟-东盟商业理事会执行董事克里斯·汉弗莱（Chris Humphrey）对德国之声表示：“尽管没有签署投资保护协议，但我们也看到欧洲企业在越南的投资有所增加。”

paras.en: Germany ratified it in February and Poland followed in April, but France, the Netherlands and several other member states have yet to complete ratification.
paras.zh: 德国于二月批准了该公约，波兰随后于四月批准了该公约，但法国、荷兰和其他几个成员国尚未完成批准。

paras.en: The agreement will strengthen legal protections for investors and establish a permanent mechanism for resolving investment disputes, potentially encouraging greater European investment in Vietnam.
paras.zh: 该协议将加强对投资者的法律保护，并建立解决投资争端的永久性机制，有可能鼓励欧洲加大对越南的投资。

paras.en: "With a new government in Vietnam pursuing an ambitious legislative program but with an overall target of maintaining Vietnam's extraordinary growth path, we would expect trade to continue to flourish," Humphrey said.
paras.zh: 汉弗莱说：“越南新政府正在推行雄心勃勃的立法计划，但总体目标是保持越南非凡的增长道路，我们预计贸易将继续蓬勃发展。”

paras.en: "That said, many European businesses are looking carefully at what the legislative program may bring in terms of reform," he added.
paras.zh: “话虽如此，许多欧洲企业正在仔细研究立法计划可能带来的改革，”他补充道。

paras.en: For Brussels, the next phase of relations is about ensuring that European businesses benefit from that growth, while demonstrating that its commitments to human rights and sustainable trade are more than diplomatic promises.
paras.zh: 对于布鲁塞尔来说，下一阶段的关系是确保欧洲企业从增长中受益，同时表明其对人权和可持续贸易的承诺不仅仅是外交承诺。

articles.title: Is Iran ready for another major US attack after midterm elections?

paras.en: Officials in Tehran are preparing for renewed strikes
paras.zh: 德黑兰官员正在为新一轮罢工做准备

paras.en: following media reports that the United States and Israel have been examining new options for escalating their war against Iran.
paras.zh: 此前有媒体报道称，美国和以色列一直在研究升级对伊朗战争的新选择。

paras.en: The US midterm elections on November 3 and Israel's October 27 election have injected a political factor into how both countries are approaching the conflict, which they launched in late February.
paras.zh: 11 月 3 日的美国中期选举和 10 月 27 日以色列的选举为两国如何应对 2 月底发起的冲突注入了政治因素。

paras.en: Polls show that high energy prices brought on by the Iran war are hurting Donald Trump's Republican Party. On October 8, the president posted on social media that the United States would not attack Iran before the midterms, citing "productive discussions" with Tehran. The United States last launched strikes on Iran in early September.
paras.zh: 民意调查显示，伊朗战争带来的高能源价格正在损害唐纳德·特朗普领导的共和党。 10月8日，总统在社交媒体上发帖称，美国不会在中期选举前攻击伊朗，并称与德黑兰进行了“富有成效的讨论”。美国上次对伊朗发动打击是在九月初。

paras.en: After the elections are over, however, Trump may feel less politically constrained.
paras.zh: 然而，选举结束后，特朗普可能会感到政治上的限制减少了。

paras.en: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has campaigned on a platform of regime change in Iran.
paras.zh: 以色列总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡以伊朗政权更迭为竞选纲领。

paras.en: Report: Plans in place for 'short' US-Israeli operation
paras.zh: 报告：美以“短期”行动计划已到位

paras.en: Citing senior US officials the New York Times reported on Wednesday that the United States and Israel have "developed specific plans" for a "short but intensive operation" in Iran that would include targets such as nuclear facilities, energy infrastructure, and the country's arsenal of missiles and drones.
paras.zh: 《纽约时报》周三援引美国高级官员的话说，美国和以色列已经“制定了具体计划”，在伊朗进行“短期但密集的行动”，其中包括核设施、能源基础设施以及该国的导弹和无人机武库等目标。

paras.en: One official told the newspaper that the goal would be to force Iran into making "diplomatic concessions" by further weakening its economy, as negotiations to end the conflict have gone nowhere. The United States has also maintained a blockade of Iranian oil exports in the Strait of Hormuz that has sapped Tehran's oil revenues.
paras.zh: 一名官员告诉该报，目标是通过进一步削弱伊朗经济来迫使伊朗做出“外交让步”，因为结束冲突的谈判毫无进展。美国还维持对霍尔木兹海峡伊朗石油出口的封锁，这削弱了德黑兰的石油收入。

paras.en: Other outlets have reported similar plans in recent weeks. In early October, Axios reported that the Pentagon has instructed US Central Command "to conclude preparations for resuming major combat operations in Iran."
paras.zh: 最近几周，其他媒体也报道了类似的计划。 10月初，Axios报道称，五角大楼已指示美国中央司令部“完成在伊朗恢复重大作战行动的准备工作”。

paras.en: There are currently two US aircraft carrier strike groups in the Arabian Sea, with a third expected to arrive by late November.
paras.zh: 目前，阿拉伯海有两个美国航母战斗群，第三个预计将于 11 月底抵达。

paras.en: On October 15, Trump told the right-wing broadcaster Newsmax that he was considering a strike on Pickaxe Mountain, near the Natanz nuclear complex, where US officials say Iran may have moved sensitive nuclear-related material underground.
paras.zh: 10 月 15 日，特朗普告诉右翼广播公司 Newsmax，他正在考虑对纳坦兹核设施附近的镐山发动袭击，美国官员称伊朗可能已将敏感的核相关材料转移到地下。

paras.en: A day later, CNN reported that Trump is considering using a Massive Ordnance Air Blast bomb on Iranian targets. As the MOAB creates a humungous blast wave above ground, its effectiveness in targeting underground facilities such as Pickaxe would be limited.
paras.zh: 一天后，美国有线电视新闻网 (CNN) 报道称，特朗普正在考虑对伊朗目标使用大型空爆炸弹。由于 MOAB 在地面上产生巨大的冲击波，其瞄准镐等地下设施的效果将受到限制。

paras.en: Iranian officials say they are prepared for another attack, with a broad response that would include strikes on US bases and energy facilities in the Gulf.
paras.zh: 伊朗官员表示，他们已准备好应对另一次袭击，并做出广泛回应，其中包括对海湾地区的美国基地和能源设施进行袭击。

paras.en: Ali Asghar Shafieian, a media adviser to Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian, told DW that, although the United States retains a significant technological and military advantage, Tehran's strategy is based on preserving the regime's hold on the country rather than matching US strength.
paras.zh: 伊朗总统马苏德·佩泽什基安(Masoud Pezeshkian)的媒体顾问阿里·阿斯加尔·沙菲安(Ali Asghar Shafieian)告诉德国之声，尽管美国保留着显着的技术和军事优势，但德黑兰的战略是基于维持伊朗政权对该国的控制，而不是与美国的实力相匹配。

paras.en: "The United States has the upper hand in military power and technology, but Iran's strength is in how it deals with a crisis," Shafieian said.
paras.zh: 沙菲安说：“美国在军事力量和技术方面占据上风，但伊朗的优势在于其应对危机的方式。”

paras.en: Shafieian pointed to the rapid replacement of senior officials killed in previous attacks as an example of how Tehran has tried to make its political structure more resilient. Iran has also been rebuilding missile and drone capabilities that were hit during the massive wave of strikes during the first weeks of the war.
paras.zh: 沙菲安指出，德黑兰迅速更换在先前袭击中丧生的高级官员是德黑兰如何努力使其政治结构更具弹性的一个例子。伊朗还一直在重建在战争头几周的大规模打击浪潮中遭受打击的导弹和无人机能力。

paras.en: Citing Iranian officials, the Reuters news agency reported this week that Iran is "preparing for renewed Israeli and US attacks, not for a deal with America to end the war," adding that Tehran was prolonging negotiations to try to weaken Trump ahead of the midterms.
paras.zh: 路透社本周援引伊朗官员的话说，伊朗“正在为以色列和美国再次发动袭击做准备，而不是为与美国达成协议以结束战争”，并补充说，德黑兰正在延长谈判，试图在中期选举前削弱特朗普。

paras.en: Iran has told regional governments that US military bases and critical infrastructure could become targets if neighboring countries assist another US or Israeli operation.
paras.zh: 伊朗告诉地区政府，如果邻国协助美国或以色列的另一项行动，美国的军事基地和关键基础设施可能成为目标。

paras.en: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi has warned that participation or cooperation by regional states would result in a "decisive and proportionate response."
paras.zh: 伊朗外交部长阿巴斯·阿拉格奇警告说，地区国家的参与或合作将导致“果断和适当的反应”。

paras.en: "Iran is prepared to give diplomacy another chance if we see strong evidence of a sincere desire by US to build trust & reach a just solution," Araghchi posted on X Wednesday. "But, if US chooses war over diplomacy, it'll certainly result in an even greater strategic failure."
paras.zh: 阿拉格奇周三在 X 上发帖称：“如果我们看到强有力的证据表明美国真诚希望建立信任并达成公正的解决方案，伊朗准备再给外交一次机会。” “但是，如果美国选择战争而不是外交，那肯定会导致更大的战略失败。”

paras.en: Rahman Ghahremanpour, a Tehran-based political analyst, told DW that Iran's preparations extend beyond missiles and drones to prioritizing internal security.
paras.zh: 德黑兰政治分析家拉赫曼·加勒曼普尔 (Rahman Ghahremanpour) 告诉德国之声，伊朗的准备工作不仅限于导弹和无人机，还优先考虑内部安全。

paras.en: That includes confronting armed opposition groups, preparing for possible protests and developing plans to prevent external military pressure from combining with domestic unrest.
paras.zh: 这包括对抗武装反对派团体、为可能的抗议活动做准备以及制定计划以防止外部军事压力与国内动乱结合起来。

paras.en: Another conflict, he said, could bring renewed internet restrictions and a stronger mobilization of government supporters in public spaces.
paras.zh: 他说，另一场冲突可能会带来新的互联网限制，并在公共场所更强有力地动员政府支持者。

paras.en: "In the government's asymmetric-war strategy, the ultimate objective is to convince the United States that regime change through military action is impossible," Ghahremanpour said.
paras.zh: 加勒曼普尔说：“政府的不对称战争战略的最终目标是让美国相信通过军事行动改变政权是不可能的。”

paras.en: Ghahremanpour added that some factions within Iran have supported returning to a negotiated agreement. But he believes that Washington's demands are now considered so extensive that even Iranian officials who favor compromise struggle to build domestic support for them.
paras.zh: 加勒曼普尔补充说，伊朗内部的一些派系支持恢复通过谈判达成的协议。但他认为，华盛顿的要求现在被认为是如此广泛，以至于即使是赞成妥协的伊朗官员也很难为他们争取国内支持。

paras.en: "For now, we are facing a deadlock," Ghahremanpour said. "Iranian officials do not appear optimistic about reaching an agreement."
paras.zh: “目前，我们面临僵局，”加勒曼普尔说。 “伊朗官员似乎对达成协议并不乐观。”

paras.en: Talks continue to snag on Iran's nuclear program, which US officials say must top the agenda.
paras.zh: 谈判继续围绕伊朗核计划展开，美国官员表示，伊朗核计划必须成为首要议程。

paras.en: Iran's latest proposal to the United States, sent through Qatari mediators, included an offer to reopen the Strait of Hormuz under Iranian control, in exchange for the US's lifting its maritime blockade, releasing frozen assets and ending military actions.
paras.zh: 伊朗通过卡塔尔调解人向美国提出的最新提议包括重新开放伊朗控制下的霍尔木兹海峡，以换取美国解除海上封锁、释放冻结资产并结束军事行动。

paras.en: Citing data from the ship tracker Kpler, the Wall Street Journal reported this week that oil flows through Hormuz are approaching prewar levels as the US military escorts tankers and shipping companies are more willing to take risks for a bigger payoff. This raises questions about whether Iran's leverage over oil flows might be weakening.
paras.zh: 《华尔街日报》本周援引船舶跟踪器 Kpler 的数据报道称，由于美国军方护航油轮和航运公司更愿意为了更大的回报而冒险，因此经过霍尔木兹的石油流量已接近战前水平。这引发了人们的疑问：伊朗对石油流动的影响力是否可能正在减弱。

paras.en: An escalation in the confrontation would come at a moment of severe economic pressure and growing political polarization for Iranians.
paras.zh: 对抗升级将发生在伊朗面临严峻的经济压力和日益加剧的政治两极分化之际。

paras.en: A doctor in Tehran told DW that she fears what would happen should fighting resumed. Speaking with the media in Iran remains very dangerous, and she spoke under condition of anonymity.
paras.zh: 德黑兰的一名医生告诉德国之声，她担心如果战斗重新爆发会发生什么。在伊朗接受媒体采访仍然非常危险，而且她在匿名的情况下发言。

paras.en: "The economic situation has become extremely bad," she said. "Even if you have a good income yourself, you don't feel good living among so many people struggling with poverty," she added.
paras.zh: “经济形势已经变得极其糟糕，”她说。 “即使你自己收入不错，但生活在这么多贫困人口中，你的感觉也不好，”她补充道。

paras.en: She expects authorities to restrict internet access again if fighting resumes.
paras.zh: 她预计，如果战斗重新爆发，当局将再次限制互联网访问。

paras.en: A woman in Tehran described anger toward regime supporters and said another war combined with domestic protests could increase the risk of confrontations on the streets.
paras.zh: 德黑兰的一名妇女描述了对政权支持者的愤怒，并表示另一场战争加上国内抗议可能会增加街头对抗的风险。

paras.en: Asked about possible attacks on underground nuclear sites, she said the issue felt increasingly detached from her everyday problems.
paras.zh: 当被问及地下核设施可能遭受的袭击时，她说这个问题与她的日常问题越来越脱节。

paras.en: "What do the nuclear sites have to do with us?" she said. "They are inside mountains."
paras.zh: “核设施和我们有什么关系？”她说。 “他们在山里。”

articles.title: Are the French police the most violent in the EU?

paras.en: Videos of alleged police violence are going viral on French social media as a wave of protests grips France. One video shows the police beating a man to the floor then dragging him away unconscious. Another shows an officer grabbing a young man from behind, seemingly unprovoked, and dragging him by the neck. Another shows a young woman being hauled off with a twisted arm, screaming in pain. These videos could not be independently verified.
paras.zh: 随着一波抗议浪潮席卷法国，涉嫌警察暴力的视频在法国社交媒体上疯传。一段视频显示，警察将一名男子打倒在地，然后将不省人事的他拖走。另一张照片显示，一名警察似乎无缘无故地从后面抓住一名年轻男子，并拖住他的脖子。另一张照片显示，一名年轻女子的手臂被扭伤，被拖走，痛苦地尖叫着。这些视频无法得到独立验证。

paras.en: The French police have drawn renewed criticism from rights groups, not only because of their methods but also because of their use of stun grenades and rubber bullets. France has one of the most heavily armed police forces in Europe. During the student protests of the past weeks, several teenagers sustained life-changing injuries as a result: One had a hand blown off, one was blinded in one eye, another had his jaw broken.
paras.zh: 法国警察再次受到人权组织的批评，不仅因为他们的方法，还因为他们使用眩晕手榴弹和橡皮子弹。法国拥有欧洲武装力量最齐全的警察部队之一。在过去几周的学生抗议活动中，几名青少年遭受了改变生活的伤害：其中一人的一只手被炸断，一人的一只眼睛失明，另一人的下巴被打断。

paras.en: More than half a million people took to the streets in France on Saturday, most of whom protested peacefully, criticizing public sector cuts, the cost-of-living crisis and supporting students' demands for better conditions in classrooms.
paras.zh: 周六，超过五十万人走上法国街头，其中大多数人进行和平抗议，批评公共部门削减开支、生活成本危机，并支持学生改善教室条件的要求。

paras.en: Rioters took advantage, burning buildings, looting stores and lobbing projectiles at the police, creating a difficult situation for the officers and other emergency services.
paras.zh: 暴徒趁机烧毁建筑物、抢劫商店并向警察投掷弹丸，给警察和其他紧急服务部门造成了困难。

paras.en: The protests over the weekend followed a series of protests by high-school students, who barricaded school buildings to denounce a shortage of teachers and demand repairs to crumbling infrastructure.
paras.zh: 周末的抗议活动是在高中生发起一系列抗议活动之后发生的，他们封锁了校舍，谴责教师短缺，并要求修复摇摇欲坠的基础设施。

paras.en: More protests will be happening this weekend, with the French government saying it will even deploy military forces.
paras.zh: 本周末将发生更多抗议活动，法国政府表示甚至将部署军队。

paras.en: The French police have a bigger arsenal than most European countries. For instance, officers use the so-called LBD-40, a type of gun used to fire rubber bullets.
paras.zh: 法国警察拥有比大多数欧洲国家更大的武器库。例如，警察使用所谓的 LBD-40，这是一种用来发射橡皮子弹的枪。

paras.en: Many countries, like the UK and Germany, mostly do not allow the use of rubber bullets in protests. In some European countries, like Spain, they are sometimes used but cause fewer injuries than in France.
paras.zh: 英国和德国等许多国家大多不允许在抗议活动中使用橡皮子弹。在西班牙等一些欧洲国家，有时也会使用它们，但造成的伤害比法国少。

paras.en: "It is not a French specificity. But there are guidelines. There must be a certain distance," Anastassia Tsoukala, an associate professor of criminology at the University of Paris-Sud, told DW. "Even if you try to respect the guidelines, people may move and then all of a sudden they may lose one eye. So it's extremely dangerous."
paras.zh: 巴黎南大学犯罪学副教授阿纳斯塔西娅·苏卡拉（Anastassia Tsoukala）告诉德国之声：“这不是法国特有的，但有指导方针。必须有一定的距离。” “即使你试图遵守指导方针，人们也可能会移动，然后突然失去一只眼睛。所以这是极其危险的。”

paras.en: Police in France routinely use tear gas, as do police in many other countries in Europe. In warfare, its use is actually forbidden under agreements like the Chemical Weapons Convention.
paras.zh: 法国警察经常使用催泪瓦斯，欧洲许多其他国家的警察也是如此。在战争中，化学武器公约等协议实际上禁止使用它。

paras.en: What makes the French police stand out from other forces is its use of stun grenades.
paras.zh: 法国警察与其他部队的区别在于其使用眩晕手榴弹。

paras.en: "These grenades contain a high level of explosive substances. So from this point of view, France is unique," said Tsoukala.
paras.zh: “这些手榴弹含有高浓度的爆炸性物质。所以从这个角度来看，法国是独一无二的，”苏卡拉说。

paras.en: Minister of the Interior Laurent Nunez insists that weapons used by the police are "non-lethal." However, some of the equipment used by the force is classified by France's own internal security code as "war material."
paras.zh: 内政部长洛朗·努涅斯坚称警方使用的武器是“非致命性的”。然而，该部队使用的一些装备被法国自己的内部安全法规归类为“战争物资”。

paras.en: French police: the 'most brutal' in the EU?
paras.zh: 法国警察：欧盟“最残暴”？

paras.en: The police's use of these weapons has received renewed criticism after it resulted in injuries during the protests. The teenager who lost use of an eye is suspected of being hit at close range with a rubber bullet from an LBD-40.
paras.zh: 警察使用这些武器在抗议活动中造成人员受伤后再次受到批评。这名失明少年疑似被 LBD-40 橡皮子弹近距离击中。

paras.en: "When we look at crowd control, it is clear that if we measure police brutality by the number of deaths amongst demonstrators or members of the crowd, and if we also measure it by the number of cases of maiming, the French police are the most brutal in the whole of the European Union," says Roche.
paras.zh: 罗奇说：“当我们审视人群控制时，很明显，如果我们通过示威者或人群的死亡人数来衡量警察的暴行，如果我们还通过致残案件的数量来衡量，那么法国警察是整个欧盟中最残暴的。”

paras.en: He points to the political context to understand the French police's equipment and how it is used today.
paras.zh: 他指出了政治背景，以了解法国警察的装备及其今天的使用方式。

paras.en: "The political authorities are free to decide on the police's equipment," the police expert says. "When LBDs were introduced into the [French] police force, they were intended for units like anti-organized crime units. This is the same weapon that is today used for crowd control. It gives an idea of how the way in which politicians in France think we can or should deal with political protest has evolved."
paras.zh: “政治当局可以自由决定警察的装备，”警察专家说。 “当小黑裙被引入[法国]警察部队时，它们是为反有组织犯罪单位等单位而设计的。这与今天用于人群控制的武器相同。它让人们了解法国政客认为我们能够或应该处理政治抗议的方式是如何演变的。”

paras.en: Another difference between the French police and forces elsewhere is the methods. German police, for example, are supposed to try to avoid escalation.
paras.zh: 法国警察与其他地方警察的另一个区别是方法。例如，德国警方应该尽力避免事态升级。

paras.en: Roche compares how protestors were moved in Lützerath, Germany, in 2023 to the more aggressive methods in Sainte-Soline, France, in 2023. Both places saw environmental protests.
paras.zh: 罗氏将 2023 年德国吕策拉特抗议者的转移方式与 2023 年法国圣索林更为激进的方法进行了比较。这两个地方都发生了环境抗议活动。

paras.en: "In Lützerath, dogs were used, there were some injuries but far fewer seriously injured people on both sides. In Sainte-Soline, the military police was sent in and used LBDs and grenades intensively. There were serious injuries amongst both police officers and demonstrators. Two protestors were left in a coma."
paras.zh: “在吕策拉特，双方都使用了警犬，造成了一些人受伤，但严重受伤的人数要少得多。在圣索林，军警出动，大量使用小黑枪和手榴弹。警察和示威者均受重伤。两名抗议者处于昏迷状态。”

paras.en: According to international standards set by the United Nations, use of force by officers of the law "should be exceptional," in the case of "prevention of crime" or "lawful arrest." Any use of force should follow a principle of "proportionality," which means no more than necessary to achieve its objective.
paras.zh: 根据联合国制定的国际标准，在“预防犯罪”或“合法逮捕”的情况下，执法人员使用武力“应该是例外”。任何武力的使用都应遵循“比例”原则，即仅达到实现其目标所必需的程度。

paras.en: French Interior Minister Nunez has insisted in radio interviews that officers have largely respected this principle, which is also enshrined in French law, during the current protests.
paras.zh: 法国内政部长努涅斯在电台采访中坚称，在当前的抗议活动中，官员们在很大程度上尊重了这一原则，该原则也被写入法国法律。

paras.en: However, rights group Amnesty International describes the police response to the current protests as "disproportionate" and calls upon French authorities to "act upon their human rights obligations."
paras.zh: 然而，人权组织大赦国际称警方对当前抗议活动的反应“不成比例”，并呼吁法国当局“履行其人权义务”。

paras.en: The French branch of the League of Human Rights condemns the "violent repression" of the high school protest movement.
paras.zh: 人权联盟法国分部谴责对高中抗议运动的“暴力镇压”。

paras.en: DW contacted two police unions and the French Interior Ministry for comment, but none responded before time of publication.
paras.zh: 德国之声联系了两个警察工会和法国内政部请其置评，但截至发稿前均未做出回应。

paras.en: "It was very complicated to contain all the different groups," Interior Minister Nunez said in Marseille on Tuesday. "The police did a great job and there were a great number of crimes that were prevented thanks to their commitment."
paras.zh: “遏制所有不同群体是非常复杂的，”内政部长努涅斯周二在马赛表示。 “警察做得很好，由于他们的努力，大量犯罪行为被阻止了。”

paras.en: Experts are critical of the police's actions.
paras.zh: 专家对警方的行为提出批评。

paras.en: "Public order is subordinated to human life and safety," Tsoukala said. "As a jurist I should say that this is a non-negotiable value."
paras.zh: 苏卡拉说：“公共秩序服从于人类生命和安全。” “作为一名法学家，我应该说这是一个不容谈判的价值。”

paras.en: Less oversight than in the UK and Denmark
paras.zh: 监管比英国和丹麦少

paras.en: The French police have no independent watchdog, only an internal division called the IGPN (General Inspectorate of the National Police) that can investigate when problems occur. The IGPN says it has opened at least 40 cases since the beginning of the latest protests.
paras.zh: 法国警察没有独立的监督机构，只有一个名为 IGPN（国家警察总监察局）的内部部门可以在问题发生时进行调查。 IGPN 表示，自最近的抗议活动开始以来，它已立案至少 40 个案件。

paras.en: Countries like the UK and Denmark investigate incidents differently, with independent watchdogs. However, Tsoukala criticizes leniency and a lack of transparency across Europe when incidents with the police occur.
paras.zh: 英国和丹麦等国家通过独立的监管机构以不同的方式调查事件。然而，苏卡拉批评整个欧洲在与警察发生事件时的宽大处理和缺乏透明度。

paras.en: "They are acquitted or they receive extremely light penalties," she said. "And I'm afraid this is the standard method to deal with police brutality cases across Europe."
paras.zh: “他们被无罪释放，或者受到极轻的处罚，”她说。 “恐怕这是整个欧洲处理警察暴力案件的标准方法。”

articles.title: South Africa crush Australia by an innings to level cricket Test series

paras.en: South Africa bowled out Australia for 295 to win by an innings and 31 runs in the last session of the second Test at St George’s Park in Gqeberha on Thursday to level the three-match series, winning a race against looming bad weather.
paras.zh: 周四，在格凯贝哈圣乔治公园举行的第二场测试赛的最后一场比赛中，南非队以 295 分击败澳大利亚队，以一局 31 分的优势击败澳大利亚队，在三场比赛中扳平了比分，在迫在眉睫的恶劣天气下赢得了一场比赛。

paras.en: The hosts’ pace trio of Wiaan Mulder, Kagiso Rabada and Marco Jansen took the last four wickets required as Australia’s resistance crumbled after a century from Travis Head and a doggedly defiant Test high 40 by nightwatchman Scott Boland.
paras.zh: 东道主的速度三人组维安·穆尔德、卡吉索·拉巴达和马可·詹森占据了最后四个三柱门，澳大利亚的抵抗在特拉维斯·海德和守夜人斯科特·博兰顽强地挑衅性的测试高40年后崩溃了一个世纪。

paras.en: Mulder, who earlier dismissed Head, then bowled Boland and castled Australia captain Pat Cummins to forge a breakthrough, with Rabada dismissing Mitchell Starc and Jansen finishing off the innings with Josh Hazlewood caught in the slips.
paras.zh: 穆德早些时候解雇了海德，然后击球博兰并击败了澳大利亚队长帕特·康明斯以取得突破，拉巴达解雇了米切尔·斯塔克，詹森完成了局局，乔什·黑兹尔伍德陷入了滑倒。

paras.en: A result in the Test seemed far-fetched when most of the first two days’ play was washed out and South Africa, who were 110-6 when the sun came out on the morning of the third day, looked in early trouble as Australia aimed to capitalise on their success in the first Test.
paras.zh: 测试赛的结果似乎有些牵强，前两天的大部分比赛都被淘汰了，第三天早上太阳出来时，南非队以 110 胜 6 负的战绩，在澳大利亚队希望利用他们在第一次测试赛中的成功的基础上，看起来很早就遇到了麻烦。

paras.en: But a brilliant 179 runs from skipper Temba Bavuma led a fightback that saw South Africa declare on 425-9 and then turn the Test on its head by bowling Australia out for 99 and putting them in to bat again.
paras.zh: 但队长坦巴·巴武马 (Temba Bavuma) 打出 179 分的出色表现，带领南非队以 425 比 9 的比分发起反击，随后以 99 分将澳大利亚队淘汰，让他们再次上垒，从而扭转了测试赛的局面。

paras.en: Head and Boland had resumed on 156-4 in the second innings after rain returned and wiped out the morning session and Head, who was 87 overnight, went on to score 121 before chopping onto his stumps a rising delivery from Mulder.
paras.zh: 海德和博兰在第二局以 156 胜 4 负的成绩恢复比赛，之后下雨并取消了上午的比赛，而一夜之间打出 87 杆的海德继续得分 121，然后将穆德的一记上升球砍到了树桩上。

paras.en: It was Head’s 13th Test century but only his second outside Australia, and his departure offered the home bowlers hope again after almost 90 minutes of frustrating attack without success at the start of the day’s action.
paras.zh: 这是海德的第 13 个测试世纪，但只是他在澳大利亚以外的第二个世纪，他的离开给主场保龄球手们带来了希望，因为他们在当天的比赛开始时经历了近 90 分钟的令人沮丧的进攻，但没有成功。

paras.en: “We were scrambling a bit, not sure about the weather and Australia made us work hard for those last six wickets,” said Bavuma.
paras.zh: “我们有点手忙脚乱，不确定天气如何，澳大利亚让我们为最后六个边门努力工作，”巴武马说。

paras.en: Steve Smith, who battled with a neck problem in the first innings on Wednesday, made three as he came in at number seven.
paras.zh: 史蒂夫·史密斯在周三的第一局中与颈部问题作斗争，他在第七局中取得了三分。

paras.en: The former captain was tempted into pulling a delivery from Rabada, bowling with the second new ball, but only got a top edge to Matthew Breetzke, who juggled it at mid-wicket before holding the catch.
paras.zh: 这位前队长很想从拉巴达那里拉出球，用第二个新球投球，但只得到了马修·布里茨克(Matthew Breetzke)的上边缘，后者在接球之前在中门杂耍了它。

paras.en: Boland, who batted for 166 balls as he put a high price on his wicket, went soon after tea, when he was bowled through the gate. Then Cummins (4) played down the wrong line and was also clean bowled in Mulder’s next over.
paras.zh: 博兰在三柱门上标出了高价，击球 166 个球，喝完茶后不久，他就被击中了大门。然后康明斯（4）打错了路线，在穆德的下一场比赛中也被干净地击球。

paras.en: When Rabada came back for a fresh spell as dark clouds loomed ominously overhead, he immediately bowled Starc (11), leaving one wicket to get, which Jansen snagged as Hazlewood showed no sign of sticking around and nicked behind the first ball.
paras.zh: 当拉巴达回来恢复新的状态时，乌云笼罩着头顶，他立即向斯塔克（11）投球，留下一个三柱门，詹森抓住了这个三柱门，因为黑兹尔伍德没有留下任何迹象，并在第一个球后面切入。

paras.en: Alex Carey, who lasted only two balls in Australia’s first innings, was 37 not out, with Rabada taking 4-77 on his return after a lengthy injury layoff, and Mulder 3-64.
paras.zh: 亚历克斯·凯里(Alex Carey)在澳大利亚第一局只打了两个球，37杆未出局，拉巴达(Rabada)在长时间受伤后复出后以4-77获胜，穆德(Mulder)以3-64获胜。

paras.en: “I thought we showed some good fight, but it wasn’t quite enough. We were a long way from our best,” said Cummins.
paras.zh: “我认为我们表现出了一些不错的战斗力，但这还不够。我们距离最佳状态还有很长的路要走，”康明斯说。

paras.en: The last Test at Newlands in Cape Town starts on Tuesday.
paras.zh: 开普敦纽兰兹的最后一次测试将于周二开始。

articles.title: Two Syrian security officers killed in raid on ISIL cell near Damascus

paras.en: Two members of Syria’s internal security forces have been killed and five wounded in clashes with a suspected ISIL (ISIS) cell during a raid on the outskirts of Damascus, the Interior Ministry reported.
paras.zh: 据内政部报道，在大马士革郊区的一次突袭中，叙利亚国内安全部队与疑似“伊斯兰国”组织发生冲突，造成两名内部安全部队成员死亡、五人受伤。

paras.en: The fighting began on Thursday morning, when security forces launched an operation against the cell in the town of Rankous in the western Damascus countryside. The operation is the latest in a series of raids as the government tries to dismantle ISIL networks and prevent attacks.
paras.zh: 战斗于周四上午开始，安全部队对大马士革西部乡村兰库斯镇的该牢房发起了行动。这次行动是政府试图瓦解“伊斯兰国”网络并防止袭击的一系列突袭行动中的最新一次。

paras.en: The ministry said the suspects refused to surrender and opened fire, triggering the clashes. Five alleged ISIL members were killed and six arrested, and weapons and explosive belts were seized.
paras.zh: 内政部表示，嫌疑人拒绝投降并开枪，引发冲突。五名被指控的伊斯兰国成员被打死，六人被捕，武器和爆炸带被缴获。

paras.en: Al Jazeera’s Heidi Pett, reporting from Syria, said residents told her the clashes began around 6am (03:00 GMT) and lasted two to three hours. Some of the wounded security personnel were seriously hurt, she said.
paras.zh: 半岛电视台记者海蒂·佩特在叙利亚报道称，居民告诉她，冲突于早上 6 点（格林威治标准时间 03:00）左右开始，持续了两到三个小时。她说，一些受伤的安全人员伤势严重。

paras.en: Residents said the group was about nine people – smaller than what officials reported – with two members killed, another two escaping, and an unknown number injured.
paras.zh: 居民称，该团伙约有九人——比官方报道的人数要少——其中两人死亡，另外两人逃跑，受伤人数不详。

paras.en: Residents told the local outlet Syria Now that security forces imposed a curfew and arrested several people.
paras.zh: 居民告诉当地媒体《Syria Now》，安全部队实施了宵禁并逮捕了几人。

paras.en: The ministry also reportedly foiled an ISIL plot in the Damascus countryside and dismantled an ISIL cell in the Houla area of Homs earlier this month. The plots involved attacking places of worship and security patrols, according to Syria Now.
paras.zh: 据报道，本月早些时候，该部还挫败了“伊斯兰国”在大马士革乡村的阴谋，并摧毁了“伊斯兰国”在霍姆斯胡拉地区的一个组织。据《今日叙利亚》报道，这些阴谋涉及袭击礼拜场所和安全巡逻队。

paras.en: On October 6, the ministry announced the arrest of Khaled Raed Birouni, also known as Abu Hassan Dushka, in the town of Hujaira in the Damascus countryside. Authorities say he was the group’s top military commander for Homs.
paras.zh: 10 月 6 日，内政部宣布在大马士革乡村的胡贾伊拉镇逮捕哈立德·拉德·比鲁尼（Khaled Raed Birouni），又名阿布·哈桑·杜什卡（Abu Hassan Dushka）。当局称他是该组织在霍姆斯的最高军事指挥官。

paras.en: They accused him of planning several attacks there, including the December 2025 bombing of a mosque in the city’s Wadi al-Dhahab neighbourhood during Friday prayers, which killed eight people and wounded 18, according to Syria’s Health Ministry.
paras.zh: 据叙利亚卫生部称，他们指控他策划了多起袭击事件，其中包括 2025 年 12 月在周五祈祷期间对该市 Wadi al-Dhahab 社区的一座清真寺进行爆炸袭击，造成 8 人死亡、18 人受伤。

paras.en: ISIL has repeatedly attacked Syrian security forces, usually targeting buses and vehicles carrying personnel, Pett said, along with a few attacks on civilians.
paras.zh: 佩特说，“伊斯兰国”多次袭击叙利亚安全部队，通常针对载有人员的公共汽车和车辆，并对平民进行几次袭击。

paras.en: Syria joined the 90-member international coalition against ISIL in November, six years after Syrian Kurdish-led forces led the territorial defeat of ISIL strongholds in the country’s northeast.
paras.zh: 叙利亚于11月加入了由90个成员组成的打击ISIL的国际联盟，六年前，叙利亚库尔德人领导的部队领导了该国东北部ISIL据点的领土击败。

articles.title: FIFA announces USA to host first Women’s Club World Cup in 2028

paras.en: The United States will host the inaugural women’s football Club World Cup in 2028, FIFA announced Thursday.
paras.zh: 国际足联周四宣布，美国将于 2028 年主办首届女子足球俱乐部世界杯。

paras.en: “The decision was taken in view of its experience in organising FIFA tournaments, the maturity of its infrastructure and services and the level of stakeholder interest in women’s football in the country,” world football’s governing body said.
paras.zh: 世界足球管理机构表示：“做出这一决定是考虑到其组织国际足联赛事的经验、基础设施和服务的成熟度以及利益相关者对该国女子足球的兴趣程度。”

paras.en: The US has a proven track record of staging large sporting events, notably cohosting the men’s World Cup earlier this year.
paras.zh: 美国在举办大型体育赛事方面有着良好的记录，特别是今年早些时候联合主办的男子世界杯。

paras.en: The first women’s Club World Cup will be staged from January 5-30, 2028.
paras.zh: 首届女子俱乐部世界杯将于2028年1月5日至30日举行。

paras.en: It will bring together 19 top-tier clubs from all six continental confederations.
paras.zh: 它将汇集来自所有六个洲联盟的 19 支顶级俱乐部。

paras.en: The AFC (Asia), CAF (Africa), CONCACAF (North America) and CONMEBOL (South America) will be represented by three clubs apiece at the competition, one team will fly the flag for the OFC (Oceania) and six of Europe’s best sides will represent UEFA.
paras.zh: AFC（亚洲）、CAF（非洲）、CONCACAF（北美）和 CONMEBOL（南美洲）将分别派出 3 支球队参加比赛，其中一支球队将代表 OFC（大洋洲），而欧洲最好的 6 支球队将代表 UEFA。

paras.en: Seven clubs have already secured their berths at the tournament: Arsenal (England), Club America Femenil (Mexico), Barcelona (Spain), Gotham (United States), Naegohyang (North Korea), Corinthians (Brazil) and Wuhan Jiangda (China).
paras.zh: 已有七家具乐部获得参赛资格：阿森纳（英格兰）、美洲俱乐部（墨西哥）、巴塞罗那（西班牙）、哥谭（美国）、内乡（朝鲜）、科林蒂安（巴西）和武汉江大（中国）。

paras.en: “These seven clubs, and a dozen more, will come together to show the strength and depth of women’s club football to a global audience,” said FIFA chief women’s football officer Sarai Bareman.
paras.zh: 国际足联首席女足官萨莱·巴雷曼表示：“这七家具乐部以及另外十几家具乐部将齐聚一堂，向全球观众展示女足俱乐部足球的实力和深度。”

paras.en: “They will have the opportunity to tell their story, expand their fan base and represent their club on the world stage. They have thoroughly earned this opportunity to be part of history in the United States.”
paras.zh: “他们将有机会讲述自己的故事，扩大球迷基础，并在世界舞台上代表自己的俱乐部。他们完全赢得了这个机会，成为美国历史的一部分。”

paras.en: FIFA said the introduction of the tournament marked “a major milestone for the professionalisation and global expansion of the women’s club game, giving elite club sides a true world stage to compete on every four years”.
paras.zh: 国际足联表示，这项赛事的推出标志着“女子俱乐部比赛职业化和全球扩张的一个重要里程碑，为精英俱乐部球队提供了一个真正的世界舞台，每四年举行一次比赛”。

paras.en: Initially slated for 2026, FIFA pushed the inaugural tournament back by two years so it enjoys a clear window following the 2027 women’s World Cup and before the 2028 Summer Olympics in Los Angeles.
paras.zh: 国际足联原定于 2026 年举行的首届赛事推迟了两年，因此在 2027 年女足世界杯之后和 2028 年洛杉矶夏季奥运会之前有一个明确的窗口期。

paras.en: The US has a proven track record of hosting large sporting events, notably staging the men’s 2026 World Cup, which was won by Spain earlier this year.
paras.zh: 美国在举办大型体育赛事方面有着良好的记录，尤其是举办 2026 年男子世界杯，西班牙今年早些时候赢得了冠军。

paras.en: Chelsea are the reigning men’s FIFA Club World Cup holders, after beating Paris St Germain in the 2025 final, which was also staged in the US.
paras.zh: 切尔西在 2025 年同样在美国举行的决赛中击败巴黎圣日耳曼队，成为男子 FIFA 俱乐部世界杯卫冕冠军。

articles.title: Former U.S. Ambassador to Ukraine William Taylor on Trump's embrace of Russia
articles.author: Steve Inskeep

paras.en: Former U.S. Ambassador to Ukraine William Taylor on Trump's embrace of Russia
paras.zh: 前美国驻乌克兰大使威廉·泰勒谈特朗普拥抱俄罗斯

paras.en: NPR's Steve Inskeep asks former U.S. Ambassador to Ukraine William Taylor about President Trump's embrace of Russia as envoy Steve Witkoff visits Moscow after meeting Ukraine's Volodymyr Zelenskyy.
paras.zh: 美国国家公共广播电台 (NPR) 的史蒂夫·英斯基普 (Steve Inskeep) 向美国前驻乌克兰大使威廉·泰勒 (William Taylor) 询问特朗普总统对俄罗斯的拥抱，特使史蒂夫·威特科夫 (Steve Witkoff) 在会见乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基 (Volodymyr Zelenskyy) 后访问莫斯科。

paras.en: And now let's bring Ambassador William Taylor back to the conversation. He has served as U.S. ambassador to Ukraine during the George W. Bush and Obama administrations - has been involved in some historic events. Ambassador, welcome back.
paras.zh: 现在让我们让威廉·泰勒大使回到谈话中来。他曾在小布什和奥巴马政府期间担任美国驻乌克兰大使，参与了一些历史性事件。大使，欢迎回来。

paras.en: WILLIAM TAYLOR: Thank you, Steve. Good to be here.
paras.zh: 威廉·泰勒： 谢谢你，史蒂夫。很高兴来到这里。

paras.en: INSKEEP: So what do you make of this Russian announcement? Is this something you would take seriously?
paras.zh: 因斯基普：那么您对俄罗斯的这一声明有何看法？这是你会认真对待的事情吗？

paras.en: TAYLOR: If the Russians are serious, Steve, then we should take it seriously. It's not clear they are. So far, every proposal for a ceasefire has been met with the same Russian response - no. And this may be different. However, as Joanna just pointed out, these three-way talks at the technical level were going on six months ago. And there were some progress at the technical level on, for example, how to monitor a ceasefire.
paras.zh: 泰勒：如果俄罗斯人是认真的，史蒂夫，那么我们就应该认真对待。目前尚不清楚他们是。到目前为止，每一项停火提议都得到了俄罗斯的同样回应——没有。而这可能会有所不同。不过，正如乔安娜刚才指出的那样，这些技术层面的三方会谈是在六个月前进行的。在技​​术层面也取得了一些进展，例如如何监督停火。

paras.en: And Ukrainians and Russians and Americans got together, and the technical experts were able to come up with some good ideas about how to monitor a ceasefire. The problem, of course, is Putin doesn't want a ceasefire. So they can start these technical discussions again three ways. That's a good thing. However, the main problem remains, and that is Putin's opposition to ending this war.
paras.zh: 乌克兰人、俄罗斯人和美国人聚集在一起，技术专家能够就如何监督停火提出一些好主意。当然，问题是普京不希望停火。因此他们可以通过三种方式再次开始这些技术讨论。这是一件好事。然而，主要问题依然存在，那就是普京反对结束这场战争。

paras.en: INSKEEP: And I guess we should just be clear. The idea on the table is everyone stops shooting where they are. Nobody admits that anybody has conquered territory. The idea is just to stop shooting. And you're saying the political will on the Russian side just isn't there.
paras.zh: 因斯基普：我想我们应该明确一点。摆在桌面上的想法是每个人都停止在原地射击。没有人承认有人征服了领土。这个想法只是停止拍摄。你是说俄罗斯方面不存在政治意愿。

paras.en: TAYLOR: It's just not there. They've opposed that. Steve, they've been very clear. Putin's been very clear about what he wants. He wants to dominate - eliminate Ukraine. He doesn't think Ukraine really exists - it's not a real nation. So he's been very clear that his strategy is to wait us out. And waiting us out, waiting out the Europeans, the Ukrainians, the Americans, means no ceasefire. He keeps grinding.
paras.zh: 泰勒：它不在那儿。他们对此表示反对。史蒂夫，他们已经说得很清楚了。普京非常清楚他想要什么。他想统治——消灭乌克兰。他不认为乌克兰真的存在——它不是一个真正的国家。所以他非常清楚他的策略是等待我们退出。等待我们、等待欧洲人、乌克兰人、美国人离开，意味着不会停火。他一直在磨。

paras.en: INSKEEP: He did, however, release Stephen Hubbard, this seemingly friendly gesture toward the United States. Do you see it as a friendly move?
paras.zh: 因斯基普：不过，他确实释放了斯蒂芬·哈伯德，这似乎是对美国的友好姿态。您认为这是友好举动吗？

paras.en: TAYLOR: I see it as manipulation again. I mean, it's a good thing that the Russians have let this man go. He was wrongfully imprisoned. So it's a good thing that he can come home to his family. That's a very good thing. The Russians took him, and the Russians can take others if they think they can get something for it. But for Steve Witkoff to say that because the Russians let this man go, that Putin is humanitarian. I agree with the Ukrainian legislature - I cringed when I heard that.
paras.zh: 泰勒：我再次将其视为操纵。我的意思是，俄罗斯人放了这个人是件好事。他被错误地监禁了。所以他能回到家人身边是件好事。这是一件非常好的事情。俄罗斯人带走了他，如果俄罗斯人认为可以从中得到一些东西，他们也可以带走其他人。但史蒂夫·威特科夫说，因为俄罗斯人放了这个人，所以普京是人道主义的。我同意乌克兰立法机构的观点——当我听到这个消息时我感到畏缩。

paras.en: INSKEEP: So your analysis of President Putin is that, fundamentally, I mean, he feints to the right, he feints to the left. He makes a gesture, but fundamentally, he believes the same thing as he did years ago, which is that Ukraine ought to belong to Russia, and he hasn't changed. Would you say that's also true of President Trump - periodically, the United States gets a little tough on Russia and then reverts to saying that, you know, Russia has the edge. Russia is the bigger country, and Ukraine ought to deal with them?
paras.zh: 因斯基普：所以你对普京总统的分析是，从根本上来说，我的意思是，他佯攻右翼，他佯攻左翼。他做出了一个姿态，但从根本上来说，他的信念与多年前一样，那就是乌克兰应该属于俄罗斯，而且他没有改变。你会说特朗普总统也是如此吗？美国周期性地对俄罗斯采取强硬态度，然后又转而说，你知道，俄罗斯有优势。俄罗斯是更大的国家，乌克兰应该对付他们吗？

paras.en: TAYLOR: And President Trump says that almost every time he has a conversation with President Putin, Putin will get on the phone with Trump, give him the story, give him the line from the Russians, exactly what you just described, and President Trump comes out and says the same thing. It turns out that it's not that way. The Ukrainians have stopped the Russians on the battlefield. The Ukrainians have stopped this Russian army. They're a small army, the Ukrainians, but they've used technology to stop the Russians on the battlefield.
paras.zh: 泰勒：特朗普总统说，几乎每次他与普京总统交谈时，普京都会与特朗普通电话，给他讲述故事，给他俄罗斯人的台词，正如你刚才所描述的那样，然后特朗普总统出来说了同样的话。事实证明并非如此。乌克兰人在战场上阻止了俄罗斯人。乌克兰人已经阻止了这支俄罗斯军队。乌克兰人是一支小军队，但他们利用技术在战场上阻止了俄罗斯人。

paras.en: And you never hear Trump say that because Putin tells them, oh, we're grinding over the Ukrainians. It's inevitable that we will win. So no, this is not reality, and the stalemate is on the ground. Now, it is true that the Russians have the ability to hit the Ukrainians with ballistic missiles at will because the Ukrainians don't have the ability any longer to knock them down. The Patriot missiles that are useful for that are no longer there.
paras.zh: 你永远不会听到特朗普这么说，因为普京告诉他们，哦，我们正在压垮乌克兰人。我们获胜是不可避免的。所以，不，这不是现实，僵局就在眼前。现在，俄罗斯确实有能力用弹道导弹随意打击乌克兰，因为乌克兰已经没有能力击落他们了。对此有用的爱国者导弹已不复存在。

paras.en: INSKEEP: We've heard mixed signals and mixed messages, anyway, about why it is that the Ukrainians are suddenly short of Patriot missiles and why there seem to be delays in delivering weapons that the Ukrainians seem to have paid for, and why even there was a brief interruption in Starlink service. Do you feel you understand why the Trump administration is doing these things and whether they're deliberate?
paras.zh: 因斯基普：无论如何，我们听到了混合的信号和混合的信息，关于为什么乌克兰人突然缺乏爱国者导弹，为什么乌克兰人似乎已经付费的武器交付似乎出现了延误，以及为什么星链服务甚至出现了短暂的中断。您是否理解特朗普政府为什么要做这些事情以及它们是否是故意的？

paras.en: TAYLOR: You have to believe they're deliberate, Steve. They're all happening at the same time. The Starlink, the military intelligence stopped at the same time, restricted at the same time. After some indication from Russian officials to Ukrainian officials that this was going to happen. And you hear that the supply of Patriots, which are, as you said, paid for by the Europeans to be provided to the Ukrainians, stalled, stopped on Secretary of Defense Hegseth's death. He's - desk. He's holding that up. They're all happening at the same time. I don't believe that Elon Musk would have slowed down Starlink and Starshield without talking to the president.
paras.zh: 泰勒：你必须相信他们是故意的，史蒂夫。它们都是同时发生的。星环，军事情报同时停止，同时限制。在俄罗斯官员向乌克兰官员表示这将会发生之后。你听说爱国者的供应，正如你所说，由欧洲人支付提供给乌克兰人的供应，在国防部长赫格塞斯去世后停止了。他是——办公桌。他一直坚持着。它们都是同时发生的。我不相信埃隆·马斯克会在不与总统交谈的情况下放慢星链和星盾的速度。

paras.en: INSKEEP: Interesting, Marco Rubio, the secretary of state, says there's nothing being deliberately denied to Ukraine, but then says it's simply a balance between our obligations to other partners and our own standards, then suggesting maybe the U.S. is doing - knows what it's doing here.
paras.zh: 因斯基普：有趣的是，国务卿马可·卢比奥表示，没有任何人故意拒绝乌克兰，但随后又表示，这只是我们对其他伙伴的义务和我们自己的标准之间的平衡，然后暗示美国可能正在做什么——知道它在这里做什么。

paras.en: TAYLOR: The U.S. does know what it's doing. It's slowing it down, and that is causing real pain. It's causing Ukrainians to die. Let's be clear.
paras.zh: 泰勒：美国确实知道自己在做什么。它减慢了速度，这造成了真正的痛苦。它导致乌克兰人死亡。让我们说清楚。

paras.en: INSKEEP: And we'll end it on that note. Former U.S. ambassador to Ukraine William Taylor, thanks so much.
paras.zh: 因斯基普：我们就这样结束吧。前美国驻乌克兰大使威廉·泰勒，非常感谢。

articles.title: U.S., Israel may attack Iran post-elections. And, SpaceX and Tesla consider merging
articles.author: Brittney Melton

paras.en: U.S., Israel may attack Iran post-elections. And, SpaceX and Tesla consider merging
paras.zh: 美国、以色列可能会在选举后攻击伊朗。而且，SpaceX 和特斯拉考虑合并

paras.en: President Trump isn't the only one hitting key states in the last days before the midterm elections. Democrats are bringing out big names, too. Former President Barack Obama will be in Ohio and Michigan this weekend, and next week he heads to Georgia. Today, former Vice President Kamala Harris is set to visit Mississippi, which has a surprisingly competitive Senate race.
paras.zh: 特朗普总统并不是唯一一个在中期选举前最后几天袭击关键州的人。民主党也推出了大人物。前总统巴拉克·奥巴马本周末将访问俄亥俄州和密歇根州，下周将前往佐治亚州。今天，前副总统卡马拉·哈里斯将访问密西西比州，该州参议员竞选的竞争异常激烈。

paras.en: - 🎧 Many Democrats are visiting toss-up and deep-red areas across the country, NPR's Stephen Fowler tells Up First. Alongside figures like Obama and Harris, U.S. Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez, Sen. Bernie Sanders, Sen. Cory Booker and former DNC chair Jaime Harrison are going to different states to help with campaigning. Fowler says these leaders resemble a shadow primary for potential 2028 presidential candidates. He also notes that the Democrats' campaign push is happening against a backdrop of a big surge in Black voter turnout during early voting.
paras.zh: - 🎧 NPR 的史蒂芬·福勒 (Stephen Fowler) 告诉 Up First，许多民主党人正在全国各地访问不稳定和深红色地区。除了奥巴马和哈里斯等人物外，美国众议员亚历山大·奥卡西奥-科尔特斯、参议员伯尼·桑德斯、参议员科里·布克和前民主党全国委员会主席杰米·哈里森也将前往不同的州帮助竞选。福勒表示，这些领导人就像 2028 年潜在总统候选人的影子初选。他还指出，民主党的竞选活动是在提前投票期间黑人选民投票率大幅上升的背景下进行的。

paras.en: - ➡️ The American Israel Public Affairs Committee (AIPAC) announced yesterday that it will no longer issue endorsements, make direct PAC contributions or earmark funds for candidates. The influential lobbying group began its direct political involvement five years ago but has faced growing resistance and criticism over its positions on issues like the wars in Gaza and Iran.
paras.zh: - ➡️美国以色列公共事务委员会（AIPAC）昨天宣布，将不再为候选人发放背书、直接向 PAC 捐款或指定资金。这个有影响力的游说团体五年前开始直接参与政治，但因其在加沙和伊朗战争等问题上的立场而面临越来越多的阻力和批评。

paras.en: - ➡️ This week, the Department of Justice started notifying the counties it wants to monitor on Election Day, NPR has learned. The DOJ deploys monitors to ensure compliance with voting laws, but officials have raised concerns this year over the Trump administration's efforts to control elections.
paras.zh: - ➡️ 据 NPR 获悉，本周，司法部开始通知其想要在选举日监控的县。司法部部署监察员以确保投票法得到遵守，但官员们今年对特朗普政府控制选举的努力表示担忧。

paras.en: - ➡️ The NPR App has all of NPR's election coverage in one place — from the biggest stories across the country, to the issues that matter close to home. Browse headlines, playlists, podcast episodes, videos and more, all on the 2026 Election tab.
paras.zh: - ➡️ NPR 应用程序将 NPR 的所有选举报道集中在一个地方 - 从全国最大的新闻到与家庭息息相关的问题。浏览头条新闻、播放列表、播客剧集、视频等，所有这些都在 2026 年选举选项卡上。

paras.en: The U.S. and Israel are preparing plans for a possible attack on Iran early next month, a person briefed on the matter, who spoke on condition of anonymity so they could discuss the preparations, told NPR today. This potential strike would occur after the U.S. midterm elections and Israel's elections next week. The development comes after Israeli security forces in the occupied West Bank detained about 80 people yesterday, including U.S. Democratic congressional nominee for New York Brad Lander and more than a dozen American rabbis.
paras.zh: 一位不愿透露姓名的知情人士今天告诉美国国家公共广播电台，美国和以色列正在准备下月初可能对伊朗发动袭击的计划。该人士要求匿名，以便讨论准备工作。这次潜在的罢工将发生在美国中期选举和下周以色列选举之后。此前，以色列安全部队昨天在被占领的约旦河西岸拘留了约 80 人，其中包括美国民主党纽约州国会候选人布拉德·兰德和十多名美国拉比。

paras.en: - 🎧 Israel initially intended to strike Iran in mid-October, but Trump objected, according to NPR's source. These preparations might aim to pressure Iran into a diplomatic deal, NPR's Ruth Sherlock says. Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is campaigning to topple Iran's regime, and if election results remain uncertain by November, he may use the threat of military action to form a unity government.
paras.zh: - 🎧 据 NPR 消息来源称，以色列最初打算在 10 月中旬袭击伊朗，但遭到特朗普的反对。 NPR 的露丝·夏洛克 (Ruth Sherlock) 表示，这些准备工作的目的可能是迫使伊朗达成外交协议。以色列总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡正在开展推翻伊朗政权的活动，如果到11月选举结果仍不确定，他可能会利用军事行动的威胁组建联合政府。

paras.en: Tesla and SpaceX are exploring a merger. Together, Elon Musk's two companies would potentially amplify his influence as one of the wealthiest individuals on Earth. The new company would become one of the largest globally, boasting a combined market cap of approximately $3.7 trillion.
paras.zh: 特斯拉和 SpaceX 正在探索合并。埃隆·马斯克的两家公司加起来可能会扩大他作为地球上最富有的人之一的影响力。新公司将成为全球最大的公司之一，总市值约为 3.7 万亿美元。

paras.en: - 🎧 Musk revived the idea of a merger this week during recent SpaceX and Tesla earnings calls, according to NPR's John Ruwitch. If it proceeds, analysts believe Musk could gain a controlling share in Tesla, where he currently wields less voting power compared to SpaceX, Ruwitch says. In November, Tesla shareholders approved a trillion-dollar pay package for Musk, contingent on meeting growth targets over the next decade. This merger could help him achieve those targets and secure the payout. Shareholders must approve the deal, but analysts believe this could be challenging on Tesla's side because shareholders might demand a higher share price.
paras.zh: - 据 NPR 的约翰·鲁维奇 (John Ruwitch) 报道，马斯克在最近的 SpaceX 和特斯拉财报电话会议上重新提出了合并的想法。鲁维奇表示，如果进展顺利，分析师认为马斯克可能会获得特斯拉的控股权，目前与 SpaceX 相比，马斯克在特斯拉的投票权要少。去年 11 月，特斯拉股东批准了马斯克数万亿美元的薪酬方案，条件是能否实现未来十年的增长目标。这次合并可以帮助他实现这些目标并确保支付。股东必须批准该交易，但分析师认为这对特斯拉来说可能具有挑战性，因为股东可能要求更高的股价。

paras.en: When news broke that Cardi B would be at the NPR Music office, so many people came to see the rapper perform an intimate set that staff had to turn some away, which is a rare occurrence. People flocked to see the unfiltered rap star, who arrived in leather pants and a power blazer, bringing a mix of humility and humor. She opened her performance with the haunting synths of "Hello" and closed with two pivotal hits from her catalog: the breakout single "Bodak Yellow" and the boogaloo-heavy "I Like It." Don't miss out — catch her entire electrifying Tiny Desk Concert here.
paras.zh: 当 Cardi B 将前往 NPR 音乐办公室的消息传出时，许多人前来观看这位说唱歌手表演亲密的表演，以至于工作人员不得不拒绝一些人，这种情况很少见。人们蜂拥而至，想要一睹这位未经过滤的说唱明星的风采，他穿着皮裤和动力西装外套，带着谦逊和幽默的气质。她以令人难忘的合成器“Hello”开始了她的表演，并以她目录中的两首关键热门歌曲结束了她的表演：突破性单曲“Bodak Yellow”和充满布加洛音乐的“I Like It”。不要错过——在这里观看她整个令人兴奋的 Tiny Desk 音乐会。

paras.en: Chip Thomas has been creating public art in rural areas of the Navajo Nation for nearly two decades. Last month, he received a MacArthur Foundation "genius" award for the social impact of his work. His artwork features large black-and-white images depicting life on the reservation. Thomas moved to the Navajo Nation in 1987 as a family physician and grew close to the community, helping with everyday tasks and eventually started photographing them. His art reflects the beauty and resilience of the people who live on the land. Don't miss these stunning photos.
paras.zh: 奇普·托马斯 (Chip Thomas) 近二十年来一直在纳瓦霍族部落的农村地区创作公共艺术。上个月，他因其工作的社会影响而获得了麦克阿瑟基金会“天才”奖。他的艺术作品以描绘保留地生活的大型黑白图像为特色。托马斯于 1987 年作为一名家庭医生搬到纳瓦霍族部落，与社区关系越来越密切，帮助处理日常事务，并最终开始为他们拍照。他的艺术反映了生活在这片土地上的人们的美丽和坚韧。不要错过这些令人惊叹的照片。

paras.en: - Gary Tyler, a quilt artist who spent decades on death row for a murder he did not commit, now has his first solo exhibit at the Grand Rapids Art Museum.
paras.zh: - 加里·泰勒 (Gary Tyler) 是一位被子艺术家，他因自己没有犯下的谋杀案而在死囚牢房里呆了几十年，现在他在大急流城艺术博物馆举办了他的首次个展。

paras.en: - Researchers are publishing some of the first data in humans suggesting that psilocybin may have potential benefits for patients with neurodegenerative diseases, such as Parkinson's.
paras.zh: - 研究人员正在发表一些关于人体的首批数据，表明裸盖菇素可能对患有神经退行性疾病（例如帕金森氏症）的患者具有潜在的益处。

paras.en: - America has a new national park. Trump signed legislation this week upgrading the status of Arizona's Chiricahua National Monument. The park is part of the Chiricahua Mountains. (via AZPM)
paras.zh: - 美国有一个新的国家公园。特朗普本周签署了提升亚利桑那州奇里卡瓦国家纪念碑地位的立法。该公园是奇里卡瓦山脉的一部分。 （通过 AZPM）

articles.title: Greetings from the Brazil-Argentina border, where waterfalls are flowing at near-record rates
articles.author: Carrie Kahn

paras.en: Greetings from the Brazil-Argentina border, where waterfalls are flowing at near-record rates
paras.zh: 来自巴西和阿根廷边境的问候，那里的瀑布正以接近创纪录的速度流动

paras.en: IGUAZÚ NATIONAL PARK, Argentina — Few times in my life have I felt the enormity and power of nature. Standing at the edge of Iguazú Falls, on the Brazil-Argentina border, was one of them.
paras.zh: 阿根廷伊瓜苏国家公园——我一生中很少几次感受到大自然的巨大和力量。站在巴西和阿根廷边境的伊瓜苏瀑布边缘，就是其中之一。

paras.en: Iguazú isn't just one imposing fall, but a complex of cascades spanning more than a mile across both countries. A rain-soaked October in Brazil has sent near-record volumes of water surging over its towering cliffs. Scientists link the relentless rains to this year's Super El Niño, causing extreme weather events across the globe.
paras.zh: 伊瓜苏不仅仅是一个气势磅礴的瀑布，而是横跨两国、跨越一英里多的瀑布群。巴西十月被雨水浸透，导致接近创纪录的水量冲过高耸的悬崖。科学家将持续不断的降雨与今年的超级厄尔尼诺现象联系起来，导致全球出现极端天气事件。

paras.en: But what a spectacular force of nature for the lower-than-average number of tourists who braved the deluge this month. The roar of the rushing Iguazú river under your feet penetrates your body; your eyes strain to keep up as the rusty swells disappear over the steep precipice.
paras.zh: 但对于本月冒着洪水袭击的游客数量低于平均水平来说，这是多么壮观的自然力量啊。脚下伊瓜苏河奔腾的咆哮声穿透你的身体；当生锈的海浪消失在陡峭的悬崖上时，你的眼睛费力地跟上。

paras.en: One day during my recent visit, officials registered nearly 12 million liters (more than 3 million gallons) of water per second tumbling over the falls. That's 10 times the normal flow. As the Iguazú river's red, muddy waters raced furiously toward the falls' edge, they lapped the bottom of the narrow metal catwalks that usually hover a few feet above the falls during normal-rainfall years.
paras.zh: 在我最近访问期间的一天，官员记录到每秒有近 1200 万升（超过 300 万加仑）的水从瀑布上翻滚。这是正常流量的 10 倍。当伊瓜苏河红色浑浊的河水猛烈地冲向瀑布边缘时，它们拍打着狭窄的金属过道的底部，在正常降雨的年份，这些金属过道通常盘旋在瀑布上方几英尺处。

paras.en: Officials closed the spectacular walkways as the river level kept rising. When asked why access was shut off, the national park's director simply said, "It just keeps raining."
paras.zh: 随着河流水位不断上升，官员们关闭了壮观的人行道。当被问及为何关闭通道时，国家公园负责人简单地说：“雨一直在下。”

paras.en: That's an understatement. I'm still drying out.
paras.zh: 这是轻描淡写的说法。我还在晒干。

articles.title: 0% intro APR until 2024 is 100% insane

paras.en: If you're on a Galaxy Fold, consider unfolding your phone or viewing it in full screen to best optimize your experience.
paras.zh: 如果您使用的是 Galaxy Fold，请考虑展开手机或全屏查看手机，以最大程度地优化您的体验。

paras.zh: 如果您的唯一目标是停止利息，富国银行 Reflect® 卡将是您的最佳选择。这是我的诚实评论。

paras.en: Intro APR 0% intro APR for 21 months from account opening on purchases and qualifying balance transfers
paras.zh: 初始年利率 0% 初始年利率，自购买账户开户和合格余额转账起 21 个月内

paras.en: Purchases: 0% intro APR for 21 months from account opening on purchases
paras.zh: 购买：自购买账户开户起 21 个月内 0% 初始年利率

paras.zh: 余额转账：合格余额转账开户后 21 个月内年利率为 0%

paras.en: This no-frills card is a solid choice if your priority is to avoid credit card interest for as long as possible. It offers an incredible 0% intro APR for 21 months from account opening on purchases and qualifying balance transfers (17.74%, 24.24%, or 28.49% Variable APR after). The balance transfer fee (5%; $5 min.) is higher than some cards, but if you want an equally long intro APR on purchases and balance transfers, this card is hard to beat.
paras.zh: 如果您的首要任务是尽可能长时间地避免信用卡利息，那么这张简单的卡是一个不错的选择。从购买账户开户和合格余额转账起，它提供令人难以置信的 0% 介绍年利率 21 个月（之后为 17.74%、24.24% 或 28.49% 可变年利率）。余额转账费用（5%；至少 5 美元）比某些卡要高，但如果您想要购买和余额转账时有同样长的年利率介绍，那么这张卡很难被击败。

paras.zh: 这些卡是为那些希望还清大额购买或转移余额的人而设计的，因此我们的评级强调免息期、费用结构以及您真正还清贷款的时间。

paras.zh: 我们不会因为缺乏长期奖励而对信用卡进行处罚——这一类别主要是为了节省利息，我们的评级反映了这一点。

paras.en: We combine these factors with an evaluation of brand reputation and customer satisfaction to ensure you're getting the best high limit card recommendations. Our aim is to maintain a balanced best-of list featuring top-scoring high limit credit cards from reputable brands. 'Best for' category selections on this page are determined by our editors, and a single card may be recognized in multiple categories.
paras.zh: 我们将这些因素与品牌声誉和客户满意度评估相结合，以确保您获得最佳的高限额卡推荐。我们的目标是维持一个平衡的最佳列表，其中包括来自知名品牌的得分最高的高限额信用卡。此页面上的“最佳”类别选择由我们的编辑确定，单张卡片可能会在多个类别中被识别。

paras.en: Ordering within lists is influenced by advertiser compensation, including featured placements at the top of a given list, but our product recommendations are NEVER influenced by advertisers. Learn more about how Motley Fool Money rates credit cards.
paras.zh: 列表中的排序受到广告商补偿的影响，包括给定列表顶部的特色展示位置，但我们的产品推荐永远不会受到广告商的影响。详细了解 Motley Fool Money 如何对信用卡进行评级。

paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡最适合背负高息债务或计划长期分期进行大额购买的人士。

paras.en: You get nearly two years of breathing room with no interest, which can save a lot of money while you pay things off.

paras.zh: 如果您正在寻求现金返还或旅行奖励，那么这张卡不适合您。 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡没有奖励计划，也没有欢迎奖金。一旦介绍期结束，它就失去了大部分价值。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card's headline feature is 0% intro APR for 21 months from account opening on purchases and qualifying balance transfers. (A 17.74%, 24.24%, or 28.49% Variable APR applies after.)
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡的主要特点是，自开户购买和合格余额转账起 21 个月内，年利率为 0%。 （此后适用 17.74%、24.24% 或 28.49% 可变年利率。）

paras.zh: 这是您能在任何地方找到的最长的 0% 年利率卡之一 - 这就是为什么它获得 Motley Fool Money 颁发的 2026 年最佳 0% 年利率介绍卡奖。

paras.zh: 这个长篇介绍年利率对于大额余额（想想任何 5,000 美元以上的东西）特别方便。促销窗口越长，您每月需要支付的费用就越少，无需支付利息即可结清余额。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card charges no annual fee, so it costs nothing to keep in your wallet. For anyone building credit history -- or, like me, holding onto a top credit card for the long haul -- that's a real plus.

paras.zh: 当您使用 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡支付每月的电话费时，该卡包含手机保护功能。每次盗窃或损坏索赔的赔付额最高为 600 美元，免赔额为 25 美元，并且每 12 个月最多可以提出两次索赔。

paras.zh: 我从来没有使用过手机保险，但作为一个经常丢手机而且通常很笨拙的人，我一直喜欢把它放在我的后口袋里。

paras.zh: 我们建议比较选项，以确保您选择的卡最适合您。为了让您的搜索更容易，这里列出了一些优秀的信用卡。

paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡不赚取任何奖励。如果您想要一张具有现金返还或旅行积分等长期福利的卡，那么这张卡不合适。

paras.en: A strong alternative is the Wells Fargo Active Cash® Card (rates and fees), which earns a flat 2% cash rewards on purchases for a $0 annual fee. It's our Best Overall Credit Card of 2026, and a fan favorite for flat-rate rewards.
paras.zh: 一个强有力的替代方案是 Wells Fargo Active Cash® 卡（费率和费用），该卡以 0 美元年费购买即可获得 2% 的固定现金奖励。这是我们 2026 年最佳综合信用卡，也是粉丝最喜欢的统一费率奖励信用卡。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card charges a balance transfer fee of 5%, min: $5 -- this is on the high side for a balance transfer card.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡收取 5% 的余额转账费用，最低 5 美元——这对于余额转账卡来说偏高。

paras.en: If you move a $10,000 balance, you'd owe a $500 fee, even though you'd pay the balance off at 0% during the intro period.
paras.zh: 如果您转移 10,000 美元的余额，则需要支付 500 美元的费用，即使您在介绍期内以 0% 的利率还清余额。

paras.en: Run the math before you transfer, because the fee should cost less than the interest you'd otherwise pay. If you won't clear the balance within the 0% APR period, then an alternative balance transfer card with a lower transfer fee may serve you better.
paras.zh: 在转账之前先计算一下，因为费用应该低于您原本支付的利息。如果您无法在 0% 年利率期间清除余额，那么转账费用较低的替代余额转账卡可能会为您提供更好的服务。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card charges a 3% foreign transaction fee, so you'll pay extra on purchases made outside the U.S. If you travel abroad and want to skip that cost, consider one of our favorite travel credit cards.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡收取 3% 的国外交易费，因此您在美国境外购物时需要支付额外费用。如果您出国旅行并想跳过这笔费用，请考虑我们最喜欢的旅行信用卡之一。

paras.en: It also has no purchase protection or extended warranty on purchases.
paras.zh: 它也没有购买保护或延长购买保修。

paras.en: You'll generally need good to excellent credit (Motley Fool Money estimates this to be a FICO® Score of about 670 or higher) to qualify for the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card. Wells Fargo doesn't publish an official cutoff, and applicants closer to 700 tend to be the best-qualified candidates.
paras.zh: 您通常需要良好到优秀的信用（Motley Fool Money 估计 FICO® 分数约为 670 或更高）才有资格获得 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡。富国银行没有公布官方截止日期，接近 700 名的申请者往往是最合格的候选人。

paras.en: Keep in mind, your score isn't the only factor. Wells Fargo also weighs your income, existing debt, and overall credit history. You can check for pre-selected offers on Wells Fargo's site without a hard inquiry to gauge your chances first.
paras.zh: 请记住，您的分数并不是唯一的因素。富国银行还会衡量您的收入、现有债务和整体信用记录。您可以在富国银行网站上查看预先选定的优惠，无需进行严格询问即可首先评估您的机会。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card comes with a minimum credit limit of $1,000, and higher scores and income generally earn higher limits. Wells Fargo sets your limit individually based on your full credit profile, so two applicants can get very different lines of credit.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡的最低信用额度为 1,000 美元，分数和收入越高，通常获得的信用额度也越高。富国银行根据您的完整信用状况单独设置您的限额，因此两个申请人可以获得截然不同的信用额度。

paras.en: Your starting limit isn't permanent, though. Once your account is open and in good standing, usually after six to 12 months, you can request an increase. Or, Wells Fargo may raise it automatically for on-time payments and low utilization.
paras.zh: 不过，您的起始限制并不是永久的。一旦您的账户开设且信誉良好，通常在 6 到 12 个月后，您就可以请求增加金额。或者，富国银行可能会因按时付款和利用率低而自动提高费用。

paras.en: To get the 0% intro APR for 21 months from account opening on qualifying balance transfers (then 17.74%, 24.24%, or 28.49% Variable APR), you must complete qualifying transfers within 120 days of opening your account.
paras.zh: 要在开户后 21 个月内通过合格余额转账获得 0% 初始年利率（然后是 17.74%、24.24% 或 28.49% 可变年利率），您必须在开户后 120 天内完成合格转账。

paras.en: I recommend starting the transfer online or by phone as soon as you're approved. Having your old account details ready speeds things up.
paras.zh: 我建议您在获得批准后立即开始在线或通过电话转移。准备好旧帐户详细信息可以加快速度。

paras.en: One important note: you can't transfer a balance from another Wells Fargo or affiliated card. Transfers have to come from a different issuer, and the 5%, min: $5 transfer fee applies to each one.
paras.zh: 一个重要的注意事项：您无法从另一张富国银行或附属卡转移余额。转账必须来自不同的发行人，并且每笔转账均需缴纳 5%（最低 5 美元）的转账费。

paras.en: Applying for the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card is quick. Here's what to do:
paras.zh: 申请 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡的速度很快。该怎么做：

paras.en: Approvals are usually instant, but can take a few days if Wells Fargo needs to verify some of your information.
paras.zh: 批准通常是即时的，但如果富国银行需要验证您的某些信息，则可能需要几天的时间。

paras.en: Yes, the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card is worth it if your priority is paying off debt or financing a large purchase without interest. Very few cards give you a long no-interest runway like this.
paras.zh: 是的，如果您的首要任务是偿还债务或为大额购买提供无息融资，那么 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡是值得的。很少有卡可以给你这样一条漫长的无息跑道。

paras.en: It's not worth it if you want rewards or perks after the intro period, since it offers neither.
paras.zh: 如果您在介绍期后想要奖励或福利，那么这是不值得的，因为它两者都没有提供。

paras.en: Ready to make a dent in your debt? Apply for the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card today -- awarded Motley Fool Money's Best 0% Intro APR Card of 2026.
paras.zh: 准备好减少债务了吗？立即申请 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡 - 荣获 Motley Fool Money 2026 年最佳 0% 年利率介绍卡。

paras.en: When the 0% intro APR period ends, any remaining balance starts accruing interest at your regular variable APR from that point forward. The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card doesn't charge deferred or retroactive interest, so you only pay on what's left -- not on the full original balance.
paras.zh: 当 0% 介绍年利率期结束时，任何剩余余额将开始按照您的常规可变年利率计息。 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡不收取递延或追溯利息，因此您只需支付剩余金额，而不是全额原始余额。

paras.en: No, the 0% intro APR does not cover cash advances. Cash advances start accruing interest immediately at a separate, higher APR and come with their own fee. The intro offer only applies to purchases and qualifying balance transfers.
paras.zh: 不可以，0% 的年利率不包括现金预支。现金预支立即开始以单独的、较高的年利率计息，并收取自己的费用。介绍优惠仅适用于购买和符合条件的余额转账。

paras.en: Keeping the card open is usually the better move, even after your balance hits $0. If it has no annual fee, it costs nothing to hold, and the open account helps your credit score by supporting your total available credit and length of history.
paras.zh: 即使您的余额达到 0 美元，保持卡打开通常是更好的选择。如果它没有年费，那么持有它就不需要任何成本，并且开放账户通过支持您的总可用信用和历史长度来帮助您的信用评分。
